tei:div.tei:p: (1)chos kyi rje dpal ldan sgam po pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan thar pa rin po che'i rgyan gyi mchog ces bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// na mo gu ru/ mkhyen gnyis yon tan mchog gi sku// srid zhi kun gyi dpal gcig po// mtshungs med yongs grags sgam po pa// 'gro mgon bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// 'dren pa chos rje rin chen gyi// yon tan brjod kyis mi lang yang*// mthong thos mos gus bskyed bya'i phyir// mdzad spyod rnam thar cung zad bri// 'dir dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ gdul bya rigs can rnams la sprul pa'i sku sna tshogs su 'char zhing gsol ba btab pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa 'byung ba/ mdo sde du ma las "$ (2)lung bstan pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa/ mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i bla ma rin po che sgam po pa'i rnam par thar pa la gnyis te/ sngon byung gi rnam thar dang*/ da ltar gyi rnam thar gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rje sgam po pa chen po 'di skye ba thog ma med pa nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che spyad de/ de yang sngon gyi dus su skye ba bzhes pa ni/ mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i le'u sum cu rtsa drug pa nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa grangs med pa bas kyang ches grangs med pa/ tshad med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gzhal du med pa mtshungs pa med par gyur pa/ de'i tshe de'i dus na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che padma'i zla ba rnam par dag pa mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ngo*// de'i sku tshe'i tshad ni bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgur gyur to// de nyi ma re re zhing yang sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu sangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir mi ldog par bkod do// rab tu bkod cing yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas sems can dpag tu med pa rnams zag pa zad pa dgra bcom pa nyid la bkod do// rab tu bkod cing mya ngan las (3)'das nas sems can grangs med pa dpag tu med pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa la bkod de/

yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur to// bcom ldan 'das te mya ngan las 'das nas lnga brgya tha ma la dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur ba'i dus kyi tshe/ dam pa'i chos rab tu 'jig par gyur pa na/ yul khams der rgyal po dpa' bas byin zhes bya ba zhig byung ste/ rgyal po dpa' bas byin la btsun mo'i 'khor bud med brgyad khri bzhi stong yod/ bu stong yod/ bu mo ni lnga brgya yod do// de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po dpa' bas byin gyi pho brang rin chen ldan zhes bya ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba sgo bzhi yod pa/ stegs bu dang*/ sgo khang dang*/ rta babs dang*/ skar khung dang*/ pu shu dang*/ khang pa dang*/ khang pa brtsegs pa dang*/ skyed mos tshal gyis brgyan cing rnam par bkra ba lta na sdug pa/ lha'i gnas bzhin du snang ba/ sems can grangs med dpag tu med pa'i gnas su gyur pa zhig yod do// kun dga' bo de'i dus na mdo sde 'di lta bu dag ni skye bo mang pos smad cing spangs te skye bo mang po dang mi 'phrod cing bor bar gyur te/ 'jigs pa chen po mi zad pa'i dus su gyur pa/ 'tshe ba mang zhing char che ba'i dus/ char mi 'bab pa'i dus/ dus ma yin par char 'bab (4)pa'i dus/ sbrul 'byung ba'i dus/ lce 'bab pa'i dus/ mu ge 'byung ba'i dus/ log par lta ba'i dus/ yang dag pa ma yin par lta ba'i dus/ mu stegs can gyi sngags tshol ba'i dus/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jig par gyur pa'i dus kyi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' bdun stong grong dang grong khyer dang grong brdal dang*/ yul 'khor dang rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor dang*/ ljongs nas bskrad nas/ de dag chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs pa dang lhan cig tu kun tu bzang po zhes bya 'i nags khrod der bsten cing gnas te/ me tog zla mdzes de yang*/ dge slong de dag la gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ston to// nags khrod de yang dus thams cad du snang ba'i me tog sna tshogs dang*/

snye ma dang 'khri shing dang 'bras bu dag dang ldan pa/ dpag bsam shing dang 'dra ba'i shing sna tshogs kyis gang zhing*/ sa gzhi yang gzugs dang kha dog du ma dang myu gu thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ brag dang rdo ba sna tshogs pa mdzes shing dri ma med pa yangs shing mtho ba/ gser gyi ri dwags kyis mdzes par byas shing 'dug pa/ rig sngags 'chang dang dri za dang skyes bu dang drang srong dang mi'am ci dag gnas pa/ byad gzugs dang kha dog che zhing rnam pa sna tshogs mang po dag gnas pa/ sangs rgyas mang po bzhugs (5)pa'i dga' tshal dang 'dra ba/ kun tu bzang zhing rnal 'byor dang mthun pa'i nags tshal dam pa kun tu bzang po de na/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag rnal 'byor la rjes su brtson zhing gnas par gyur to// kun dga' bo chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes de gcig pu dben par song nas/ nang du yang dag 'jog la zhugs te/ lha'i mig rnam par dag pa mi las 'das pas bltas pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig mang po dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs 'dir skyes te/ de dag gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan pa rnyed na ni/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi zlog par 'gyur/ gal te chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan pa ma rnyed na/ bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir bzlog par mthong ngo*// de nas chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes dran zhing shes bzhin du ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po ga la ba yod pa der song ste phyin nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs de dag la 'di skad ces smras so// rigs kyi bu dag kho bo ni 'gro'o// grong dang grong khyer dang grong 'dabs dang*/ ljongs dang yul 'khor dang rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du song ste/ sems can rnams la chos ston par bya'o// zhes so// de (6)nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes la 'di skad ces smras so// khyod nags khrod 'di nas grong dang grong khyer dang*/

grong 'dabs dang ljongs dang yul 'khor dang rgyal po'i pho brang du 'gro ba ni kho bo cag 'dod pa ma yin no// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong dang*/ dge slong ma dang*/ dge bsnyen dang*/ dge bsnyen ma lhag pa'i nga rgyal can mang po dam pa'i chos spong ba'i dus la bab kyis/ de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa srog gcod par gyur na ma legs so// tshe dang ldan pa khyod ni shin tu mdzes shing byad bzhin bzang la lta na sdug pa ste/ dang po'i lang tsho dang ldan zhing na tshod dar la bab ste/ mdog ni gser btso ma dang 'dra/ dpral ba ni dung dang zla ba dang*/ me tog kun da'i kha dog lta bus mdzod spus brgyan/ skra dang thor tshugs ni mthon mthing lcang lor 'khyil ba yin pas/ rgyal po'am rgyal po'i blon po'am/ de lta bu gzhan dag kyang phrag dog dang 'jungs pas non pa'i sems kyis khyod kyi srog bcad na ma legs so// de bas mi gshegs par gsol zhes pa la/ me tog zla mdzes kyi byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po de la 'di skad du/ gal te kho bos bdag nyid bsrung ba byas na/ 'das pa dang*/ ma byon pa dang*/ da ltar byung (7)ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bstan pa bsrung bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes zer nas tshigs su bcad pa yang smras te/ bdag tu 'du shes 'di la gnas nas su// bstan pa 'di la bsrung bar yongs mi nus// mi zad phyi dus bde bar gshegs pa yi// byang chub bstan pa bkod pa chen po yin// bdag gis rtag tu 'du shes kun spangs shing*// sems can 'di dag gang zag smra gnas dang*// gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro rnams dang*// reg bya spong ba de ni bstan pa bsrung*// bskal pa bye ba gaṅgā'i bye snyed du// dang ba'i sems kyi zas dang skom rnams dang*// gdugs dang ba dan mar me'i phreng ba yis// sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig rim gro byas// gang gis dam chos rab tu 'jig pa dang*// bde gshegs bstan pa 'gag par 'gyur ba'i tshe// nyin mtshan du ni bslab pa cig spyod pa// bsod nams 'di ni de bas bye brag 'phags// skyes bu khyu mchog gis ni dam pa'i chos// 'jig par 'gyur tshe gang dag btang snyoms bsgom// de yis rgyal ba bkur sti byas ma yin// 'dren pa dag la ri mor des ma byas// khyod bde rang gi don gyis la// bdag nyid rab tu bsrung bar gyis// khyed ni rtag tu byams gnas shing*// 'dul ba 'di la bag yod (8)gyis// ma 'dres dag gtsang dri med pa// tshul khrims drang por bsrung bar gyis// gang gis tshul khrims dri ma med// sangs rgyas bsngags pa bsrung ba ni// de yis ji snyed sngon byung ba// bde gshegs thams cad ri mor byas// de yis thams cad skyabs pa yin// skye bo'i tshogs rnams byang chub bkod// sngon gyi sangs rgyas dag gis bstod pa yi// tshul khrims dri med pa de sus bsrungs pa// de dag gis ni sems can mang po yang*// sems can dmyal ba dang ni sdig las drangs// chos mchog rin chen sbyin pa byin par gyis// bzod pa dag kyang rtag tu bsrung gyis la// dgon par gnas shing ting 'dzin mkhas pa dang*// 'jam zhing mnyen pa dag kyang sgom par gyis// rnam pa kun tu rtsod pa ma byed par// spyod pa zhi mchog 'di la rnam par spyod// bdag ni sems can rnams kyang bskyab pa'i phyir// grong dang rgyal po'i pho brang 'gro bar bya// zhes me tog zla mdzes 'gro bar byas pa dang*/

byang chub sems dpa' de dag kha cig ni rkang pa la 'ju bar byed/ snying rjes ngu zhing mchi ma 'dzag /mkhas pa blo gros chen po bdag nyid bsrung bar mdzod la ma bzhud cig /ces smras pa/ blo gros che 'chang sems can dam pa'i mchog /drang srong de ni 'gro (9)bar byas pa dang*// kha cig rkang pa la yang 'ju bar byed// snying rje bar yang ngu zhing mchi ma 'dzag /mkhas pa blo gros chen po ma bzhud par// sgra 'jam yid du 'ong zhing mdzes pa yis// zhing 'di rnams la gzigs shing rtog pa mdzod// bdag nyid bsrung ba mdzod la ma bzhud cig /sngon gyi stobs bcu 'dren pa de dag kyang*// dbang po zhi zhing shin tu des pa rnams// nags tshal brag dang ri yi rtser gshegs nas// byang chub dam pa dag ni thugs su chud// byang chub rgyur yang spyod pa dam pa spyad// de dag bsod nams ye shes mchog dang ldan// de dag rjes slob nags khrod gnas par mdzod// brtul zhugs bzang po 'di nas ma bzhud cig /lus ni shin tu mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan// khyod kyi skra yang mthon mthing kha dog ste// gser gyi mdog 'dra 'od byed pa// mtshan 'di rnams kyang rab tu snang bar gyur// khyod kyi mdzod spu bzhin gyi smin mtshams na// shin tu mdzes pa dung dang 'dra ba'i 'od// rgyal po dag kyang de bzhin srid kyi phyir// phrag dog skyes nas khyod kyi lus bshig 'gyur// zhes smras so// de nas chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes kyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po de la tshigs su bcad pas smras pa/ ji snyed sngon gyi bde gshegs byung ba (10)ni// thams cad mkhyen cing zag pa zad pa rnams// de dag thams cad 'jig rten don mdzad de// srid pa gsum du byang chub dam pa rtogs// spyad pa'i dam pa byang chub rgyu spyad de// de dag bsod nams ye shes mchog dang ldan// de yi rjes bslabs byang chub sems dpa' yang*// sems can khrag khrig rnams kyi skyabs byed 'dod// drang srong mkhas pa kun gyi bskor byas te// rkang pa la yang phyag 'tshal shugs phyung nas// mi zad snying rje bar ni sgra 'byin cing*// nyams thag mi bde cho nges 'debs par byed// kha cig rab tu 'gyel zhing brgyal nas su// sa la lhung ba sa la bcad 'gyel bzhin// 'on kyang drang srong sems can don 'dod pa// bsod nams bsags pas de las phyir mi ldog

/drang srong chos gos lhung bzed thogs nas chas// ji ltar seng ge ral pa can dag bzhin// de ni chos kyi rang bzhin gnas pas na// de la yon tan nges pa bya ba med// 'jig rten 'dir ni nags khrod bdag gnas pas// sems can ngan song song na ma legs zhes// de ni sems can bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// grong khyer pho brang mchog tu song bar gyur// de nas chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes des/ grong dang grong khyer dang*/ grong brdal dang*/ ljongs dang*/ yul 'khor (11)dang*/ rgyal po'i pho brang du 'ongs nas/ sems can rnams la chos bstan te/ de'i snga dro der 'ongs nas srog chags khrag khrig phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa la bkod do// da dung rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor der ma phyin nas/ mthar gyis rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan der phyin pa dang*/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan der nye bar song ste/ shing plakṣa dang*/ sa la'i drung du 'dug go /de'i nub mo 'das pa dang*/ rgyal po'i pho brang rin chen ldan du zhugs par gyur te/ zhugs nas srog chags bye ba khrag khrig phrag sum cu rtsa drug sangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir mi ldog par bkod kyang*/ da dung zas kyi bya ba ma byas so// de nas rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sen (12)mo'i mchod rten gang na yod pa der song ste/ 'greng bzhin du nyin mtshan 'das par byas so// de de'i nub mo 'das nas snga dro gnyis pa la rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan du zhugs nas/ srog chags bye ba phrag nyi shu rtsa gsum sangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir mi ldog par bkod de/ da dung zas kyis bya ba ma byas so// de nas/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sen mo'i mchod rten gang na yod pa der song ste/

'greng bzhin du nyin mtshan 'das par byas so// de de'i nub mo 'das nas snga dro gsum pa la rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan du zhugs nas/ srog chags bye ba brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu sangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir mi ldog par bkod de/ da dung zas kyi bya ba ma byas so// de nas/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sen mo'i mchod rten gang na yod pa der song nas 'greng bzhin du nyin mtshan 'das par byas so// de de'i nub mo 'das nas/ snga dro bzhi pa la rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan du zhugs nas srog chags bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa la bkod de/ da dung zas kyi bya ba ma byas so// de nas/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sen mo'i mchod rten gang na yod pa der song nas 'greng bzhin du nyin mtshan 'das par byas so// de de'i nub mo 'das nas snga dro lnga pa la btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du song nas/ bud med brgyad khri bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa la bkod do// grong khyer de nas kyang sems can grangs med (13)dpag tu med pa dang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par bkod de/ da dung zas kyi bya ba ma byas so// de nas rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sen mo'i mchod rten gang na yod pa der song nas 'greng bzhin du nyin mtshan 'das par byas so// de de'i nub mo 'das nas snga dro drug pa la rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan du zhugs nas/ rgyal po'i bu stong bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par bkod de/

da dung zas kyi bya ba ma byas so// de nas rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sen mo'i mchod rten gang na yod pa der song nas 'greng bzhin du nyin mtshan 'das par byas so// de de'i nub mo 'das nas snga dro bdun pa la rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan du zhugs pa dang*/ rgyal po dpa' bas byin skyed mos tshal du 'gro ba mthong ste/ gser gyi shing rta la ngos ni dngul/ mda' ni sbrul gyi snying po tsandan/ 'khor lo ni bai ḍūrya/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan bsgrengs pa dang*/ rin po che'i shing rta sna tshogs kyi brgyan/ shing rta'i mda' la dar gyis dkris shing*/ ras bcos bu phrugs kyis g.yogs pa bu mo gzhon nu brgyad brgyas rin po che'i thig gus (14)btags shing 'dren te/ de dag byad bzhin bzang zhing mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa kha dog bzang po rgyas pa'i mchog dang ldan pa/ byis pa rnams dga' bar byed cing tshim par byed pa ste/ mkhas pa rnams la ni ma yin no// rgyal rigs shing sa la chen po lta bu brgyad khri bzhi stong yang zhabs 'bring mtho dman du 'gro'o// bram ze shing sa la chen po lta bu brgyad khri bzhi stong yang zhabs 'bring mtho dman du 'gro'o// khyim bdag shing sa la chen po lta bu brgyad khri bzhi stong yang zhabs 'bring mtho dman du 'gro'o// rgyal po'i bu mo lnga brgya yang rin po che'i khyogs kyi nang du zhugs nas mdun thog thag tu 'gro ste/ de dag gis dge slong de mthong ma thag tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to// btsun mo'i 'khor brgya stong phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad kyang dge slong de mthong ma thag tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to// skye bo'i tshogs chen po de dag kyang nor bu dang gdub bu rnams bkrol te/

lham rnams bzhag nas/ bla gos phrag pa gcig la gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ dge slong de ga la ba der logs su thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal zhing 'khod do// de nas bu mo gzhon nu de dag kyang sngon gyi dge ba'i (15)rtsa ba dag gis bskul bas khyogs de dag las babs nas/ nor bu dang gdub bu rnams bkrol te/ lham rnams bzhag nas/ bla gos phrag pa gcig la gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ dge slong de ga la ba der logs su thal mo sbyar te/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so// dge slong 'di ni byon pa'i tshe// nyi ma lta bur thams cad du// 'di dag rab tu snang bar bgyis// skye bo'i tshogs kyang 'dun par gyur// 'dod chags zhe sdang rgyun bcad cing*// gti mug dag kyang bsal bar gyur// de tshe zhe sdang khro ba dang*// phrag dog thams cad bcad par gyur// rgyal po dpa' bas byin pa yi// zhabs 'bring sras la sogs pa yang*// su yang rgyal po mi lta ste// su yang zhabs 'bring mi bgyid do// ji ltar zla ba nya ba ni// skar ma dag gis bskor ba bzhin// rgyal po'i bu mos mdun bdar bas// dge slong 'di yang mdzes par gyur// ji ltar gser gzugs ri mo dag /mkhas pas ri mo bris pa dang*// sa la'i rgyal po rgyas pa ltar// de bzhin dge slong mdzes par gyur// mthu chen brgya byin lha yi dbang po ni// grong khyer 'jigs pa bdag po mig stong ldan// ri rab spyi la sum cu rtsa gsum dbang*// de bzhin dge slong byon pa 'di (16)yang mdzes// tshangs pa 'jig rten tshangs pa gnas pa 'dra// rab 'phrul lha yi bu ni lha dbang bzhin// 'dod khams 'thab bral mchog gi lha bzhin du// dge slong byon pa 'di yang de bzhin mdzes// nyi ma bzhin du bar snang lhan ner gyis// 'od zer stong ldan mun nag rab tu sel// phyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyid pa ltar// de bzhin dge slong byon pa mdzes par gyur// bskal pa mtha' yas rgya cher sbyin pa byin// tshul khrims ma nyams rtag tu bsrung ba gyis// bzod pa mtshungs med 'jig rten kun tu bsgoms// de ni mtshan gyis rgyan cing 'di ltar mdzes// 'phags pa'i skye bos rab bstod brtson 'grus skyed// bsam gtan bzhi yang zhum med sems kyi bsnyen// nyon mongs dra ba bsal cing shes rab skyed// de phyir dge slong 'jig rten kun tu gda'// sangs rgyas bstan pa mtshungs med sems can snying po ste// dpa' bo 'das pas chos mchog dag kyang rab tu bshad// ma 'ongs dus dang de bzhin da ltar byung ba yi// chos kyi rgyal po dbang brnyed rnams kyi sras de lags// dge slong khyod ni mi rtag nam yang ma gyur cig

/gzugs ni ji ltar 'jig rten kun nas rab tu ldan// gzi brjid che zhing dbyangs sgra shin tu snyan par gda'// rgyal (17)ba'i gzi brjid shin tu lham me snang mi bgyid// chos 'di ji ltar khyod bdag nyid kyis rab rtogs shing*// sangs rgyas dag gi bka' stsal 'jig rten kun tu rgyu// de bzhin bdag cag bud med dngos po kun spangs te// bdag cag thams cad dge slong 'di bzhin 'gyur bar bgyi// de dag thams cad sor bcu'i thal mo sbyar byas nas// tshigs bcad 'di dag smras te gos rnams 'thor bar byed// gser gyi phreng ba dang ni rin chen do shal dang*// rna ba'i rgyan dang mgul gyi rgyan dag rnam mang 'thor// ji ltar 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dag /stobs ldan sa 'di kun la rnam par blta// sras su 'du shes dag ni nye bar 'jog /gling rnams bzhi po 'di dag kun tu 'gro /rgyal rigs dang ni tshong dpon bram ze dang*/ khyim bdag mkhar gyi rgyal po dag gi mi// de dag cig la lhag par sdug pa med// thams cad la yang byams pa mnyam par bskyed// de bzhin dge slong des pa 'di yang ni// gzugs dang dbang rnams la ni shin tu bslabs// byang chub yan lag stobs dang dbang po dang*// yan lag brgyad pa'i lam yang rnam par 'byed// mtshan mo zla ba skar tshogs dbus na yang*// ji ltar rab tu mdzes par snang ba bzhin// ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil (18)'khor 'char ba'i tshe// gzi brjid ldan zhing rnam par snang bgyid bzhin// dbang po zhi zhing stobs bcu ldan pa yi// sangs rgyas des pa kun la phyag 'tshal lo// de dag gis ni bsngags pa bskal pa brgyas// zad par byed nus skyes bu su yang med// bskal pa bye ba stong phrag mang por ni// yon tan brjod kyang zad pa yod med de// 'jig rten rab mchog gis ni spu cig kyang*// bsngags pa dag ni zad par mi 'gyur ro// des ni mtshungs med 'khor lo rab tu bskor// ye shes dag gis gnas kyang shin tu bstan// zhib cing rdul bral chos rnams bshad pa mdzad// de ni gang na'ang snang bar 'gyur ba med// dge sbyong dang ni bram ze lha dang klu// lha min bdud dang tshangs par bcas la sogs// sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan gyis// rgya mtsho dag ni zad par yongs mi nus// gang gis thugs sras 'di 'dra mnga' ba yi// sman rgyal mtshungs med rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// tshigs bcad 'di dag smras nas de yi tshe// rgyal po'i bu mo gzhon nu thams cad dga'// gser dang gser phye dag kyang 'thor bar byed// gos rnams kyang ni rab tu 'ding bar byed// gtsug gi nor bu do shal mdzes pa dang*// rin thang bye ba khrag ni rgya ri bas// dge slong de la (19)mngon par g.yogs nas ni// dga' nas byang chub phyir yang rab tu zhugs// de nas rgyal po dpa' bas byin 'di snyam du sems te/

kye ma btsun mo'i 'khor 'di dag ni log par zhugs te/ skye bos tshogs kyang log go snyam mo// skye bo de dag kyang nor bu dang gdub bu bkrol/ lham gzhag nas gos phrag pa cig tu bgos te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ dge slong de dag ga la ba der logs su thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal lo// dge slong de byad gzugs bzang ba tsam du/ rgyal po dpa' bas byin byad bzhin mi bzang*/ de tsam du blta na sdug pa ma yin/ de tsam du mdzes pa ma yin te/ de rgyal po 'di'i srid kyi phyir shin tu sngangs par gyur to// dge slong de'i gzugs kyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa mthong nas shin tu khros so// dge slong de rgyal po'i lam na 'dug pa de'i mig tu rdul song ba dang de 'di snyam du sems te/ dge slong 'di chags pa'i sems kyis btsun mo'i 'khor la bltas te/ 'dis mig gis kyang brda byas so// de 'di snyam du sems te/ dge slong 'di la srog gcod par byed pa su yod snyam mo// de nas rgyal po dpa' bas byin gyi zhabs 'bring du bu stong 'brang ba de dag bos nas/ gzhon nu dag dge slong 'di srog dang phrol cig ces byas (20)na/ gzhon nu de dag rgyal po dpa' bas byin la slar ldog go /dge slong de'i phyir 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi bu dag kyang bka' mi nyan te/ bdag gcig tu gnyis su med par bzhag na/ da dge slong 'di srog dang bral bar byed pa su yod snyam mo// de nas rgyal po dpa' bas byin la gsod pa'i gshed ma dga' byed ces bya ba gtum po/ brtse ba med pa ma rungs pa zhig yod pa de rgyal po'i lam na/ rgyal po dpa' bas byin dang ha cang mi ring ba zhig na 'dug go /rgyal po dpa' bas byin gyis de mthong nas/ dga' mgu yi rangs te/ rab tu dga' ba dang*/ mos pa dang*/ yid bde ba skyes nas/ de 'di snyam du sems te/ dga' byed 'dis dge slong 'di srog dang bral bar byed do snyam mo// de nas gsod pa'i gshed ma dga' byed rgyal po dpa' bas byin gang na 'dug pa der 'ongs pa dang*/

dga' byed la 'di skad ces smras so// khyod la bya dga' cher sbyin na/ dga' byed khyod dge slong 'di srog dang bral bar byed nus sam/ dga' byed kyis smras pa/ lha shin tu rngo thogs so// bka' bzhin 'tshal/ dge slong 'di srog dang bral bar 'tshal lo// rgyal pos smras pa/ dga' byed de'i phyir de'i dus la bab par shes na/ mtshon rnon po thogs la/ dge slong (21)'di'i lag pa dang rkang pa chod cig /rna ba dang sna yang chod cig /'dis chags pa'i sems kyis nga'i btsun mo'i 'khor la bltas kyi/ de'i phyir 'di'i mig kyang skam pas phyungs shig ces byas so// de nas gsod pa'i gshed ma dga' byed kyis/ de'i tshe ral gri rnon po thogs nas/ dge slong de'i lag pa dang rkang pa bcad do// rna ba dang sna'ang bcad do// mig gnyis kyang phyung ngo*// de nas dge slong de'i mgo bo dang rna ba dang rkang lag bcad pa las 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma yang byung*/ 'o ma'i rgyun yang byung ste phyogs bcur bskor nas/ slar yang dge slong de'i lus kyi nang du nub bo// bcad cing gtubs pa'i 'phro nas/ dpal be'u dang*/ bkra shis dang*/ 'khor lo la sogs pa nang nas byung ste/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kun tu snang ngo*// de nas rgyal po de skye bo'i tshogs chen po dang dong dong nas/ skye bo'i tshogs chen po des/ dge slong lam na bcad gtubs shing 'dug pa mthong nas/ de dag sdug bsngal zhing yid ma bde ste/ ngo mtshar du gyur nas cho nges btab ste/ smre sngags bton nas phyir yang rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan par song ngo*// de nas rgyal po dpa' bas byin zhag bdun 'das pa dang*/ skyed mos tshal (22)mchog na 'dug pa mi dga' mi rtse yongs su mi spyod de/ skyed mos tshal nas der log nas/ zhag bdun 'das pa dang*/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan du zhugs pa dang*/

des dge slong de rgyal po'i lam du bor ba shi nas zhag bdun lon yang*/ lus kyi mdog ma 'gyur ba mthong nas/ de 'di snyam du sems te/ dge slong 'di'i lus kyi mdog ma 'gyur pa las bltas na/ dge slong 'di ni gdon mi za bar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa yin te/ bdag gis sems can dmyal ba chen por skye bar 'gyur ba'i sdig pa'i las byas kyi/ bdag ni myur du sems can dmyal ba chen por lhung bar 'gyur ro// zhes de ltar sems dpa' na/ steng gi bar snang las lha'i bu brgyad khris sgra skad dbyangs cig tu smras pa/ rgyal po chen po 'di ni de bzhin te/ khyod kyi ji skad zer ba ltar dge slong 'di ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa yin no// zhes zer ro// bar snang las lha dag gi sgra thos nas shin tu 'jigs shing skrag nas/ bag tsha zhing spu zing zhes byed de 'gyod par gyur to// de nas rgyal po dpa' bas byin sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde ste/ 'gyod par gyur pas de'i tshe cho nges cher btab nas tshig 'di skad ces zer ro// rgyal (23)po'i srid dang rgyal po'i pho brang dang*// nor bu rin chen mu tig gser dbyig spang*// bdag nyid mtshon thogs bdag nyid 'chi bar bya// bdag ni byis pa'i blo can las ngan ldan// dge slong me tog zla mdzes 'dir byung bas// sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyi go bgos te// snang bar byed cing rgyal po'i pho brang 'ongs// zla ba nya tshe skar ma'i rgyal po bzhin// 'dod pa'i longs spyod ngan pas bdag dkrugs te// rab tu dga' bar bud med tshogs rnams dang*// shing rta'i nang du zhugs te de nas dong*// rgyal rigs rnams kyis yongs su 'khor lo bskor// dge slong dri mchog mig bzang 'di nyid ni// 'dir byon dge slong de yang mthong nas su// bud med tshogs rnams rab tu dga' gyur cing*// mos pa skyes nas gser gyi phreng ba gtor// thams cad sor bcu'i thal mo sbyar byas nas// tshigs bcad dbyangs kyi dge slong de la bstod// rgyal po yi ni glu yi dbyangs sgra rnams// de dag thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur// de yang shing rta'i nang du zhugs nas ni// rgyal rigs rnams kyi yongs su bskor bar gyur// bde bar gshegs pa'i sras mchog mthu che ba// dge slong dri mchog mig bzang 'dir byon na// bdag gi sems ni rab tu ngan gyur te// dge slong rgyal po'i pho (24)brang 'jug pa'i tshe// bud med tshogs chen dga' bar blta mthong nas// rmongs pas de la phrag dog khro ba skyes// phyogs bzhi kun tu snang ba bgyis pa ni// zla ba sgra gcan zin thar mdzes pa bzhin// dge slong rgyal po'i pho brang 'jug mthong nas// bud med tshogs rnams dga' zhing sgra yang 'byin// bdag gis der ni gtum pa'i tshig smras te// bu stong dag la da nyid khyod song la// dge slong 'di ni dum bu dum bur gyis// 'di ni nga yi dgra mchog ma rungs pa// gzhon nu thams cad mnyen zhing tshul ldan te// bdag la phan sems dge slong de la 'dud// rgyal po 'di 'dra'i bka' bzhin bgyid mi rung*// de tshe bdag ni mya ngan non par gyur// dge slong shin tu tshul khrims mchog ldan pa// byams ldan pha bzhin bzhugs pa mthong nas ni// shin tu gtum pa'i sems kyis gsod du btang*// phyi dus bdag ni lhung nas mnar med sreg

/dga' byed de ni rgyal po'i lam 'dir gnas// ma rungs las bgyid mi la sdug bsngal bskyed// bdag ni bka' bzhin 'di 'dra'i las bgyis te// me tog phreng rgyus 'dra ba'i dge slong gtubs// nags mchog kun tu bzang po dga' ba na// bya yis gang zhing me tog dri zhim rgyas// de nas dge slong tshogs gzhan rab mang ba// bu gcig pu ni ma (25)dang bral ba bzhin// dge slong bzhengs la nags su gnas par mdzod// mi'i don yang shin tu rgya cher gyis// rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor 'dir phyin pa'i tshe// dge slong shin tu snying rjer ngu zhing tshol// lag pa g.yas pas me tog rgyal mtshan thogs// g.yon pa yis kyang blta sdug mdzes pa bzhin// lam yang sbyangs shing gos kyi khebs par g.yogs// dge slong bzhengs la chos mchog bshad pa mdzod// rgyal po'i khab 'dir khyod bzhugs ring lon yang*// dge slong rab tu snying rjer ngu zhing tshol// rgyal ba mchog gi bstan pa 'jig pa'i tshe// khyod kyi srog gi bar chad 'gyur du dogs// ji ltar skyes bu mthu chen la la dag /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rtag tu sgra grags pa// srid gsum 'di kun thams cad zil mnan nas// g.yang sa chen por mchongs te sar lhung ltar// de bzhin dge slong mtshan mchog rab brgyan pa// byad bzhin bzang po sa 'dir 'gyel bar gyur// me tog zla mdzes zhe sdang gtum med pa// bdag gis sdig pa'i sems kyis dum bur brlags// me tog zla mdzes bkrongs nas sar lhung ba// chos smra 'di ni mthong nas myur bar yang*// dge slong thams cad sdug bsngal gzir gyur te// mi dga' skyes 'gyur de bzhin sems mi bde// (26)me tog zla mdzes ri yi rgyal po ltar// sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyi go bgos te// phreng ba brgyus pa bud med thogs pa 'dra// 'dir ni dum bu dum bur rnam par bcad// bdag gis dngos sdig shin tu mi zad bgyis// mgon med mnar med gshin rje yul du 'chi// 'dir yang dge slong dum bur brlag pa yis// bdag ni sangs rgyas rnams dang ring bas ring*// bdag gis shin tu las ngan bgyis pas na// bu dang gnyen bshes tshogs rnams skyabs mi 'gyur// blon po dang ni zhabs 'bring bkra ba yang*// de dag dmyal bar bdag song skyabs mi 'gyur// sangs rgyas 'das dang de bzhin ma byon dang*// phyogs bcu dag na gang su bzhugs pa yi// ded dpon stobs bcu nyon mongs med pa rnams// rdo rje stug sra mang ba'i skyabs su mchi// der ni dge slong dum bur byas mthong nas// lha rnams rab tu snying rje cho nges 'debs// de dag der song dge 'dun go bar byas// me tog zla mdzes rgyal po'i khab 'dir bsad// chos smra ba ni mkhas shing rtogs pa ste// mthu chen phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rab tu grags// byang chub sems dpa' gzungs la gnas pa ste// me tog zla mdzes rgyal po'i khab 'dir bsad// bskal pa mtha' yas sbyin pa sna tshogs (27)byin// tshul khrims mi g.yo skyon med gang srung zhing*// 'jig rten kun tu mtshungs med bzod bsgoms pa// me tog zla mdzes rgyal po'i khab 'dir bsad// bskal pa mtha' yas rtag tu brtson ldan zhing*// zhum med sems kyi bsam gtan bzhi la sgom// nyon mongs sgom pa'i shes rab gang brten pa// me tog zla mdzes=

/lus la bdog pa thams cad rab spangs shing*// de bzhin srog la ma chags gyur nas ni// kun tu bzang po'i nags nas babs nas su// me tog= /lha yi cho nges chen po thos nas ni// dge slong de kun shin tu sdug bsngal nas// me tog zla mdzes nyes med bsad pa la// blta ba'i phyir yang thams cad grong du lhags// des pa de dag rgyal po'i khab 'ongs nas// dge slong dum bu dum bur byas mthong ste// nyams thag skad kyis mi bzod cho nges 'debs// de dag thams cad brgyal nas sa la 'gyel// dge slong dge 'dun rgyal po de la smra// tshul khrims skyon med shin tu bsdams pa yi// dge slong 'dis ni nyes pa ci zhig byas// 'di ni sngon gyi skye ba bsam yas dran// 'di ni ye shes gzungs dbang pha rol phyin// 'di ni 'dus byas 'di dag stong par shes// 'di (28)ni 'gro ba dag la mtshan med ston// 'di ni smon lam 'du shes thams cad spangs// 'di ni yid 'ong snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'byin// 'di ni des shing dbang po rab tu zhi// 'di ni sngon gyi gnas kyi pha rol phyin// 'jig rten thams cad las kyang mngon par 'phags// 'di ni sangs rgyas rang byung ye shes kyis// khyu mchog gyur cing 'jig rten ri mor byas// dag cing rab rib med pa'i mig gis blta// byams pa dang ni snying rje shin tu che// 'dod pa ngan cing bsam pa ngan pa skyes// mtho ris rnam par ma rung byed pa ste// 'dod pa bsnyen na rna ba med par 'gyur// mig dag shes rab dang yang bral bar 'gyur// mi rnams 'dod pa la ni bsnyen byas na// long bar 'gyur zhing pha dang ma yang gsod// 'dod pa bsnyen byas tshul khrims ldan pa gsod// de bas mi yis 'dod pa rnam par spang*// rgyal pos 'dod pa dag ni bsnyen byas na// sa bdag dam pa 'byor ba 'di bor nas// mi bzod sdug bsngal rtsub byed sems dmyal nas// sems can dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa chen por 'gro

/'di 'dra'i dge slong mkhas pa gsod byed de// sdig pa'i las rnams rtag tu byed par 'gyur// de phyir byang chub zhi ba su 'dod pa// sdig pa rnam pa sna tshogs spang bar bya// lus ni (29)sgyu ma gsog dang 'dra ba dang*// de bzhin rna mig sna lce rig nas ni// gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri mchog dang*// reg bya chos rnams zhum med sems kyis gtong*// sbyin la bslabs shing tshul khrims nyams pa med// bzod pa dang ni brtson 'grus de bzhin te// bsam gtan brtan cing shes rab pha rol song*// sems can dag gi don yang rab tu byed// 'jig rten lha dang mir bcas thams cad kyang*// byams pas rgyal ba la ni rab tu blta// de phyir mig ni mun nag gtibs gyur kyang*// byang chub zhi ba nyid ni 'tshang rgyar 'gyur// rta dang ba glang yang thog khri rnams dang*// khyogs dang sngas rnams kyang ni de bzhin te// glang po dag dang gzhon dang brgal ba dang*// grong dang yul 'khor dga' bas stong par byed// grong khyer dang ni rgyal srid yongs stong zhing*// gser dang dngul dang shel dang byu ru dang*// de bzhin gnas dang bu dang bu mo dang*// rang gi mgo yang gtong zhing byang chub zhugs// me tog dang ni spos dang bdug pa dang*// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan lha yi ba dan dang*// rol mo'i cha byad sna tshogs thogs nas ni// dga' nas mchod pa mtshungs pa med pa byed// srid pa dag ni stong par shes nas kyang*// srid pa'i 'gro ba (30)dag la dga' mi byed// de phyir stobs bcu mtshan gyis rab brgyan cing*// phyogs bcu thams cad du yang snang bar byed// byang chub sems dpa' gzungs la gang gnas pa// 'dod pa'i khams rnams dang ni gzugs kyi khams// gzugs med khams la de dag mi chags te// khams gsum dag la snga nas chags pa med// byang chub sems dpa' gzungs la gang gnas pa// bdag tu 'du shes sems can 'du shes med// srog tu 'du shes gang zag 'du shes med// tshangs par spyad pa ma 'dres rtag tu spyad// byang chub sems dpa' gzungs la gang gnas pa// dngos por 'du shes dngos med 'du shes med// bde bar 'du shes mi bde 'du shes med// grangs su 'du shes grangs med 'du shes med// byang chub sems dpa' gzungs la gang gnas pa// yod par 'du shes med par 'du shes med// bud med 'du shes skyes par 'du shes med// grong du 'du shes grong khyer 'du shes med// byang chub sems dpa' gzungs la gang gnas pa// yul 'khor 'du shes grong brdal 'du shes med// 'dod chags 'du shes 'dod bral 'du shes med// zhe sdang 'du shes sdang bral 'du shes med// gti mug 'du shes 'dod bral 'du shes med// byang chub sems dpa' gzungs (31)la gang gnas pa// nga rgyal nga rgyal bral ba'i 'du shes med// ma rig ma rig ma yin 'du shes med// lta dang lta ba ma yin 'du shes med// byang chub sems dpa' gzungs la gang gnas pa// de dag dbang po stobs la mi chags te// byang chub yan lag bsam gtan chags pa med// khams gsum nyes pa thams cad rnam par spong*// 'dod chags chags med zhe sdang gtum pa med// gti mug rmongs med rtag tu g.yo med gyur// sangs rgyas stobs bcu mthong nas bkur sti byed// blo gros ldan pa mtho ris snon mi byed// su dag gzhan las chos mchog thos nas ni// de la nam yang nem nur mi byed pa// 'bru mar gang ba'i snod bzhin dwangs shing dag

/bcad dang ma bcad gzhan gyi blo yang shes// mdza' ba byas na rjes su chags pa skye// de yang nyon mongs pa ni chen po yin// zhe sdang byas na khong khro skye bar 'gyur// dgra dang 'jigs pa sdig pa rnams kyang 'byung*// 'di gnyis rab tu rnam par sbyangs byas te// blo gros ldan pa dag ni byang chub zhugs// de dag mi yi khyu mchog stobs bcur ni// 'jig rten du yang mngon par 'byung bar 'gyur// nang dang phyi rol dag kyang rnams spangs te// chos kyi ngo bo nyid la rab gnas shing*// tshul khrims phung po dag (32)kyang rnam par sbyangs// ral pa med cing ma 'dres skyon yang med// nam yang de dag gis ni tshul khrims dag /'bags shing 'dres pa dag tu mi 'gyur ro// mtha' dag gis ni gnyis po yongs spangs nas// blo gros 'chang ba byang chub zhi rtogs 'gyur// de nas rgyal po dpa' bas byin gyis dge slong gi dge 'dun las chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes kyi yon tan gyi bye brag chen po yangs shing rgya che ba thos nas/ sdug bsngal zhing yid mi dga' ste/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po la tshigs su bcad pas smras pa/ nags khrod stug po kun tu bzang po ni// sdong po chen pos gang zhing 'bras bus mdzes// dus kun skye ba'i me tog bdug pas brgyan// sna tshogs tha dad bya rnams sgra yang 'byin// gser gyi ri yang mdzes shing mtho bas brgyan// mi 'am ci yi glu dbyangs snyan pa dang*// rol mo shin tu thabs ldan yid 'ong grags// grub pa'i bu mo rtag tu gar yang byed// nags de lha yi dga' ba'i tshal bzhin te// gzugs bzang gzugs 'bar ba yi shing gis dkris// me tog rnam pa sna tshogs tha dad bkram// utpal padmos rgyan cing chu yang 'bab// 'di 'dra'i gnas mchog nyams dga' ba// drang srong rtag tu gnas par mthun pa dag /bor nas sems (33)can don dang phan bzhed pas// sdig pa'i phung po bdag drung grong du byon// de ltar chos smra yon tan 'chang ba 'di// me tog zla mdzes grong khyer 'dir byon te// byon nas sdig pa bgyid pa bdag gis bkrongs// 'di bkrongs pas ni bdag kyang dmyal bar ltung*// byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje'i stobs ldan dag

/dpa' bos sems can phan phyir 'jig rten spyod// de dag sdig bgyid bdag gi skyabs mdzod cig /byang chub sems dpa' de skyabs bdag mchi'o// gang yang rang rgyal dag ni gnyis pa dang*// gang gzhan nyan thos rdzu 'phrul ldan pa ste// zag pa zad cing tha ma'i lus 'dzin pa// bdag ni sdug bsngal mnar med 'chi ba skyobs// de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ de lta bas na kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos lus dang srog la ma chags par bya'o// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo lus dang srog la chags pa'i sems can rnams mi dge ba'i las mngon par 'du byed par 'gyur ro// de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ rtag tu rul ba'i lus 'di dang*// srog kyang g.yo zhing dbang med de// rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra ba la// sems can gang dag chags pa ni// shin tu ma rungs las byas (34)nas// gti mug dbang song de dag ni// sems can dmyal ba mi zad par// mi mkhas bdud kyi gzhol bas song*// dbu ba rdos 'dra'i lus dang ni// chu yi chu bur 'dra srog la// mi dag chags par mi byed pa// de dag 'gro ba mchog tu 'gro /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de lta bas na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ting nge 'dzin 'di 'dod pa dang*/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas/ lus dang srog la mi lta bar byas te/ mgo dang gos la me 'bar ba bzhin du brtson 'grus brtsams pas/ sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po bskyed de/ dben pa na bde bar gnas pa dang*/ dgon pa dang*/ nags khrod spangs te/ grong dang grong khyer dang*/ grong rdal dang*/ ljongs dang*/ yul 'khor dang*/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor dang*/ ri khrod rnams su zhugs te/

ci nas sems can de dag nyan thos kyi byang chub dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba de lta de lta bur sems can rnams la chos bstan par bya'o// de (35)nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la sngon byung ba'i gtam bstan pa 'di nyid rgya cher tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis rgyas par rab tu bstan to// ngas sngon spyad pa dag ni spyod pa na// de tshe rgyal po dpa' bas byin par 'gyur// rgyal po'i pho brang rin chen ldan zhes bya// bskyed mos tshal gyi sar ni byung bar gyur// shing rtar zhugs pas de tshe dge slong mthong*// kun tu mdzes shing blta na sdug pa ste// sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyi go bgos pa// phyogs rnams thams cad du yang snang bar byed// me tog zla mdzes phyogs su grags pa ste// snying rje gnas pa phan zhing snying brtse ba// dpal dang gzi brjid dag gis mdzes pa ni// sems can rnams la brtse phyir grong du 'ongs// nga ni gzugs kyang de tsam mi phod pas// de la nga yang 'jungs pa ma rungs skyes// 'dod la chags shing sred la bcings pas na// 'di ni bdag gi srid las skyod snyam ste// nga yi bu rnams stong du tshang ba yang*// shing rtar zhugs shing zhabs 'bring mtho dma' 'gro /cod pan dang ni sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan// sum cu dbang phyir lha yi bu 'brang bzhin// de na nga yi bu mo lnga brgya dag /nor bu thogs shing lham gyon lta na sdug /mgo rgyan dang ni lhab lhub (36)rgyan gyis spras// de dag gser gyi dra bas shing rta 'dren// nga yi bud med dag ni brgyad khri yang*// gzugs mdzes shin tu blta na sdug pa dag /shing rtar zhugs pas dge slong de mthong ste// ri rab bzhin du gzugs bzang dpal 'bar bas// mthong nas de dag phar yang 'du shes bskyed// byang chub sems dpa' mchog tu sems bskyed de// de tshe tshangs pa'i spyod par yang dag btsud// yid du 'ong ba'i rgyan rnams de la gtor// de tshe nga ni phrag dog skyes par gyur// gnod sems zhe sdang tha ba mi bzad de// dbang phyug rgyags pas bu la 'di skad smras// mdun na 'dug pa'i dge sbyong gsod par gyis// gzhon nu de dag nga yi tshig thos nas// shin tu sdug bsngal yid kyang mi dgar gyur// yab cig de skad kyi ni tshig ma gsung*// dge slong 'di 'dra bdag cag mi 'gums so// bskal pa bye ba gaṅgā'i bye snyed du// bdag cag lus dang yan lag bcad gtubs kyang*// dge slong 'di ni 'gums par mi bgyid de// 'di ltar bdag cag byang chub sems skyes so// rgyal po de tshe bu yi tshig thos nas// khros te gsod pa'i gshed ma 'bangs la smras// nga yi btsun mo'i mdun na 'dug pa yi// dge slong 'di ni myur du sod de phul// de nas gsod pa'i gshed ma (37)phyi bzhin 'ongs// shin tu gtum sems dga' byed snying rje med// 'bru mar ngar btags ral gri thogs nas su// de yis dge slong dum bu brgyad du byas// de yi lus dang yan lag bcad pa las// khrag kyang mi 'dzag 'od zer stong byung ste// bcad pa'i 'phro nas dpal be'u 'khor lo dag

/mtshan rnams de'i lus kyi nang na yod// shin tu ma rungs las ni byas nas su// bskyed mos tshal du de yi mod la byung*// dge slong me tog zla mdzes dran nas ni// de yi rtsed mo dga' bar ma gyur to// rings pa'i gzugs su myur zhing mgyogs par ni// de nas bdag ni rgyal po'i pho brang song*// gang du dge slong dum bu brgyad byas pa// sa phyogs der ni shing rtar zhugs nas phyin// lha rnams khrag khrig mang po bar snang la// cho nges 'debs pa'i sgra dag der thos te// rgyal po khyod kyi mi dge sdig mang bgyis// shi 'phos nas ni mi bde mnar med 'gro /rgyal po des ni lha yi sgra thos nas// shin tu sdug bsngal mi dga' sems skrag gyur// bdag gi me tog zla mdzes bkrongs pa ni// bdag gi sdig pa mi bzad mang po bgyis// de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes mtha' yas ldan// sangs rgyas mi yi khyu mchog sras po dag /dbang po bsrungs shing des pa zhi ba'i yid// (38)de ni 'dod pa'i don phyir bdag gis bkrongs// de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos rnams gang 'dzin cing*// zad pa'i dus la dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod// 'jig rten kun tu chos kyi sgron me mdzad// de ni 'dod pa'i don phyir bdag gis bkrongs// 'jig rten kun na sman pa'i rgyal po dag /sems can na ba rtag tu gso byed cing*// bdud rtsi dag gis bkru sman gtong ba yi// dge slong bdag gi 'dod pa'i don phyir bkrongs// zhib cing zab la zhi ba blta dka' ba'i// chos rnams skye dgu dag la gang 'chad cing*// byang chub snying po mchog kyang gang ston pa// de ni 'dod pa'i don phyir bdag gis bkrongs// 'dren pa rnams kyi chos kyi mdzod 'dzin cing*// 'jig rten mdongs pa'i sgron mar gyur pa ste// gzungs dang mdo sde'i rgyal po gang 'dzin pa// de ni ci slad bdag gis 'dod phyir bkrongs// nyon mongs med cing rnam dag ye shes can// zhi ba rab zhi rtag tu mnyam gzhag pa// 'dod pas mdongs pas bdag gis de bkrongs te// des na shin tu ma rungs dmyal bar lhung*// sangs rgyas gang dag 'das dang de bzhin ma byon dang*// mi yi dam pa rgyal ba gang yang bzhugs pa ni// bsngags pa mtha' yas yon tan rgya mtsho ldan pa rnams// de dag kun la thal mo (39)sbyar te skyabs su mchi// de nas rgyal po dpa' bas byin gyis chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes bsad de shi ba'i lus kyi mdog ma 'gyur bar sa la 'gyel cing 'dug pa mthong nas/

sdug bsngal zhing yid ma bde ste 'gyod cing myos par gyur nas/ de'i tshe cho nges rab tu cher btab bo// chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes de la yang 'di lta bur yang dag pa'i yon tan gyis bstod pa dang*/ snying rje dang ldan pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dag smras so// kun tu bzang por 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyis// khyod la rnam pa mang po go ba gyis// khyod kyi srog gi bar chad byung ta re// rin chen ldan par rgyal po'i khab ma bzhud// khyod kyi dge slong dge 'dun tshig ma bzung*// mgon po grong khyer du ni ci slad byon// khyod ni gang gi don du byon pa yi// don de sgron me mdzad pa mdzad du gsol// lha rdzas myu gu sna tshogs rgyan pa'i sa// gzugs bzang gzugs 'bar shing ljon mang pos bkris// grub pa'i rig 'dzin gnod sbyin mchog gi bsrung*// lha rnams bzhugs shing bya rgyal sgra yang sgrog /kun tu bzang po sangs rgyas rtag bzhugs pa// nags tshal dam pa dga' ba bor nas ni// bgyi ba gang bgyi khyod ni 'dir byon pa// des pa bgyi ba de deng bdag la gsungs// khyod kyi tshig thos (40)nas ni bka' bzhin bgyid// sangs rgyas sras po bzhengs la bka' stsol cig /kye ma da ni ci bgyi lha yi lha// bdag ni mgon med khyod kyi skyabs su mchi// gcig pu seng ge ri dwags rgyal po ltar// dge slong dge 'dun mchog gi khyu bor nas// sems can mtha' yas pa la thugs brtse phyir// rang gi srog kyang btang ste 'dir byon na// 'dod chags zil non shin tu 'jungs pa yis// bdag gis dpa' bo dum du dum bur bcad// 'di ni dge slong dge 'dun mtha' dag kyang*// khyod la blta bar pho brang ma lhags par// bdag ni 'jigs skrag khyod la ci gsol ba// de bar gsol ba zhig ni mdzad par 'os// me tog zla mdzes mi 'jigs bdag stsol la// nya dus zla ba nya 'drar bzhengs su gsol// sems can gtso bo dag la gnang bar mdzod// chos smra khyod ni zhe sdang rnam par grol// de ring bdag la sna cig gnang bar mdzod// nyi ma bzhin du snang mdzad bzhengs su gsol// chos smra mchog ni bdag gis bkrongs bgyis te// sdig pa ma legs bdag gis deng bgyis pas// 'di nas shi 'phos mi bzod dmyal bar skye// bdag la de yi skyabs su 'gyur ba med// nyon mongs byed pa sdig sems ci ru rung*// rgyags pas khengs pa'i rgyal (41)srid ci ru rung*// thams cad spangs te gcig pur 'gro bar 'gyur// 'di nas bdag gi snying po ci ma blangs// 'dod chags zhe sdang bcom pa rnam dag chos// snyan par gsungs pa bdag dul thugs rje can// 'gro ba'i gnyen cig sun 'byin mi mdzad pa// me tog zla mdzes bdag gis ci phyir bkrongs// kye ma bzod dang dka' thub nor phyug brtul zhugs bzang*// kye ma gzugs dang des pa bdag gi yon tan ldan// kye ma g.yo med dpa' stug spros pa mi mnga' ba// bdag cag bor nas khyod ni gang du bzhud par mdzad// 'phags pa de yi lus dang yan lag bcad pa na// 'o ma rab tu zags shing 'od zer stong dag byung*// 'jig rten 'di dag thams cad shin tu ngo mtshar gyur// ngo mtshar che ba'i rang bzhin 'dren pa bzhengs su gsol// kye ma me tog zla mdzes dul ba thugs rje can// kye ma byams dang snying rje'i phung po ri bo tshur// kye ma chos rnams zab mo shin tu ston pa'i mchog

/lha khyod bzhengs shig bdag la thugs brtser mdzad du gsol// kye ma zla ba nya zhal tshur spyon cig /kye ma sa bcu legs gnas tshur spyon cig /kye ma dpa' bo stobs bcus mngon 'phags pa// tshe la khyod dbang bdag po gang du bzhud// kye ma dpa' bo tshur spyon bdag la (42)gsungs// khyod kyis yun ring bzod pa bsgoms pa dang*// brtson 'grus thugs rje de dag gang du mchis// byams pa chen po bzhengs la gsung phyungs shig /kye ma shin tu mchod 'os lha yi lha// chos smra cang mi gsung bar ci slad bzhugs// mkhas pa bzhengs la bdag gi khyim du bzhud// bud med tshogs la khyod kyi chos ston cig /lha khyod lus ni gcod par mi nus te// lha dang lha min gnod sbyin srin pos kyang*// khyod kyi lha yi lus 'di mi shigs kyis// mkhas pa khyod deng sgyu dag ma mdzad cig /lha khyod sgyu mdzad bzhugs pa ga la gda'// byang chub sems dpa' sgyu ma mi mdzes so// sgyu ma thams cad spongs la bzhengs su gsol// rin chen ldan pa'i grong du chos shod cig /kye ma 'phags pa me tog zla mdzes tshur// kye ma khams gsum 'dod chags bral ba tshur// kye ma pha ma lta bur 'dren pa tshur// bdag gi sems dmyal sgo ni gcad du gsol// ngan song skyes pa rnams kyi rten dang dpung*// srog chags mnar med chen por lhung ba yi// skyabs mdzad me tog zla mdzes tshur spyon cig /bdag gi bde 'gro'i sgo yang dbye bar gsol// mgon po khyod ni dgung bdun bshos ma gsol// re shig deng bzhengs bdag gi bshos gsol cig /bdag gi bshos gsol rin chen ldan pa 'dir// (43)sems can du ma chos la 'god par mdzod// kye ma chos mchog rtogs pa bdag gi yab// kye ma sems can rnams la khon med sems// kye ma tshur spyon bdag mdun chos shod cig /kye ma tshur spyon khyod smon myur grub shog /dge slong dge 'dun de ni mgon med 'gyur// kye ma mdongs shing mi dran mya ngan bgyid// sems can snying po khyod ni myur bzhengs la// dge slong dge 'dun dbugs kyang dbyung bar mdzod// kye ma 'jig rten gsum na sgron gyur ba// kye ma tshur spyon kun tu bzang por bzhud// kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod bzhud nas ni// dge slong rnams la phan phyir khyod ston cig

/kye kye chos 'dzin yon tan rmad byung ste// a shad me tog bzhin du rnyed pa dka'// shes rab spyan ni thugs rje dri med pa// kye kye dge slong dge 'dun gzigs su gsol// tshig gi lam dang bral ba'i gzungs de yang*// kye kye dge slong dag la bstan du gsol// kye kye zla ba shar ba bzhin du 'dir// me tog zla mdzes de ring bzhengs su gsol// kye kye rgyal sras bdag la thugs brtse ba// dbugs 'byin mdzad pa bla na med// kye kye mtshon dang dbyug pas btab pa bzod// bzod pa'i stobs dang ldan zhing rab tu des// kye kye me tog zla mdzes thugs rje (44)can// rab sbyin 'dren pa khyed ni bzhengs su gsol// kye kye khyod ni bzhengs la bdag la yang*// mthong bar dka' ba'i gzungs rnams bshad du gsol// kye kye 'jig rten kun tu snang mdzad pa// shes rab kyi ni sgron me dam pa'i mchog /kye kye sems can dag gi phan don la// brtson mdzad 'dren pa thugs rje'i stobs dang ldan// kye kye me tog zla mdzes bzhengs su gsol// dpa' bo sems can dag gi don mdzad pa// kye kye sems can dag ni bye ba dang*// khrag khrig rnams kyang zhi ba'i grong du khyod// kye kye tshul khrims nor ldan blo gros che// mkhas pa bslab pa'i nor gyi shin tu phyug /kye kye tshul khrims brtul zhugs rab gnas shing*// chos kyi shing gi myu gu mngon par gda'// kye kye chos gos ngur smrig kha bsgyur 'chang*// rtag tu mngon par 'byung la dga' bar mdzad// kye kye me tog zla mdzes brtul zhugs bzang*// rab sbyin dka' thub bzang po khyod bzhengs shig /kye kye dul ba sems can ma dul 'dul// rtag par dul ba'i gnas dang rjes su ldan// kye kye dul ba rab dul rjes su bzhud// zhi ba dbang po rab zhi 'ongs nas des// kye kye sems can nyal zhing gnyid log pa// chos kyi sgra yis rtag tu sad par mdzod// kye kye sems can bye ba khrag khrig dag

/(45)sad par bgyis nas theg pa mchog la 'khod// kye kye sbyin pa yi ni spang leb la// brtson 'grus tha gus sbrel ba'i gru sbyor te// kye kye sems can rgya mtsho chen por ni// rtag tu lhung zhing sred pas ded pa rnams// kye kye stobs bcu ldan pa me tog mchog /mnyan pa gdos 'dzin mkhas pa bzhengs su gsol// kye kye shin tu sra ba'i grur yang ni// zhugs nas bdag dang de dag bsgral bar mdzod// kye kye sman pa'i dam pa brtul zhugs la// shin tu spyad phyir rig mdzad sman pa'i mchog /kye kye ye shes rnam grol pha rol phyin// dam pa'i chos kyi rtsi dag sbyin mdzad pa// kye kye nad ni rnam pa sna tshogs kyis// gzir ba'i sems can na ba rnams gzigs nas// kye kye myur du bzhengs la de dag la// chos kyi sman rnams shin tu stsal bar mdzod// kye kye ye shes sman pa'i rgyal po mchog /mtshungs med ye shes 'phags shing pha rol phyin// kye kye nad rnams shin tu gso mdzad cing*// thugs rjes sems can dag gi don kyang mdzad// kye kye na bar gyur pa'i sems can khams// 'dod chags nad kyis ma lus bcom pa rnams// des ni sems can thams cad bde ba dang*// nad rnams med cing mya ngan 'das par gyur// kye kye mkhas pa ye shes rgya chen bslabs// chos kyi (46)rnga dag shin tu brdung bar mdzod// kye kye 'jig rten dag ni the tshom gyi// 'khri shing thams cad ye shes rgya mtshos chod// kye kye legs thos chos rnams 'dzin mdzad pa// rdul bral mdo sde bye ba brgya dag kyang*// 'khor gyi nang du gdan la rab zhugs la// mi mchog mkhas pa brjod pa mdzad du gsol// me tog zla mdzes mtshan mchog brgyan pa kye// dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu tshang ba kye// dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus lus brgyan kye// srid pa'i mtsho rgal spros med tshur spyon kye// srid pa'i brtson rar tshur khrol bzhengs shig kye// ye shes mchog rig tshang pa 'dra ba kye// me tog zla ba thugs rje chen po kye// byams dang thugs rje bskyed la bzhengs shig kye// me tog zla ba khyod la gsol ba 'debs// dge slong dge 'dun khyod kyis ma dor bar// tshur gshegs dge 'dun yongs su bsdu ba mdzod// bzhengs la nags khrod der yang gshegs sam kye// me tog zla ba bsam gtan dgyes pa mchog

/mdza' dang mi mdza' mtshungs par byams shing phan// gzungs la rab tu gnas pa tshur spyon kye// ye shes sdong po mtshungs med khyod bzhengs shig /ri rab bzhin du mi g.yo brtan pa kye// sangs rgyas sangs rgyas sems can mnyam yid kye// me tog zla ba brtul zhugs rdzogs pa kye// (47)bzhengs la shing gi drung du 'tshang rgya mdzod// lha yi rna ba chos kyi mchog 'chang kye// lha yi mig mkhas ye shes rtogs pa kye// bzhengs te bdag la gzigs shig thugs rje can// grags pa mtha' yas bdag gis tshig gson kye// 'jig rten kun la phan dang don mdzad kye// me tog zla ba shin tu sbyin dgos kye// bzhengs la myur du bdag gi re rdzogs mdzod// khyod 'dir dum bu dum bur ma bzhugs shig /grong 'di'i skyes pa bud med tshogs rnams kyang*// khyod mthong thams cad shing bzhin sa la 'gyel// snying skams 'gyur ba'i mya ngan rnams kyang bgyid// thugs rje mchog gi spyan gyis de la gzigs// gang gi slad du byams pa bsgoms pa dang*// ye shes shes rab thabs kyi stobs rnams dang*// khyod kyi thugs rjes btang snyoms dga' ba yang*// de dag rdzogs mdzod bzhengs shigs me tog mdzes// lha klu lha min rdzu 'phrul chen po dang*// gnod sbyin srin po mi dang mi'am ci// snyim pa me tog bdug pas bkang nas ni// thams cad mthong bar dga' nas lhags shing 'khod// drang srong chen po'i tshig ni der rtogs te// skye dgu'i 'dod pa gnod byed gsod pa yin// yid kyi nang du 'gro ba ngan 'gro'i rgyu// de phyir 'dod pa'i spyod pa spang bar bya// dge slong (48)bdag gis bsad pa sdig gi las// shin tu ma legs mi bde byas pas na// bdag ni mi bzad dmyal ba mnar med 'gro /bdag la de yi mgon skyabs byed pa med// bdag ni rgyal po'i srid btang tshangs spyod gzhol// spos dang me tog byug pa rnams kyis ni// mchod pa dam pa rnams kyang rab tu bya// shin tu mdzes par mchod rten bdag gis bya// bu dang bu mo bud med khyim bdag dang*// blon po dang ni tshong dpon de dag dang*// grong pa dang ni rgyal rigs mang po rnams// de dag thams cad la ni ngas bsgo ba// a ka ru dang tsandan shug pa dang*// shin tu zhim pa'i spos mchog ci yod pas// myur du sgrom gyi snying po khyogs chos la// dge slong 'di ni bsreg pa'i cho ga gyis// grong khyer mi kun rgyal po'i tshig thos nas// spos mchog dag kyang thogs nas khyogs bcas te// spos rab bzang po yid du 'ong las byas// der ni dge slong de yang bcug nas su// a ka ru dang tsandan tsam pa ka

/rgya spos spri ga de bzhin po ta la// me tog dang ni phreng ba byug pa dang*// shin tu bzang dang 'bru mar dag gi bsregs// de yis rus pa'i sgrom ni byas par gyur// dge slong dag gis de yang der bsregs te// rgyal pos de yi mchod rten byas nas (49)su// 'di la ngas ni mchod pa bya zhes zer// me tog dang ni phreng ba byug pa dang*// gdugs dang ba dan rgyal mtshan thogs nas su// rgyal pos der ni sil snyan stong dag dang*// bye ba khrag khrig rnams kyang len du btsud// nyi ma gcig la rgyal po dus gsum du// dge slong de yi mchod rten de drung du// sdig pa sngon chad cung zad ci byas pa// de tshe dus gsum du yang shin tu chags// lo stong bye ba khrag ni dgu bcu lngar// nyes pa byas pa dag kyang rab bshags te// phyis kyang tshul khrims dam pa ma ral bsrungs// rnam par dag cing gtsang la dri ma med// lo stong bye ba phrag ni dgu bcu lngar// gso sbyong dag kyang de tshe rab gsol te// de ni de tshe bdag gi lus zhig nas// mnar med mi bzad par ni der lhung 'gyur// 'dod phyir snying rje med pa'i las byas pas// sdug bsngal mang po dag kyang myong bar gyur// sangs rgyas bye ba stong phrag dgu bcu lnga// de tshe bdag gis de dag ma mnyes byas// lo stong bye ba phrag ni dgu bcu lngar// de yi tshe na nga ni long bar gyur// bskal pa bye ba phrag ni drug cu gnyis// sngon chad nga yi mig kyang bcar bar 'gyur// bskal pa khrag khrig dag ni phrag stong dang*// shin tu mang bar nga yi mig phyung (50)phrogs// mgo dang rna ba dang ni rkang lag kyang*// bskal pa khrag khrig mtha' yas bcad par 'gyur// bskal pa dang ni bye ba khrag khrig tu// mi gyur pa dang skye ba gzhan du yang*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dag gis rab gtses shing*// sdug bsngal tshor ba yun ring myong bar 'gyur// sdig pa'i las rnams byas pas 'khor ba na// yun ring shin tu sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur// de phyir byang chub zhi ba su 'dod pa// srid pa gsum du sdig pa mi bya'o// rgyal po mchog gis sngon gyi las bshags kyang*// snga ma'i nyes byas rnams las de ma thar// mi bzad gzugs kyi las rnams sngar byas pas// de shi dmyal ba mi bzad mnar med song*// nga yi rna ba de bzhin rkang lag bcad// bskal pa mtha' yas mang por sna yang bcad// spyod pa spyod tshe mtshon cha dbyig thogs nas// 'debs byed nan gyis nga yi mig kyang phyung*// byang chub phyir mgo yan lag lus bcas dang*// bu dang chung ma mig dang rang gi sha// rkang lag dga' ba'i sems kyis yongs btang yang*// sngon gyi sdig pa'i las ni zad ma gyur// kun dga' de ltar bskal pa mtha' yas spyod// sangs rgyas dpal stug dpag tu med pa mthong*// byang chub spyod mchog 'di ni spyod pa na// de ni sdug bsngal 'di dag sngon (51)myong gyur// byang chub sems dpa' gzungs la gang gnas shing*// byams spyod rtag tu mi g.yo mi 'gul ba// sangs rgyas rdul bral lha yi lha mchod nas// de dag nam yang ngan song sar mi 'gro

/sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyi go bgos pa// chos rje sangs rgyas bdag 'gyur su 'dod pa// tshul khrims ma 'dres g.yo ba med par bsrungs// gzungs la rab gnas chos kyang ston par gyis// nga ni de tshe rgyal po dpa' byin yin// nga yi bu rnams phyi dus chos skyong ba// me tog zla mdzes padma'i bla ma yin// dga' byed de ni zhi ba'i rgyal bar 'gyur// 'jig rten gsum dpa' 'gro ba'i gnyen cig po// de bzhin gshegs pa rkang gnyis gtso bor gyur// skye dgu dag ni don chen mdzad nas ni// mar me bzhin du 'dren pa mya ngan 'das// bud med tshogs dang rgyal rigs mang po dang*// khyim bdag dang ni blon po stobs chen dang*// tshong dpon de bzhin grong pa mkhar gyi rgyal// thams cad stobs bcu nyon mongs med par gyur// zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo la gsungs te/ rgya cher ni mdo nyid las rtogs par bya'o// de ltar bdag nyid chen po 'di chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes su gyur pa na'ang*/ rang gi lus dang srog la ltos pa med par gzhan gyi (52)don yongs su bsgrubs shing*/ de nas sangs rgyas padma'i bla ma zhes bya bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpar gyur nas/ phyi ma'i dus dam pa'i chos yongs su skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa yin no// de rnams ni sngon byung gi rnam thar ro/// /da ltar gyi rnam thar ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ gdul bya rigs can rnams la sprul pa'i sku sna tshogs su 'char zhing*/ gsol ba btab pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus par 'byung ba/ mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i bla ma chos kyi rje rin po che sems dpa' chen po 'di snyigs ma'i dus la bab pa na/ byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'dir dge slong 'tsho byed ces bya bar gyur nas/

bstan pa rin po che rgyas par byed ces lung bstan pa de ni rje sgam po pa chen po yin no// de yang rje btsun chen po 'di'i sku skye ba 'di nyid kyi rnam thar gyi dbang du byas na/ sku 'khrungs pa'i yul ni bod yul gyi dbus/ sa cha'i ming ni gnyal gyi bod snyi/ grong spyil grong*/ yab snyi ba rgyal po// yum sho ma za tshe lcam zhes bya ba la/ sras gsum 'khrungs pa'i che ba rgya pa se re/ (53)chung shos snyi chung ba/ rje nyid bar ma ste/ sa mo lug gi lo la ngo mtshar ba'i bltas mang po dang bcas te sku 'khrungs/ mtshan dar ma grags zhes btags shing*/ mtshan snying po kun dga' zhes kyang zer/ 'jig rten pa dang sgo bstun nas mchims jo sras kyi bu mo khab tu bzhes/ gso ba rig pa dang 'jig rten gyi phan bya mtha' dag la mkhas shing*/ gzhan gyi don la brtson pa/ kun gyi yid du 'ong zhing*/ dul ba la sogs pa yon tan gyi khyad par du ma dang ldan pa las/ re zhig na jo mo mi rtag par gyur pas rkyen byas te/ de yang 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med snyam du skyo ba drag po skyes nas/ dwags po dbrongs khar dge bshes mar yul blo ldan shes rab la spre'u lo dgung lo nyi shu rtsa drug gi dus su dge bshes rmu lo'i khang par chig rdzogs mdzad mtshan yang dge slong bsod nams rin chen du gsol/ dge bshes mar yul blo ldan la pha rgyud ma rgyud la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsan cing*/ dge bshes byang chub sems dpa' la gdams ngag mang du zhus/ khong bla ma mi la'i slob ma yin gsung*/ sgom zhus pas zhi gnas kyi nyams bzang po byung*/ snang ba thams cad 'ja' tshon ltar ban bun du song*/ bde ba dang mi rtog pa'i nyams nyin mtshan ngo mi shes pa dang*/ zhag (54)bdun gyi bar la ting nge 'dzin gcig la gnas pa byung*/ na mo shod du bzhugs pa'i dus su ting nge 'dzin la ji tsam 'jog rang dbang che ba lta bu byung nas/

ji tsam 'ong bltas pas zhag bcu gsum du mi 'chor ba'i ting nge 'dzin skyes/ nyon mongs pa thams cad mgo non nas ngos mi zin pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bde bas blo phrogs nas 'dod yon lnga yid la mi rgyu ba byung*/ sbrang ston na re nga la 'dod yon 'di kho na gnod par byung*/ khyed la ji ltar byung zer/ nga la 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yid la mi rgyu ba byung*/ khyed la ji ltar byung byas pas/ nga la ni bud med la bde ba yod snyam pa la brten nas/ chags pa'i rnam rtog skye zhing 'dug zer/ khong de ltar 'dug snyam pa'i 'phro la yang ting nge 'dzin du cham cham song gsung*/ yang zhubs kyi brag tu dge bshes sgre pa'i zhal nas khyed la ting nge 'dzin bzang po yod 'dug pa/ ci tsug yod zer ba la/ ne'u thang bde mo la gom pa 'dor ba dang*/ nga'i rgyud la ting nge 'dzin bskrun pa la khyad med/ thang la bsdad nas skyil krung dang mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya bcas nas rlung nang du sim gyis song ba dang*/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba la dka' tshegs med ces gsung*/ dge bshes zangs dkar ba la yo ga dang bde mchog la sogs (55)mkhas par bslabs/ bya 'dul gnyis la gsan pa mang po yang dag pa mdzad/ gzhan yang dbang dang byin rlabs kyi sgrub thabs dang*/ snyan rgyud mang po dang*/ sgrub rgyud phyi nang mang po dang*/ rgyud kyi bshad pa mang po rnams kyang thams cad mkhyen par mdzad/ sgom ni nga rang la yod/ dbu ru byang phyogs kyi bka' gdams pa rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'gros shig blta snyam du dgongs nas/ 'gong ston bya ba zhig yod pa la/ bla ma'i zhal nas sgom ni nged rang la yod/ bka' gdams bya ba spyod pa la mkhas pa yin zer/ spyod tshul slob tu 'dod gsungs nas dbu rur byon/ dge bshes snyug rum pa zla ba bdun bsten/ lam rim bskyangs/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems rnam par dag pa thugs la 'khrungs/

dus de nas brtsams te byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang 'bral ma myong gsung*/ de nas lcags ri gong khar byon/ dge bshes lcags ri ba la jo bo'i gdams ngag ma lus pa mthar phyin par gsan cing zla ba bdun bsten/ man ngag mang po yang gnang*/ mgon po gri gug ma zhus pas de'i nub mo rang la zhal gzigs/ de nas dge bshes rgya yon bdag gi snyan pa thos pas shin tu spro bar byung ste spyan sngar phyin/ jo bo rje'i gdams ngag mtha' dag gsan/ (56)lam rim gtso bor byas nas bsgoms pas/ sngar gyi bde gsal de chung du song*/ skyo shas dang yid 'byung ba kho na shas cher byung*/ khong gi zhal nas nga la jo bo'i gdams ngag dge bshes ston pas kyang bar du ma chod pa/ sangs rgyas lag pas 'chos pa 'dra ba yod pa khyod la bstan gyis gsungs nas/ gdams ngag thams cad btab/ dmigs pa'i 'gro ldog zad pa med pa gsungs/ lo gsum bsten no// der chos thams cad kyi nang nas nyams su len pa kho na gtso che bar gsungs 'dug pas/ da ni bsgrub pa zhig bya dgos snyam du dgongs te/ khong rang gis yab mes kyis brtsigs pa'i ser kha bya ba'i gtsug lag khang zhig yod pa der brang khang zhig brtsigs/ pha zhing la yon bdag byas nas bsgoms pas/ sngar gyi ting nge 'dzin sor chud/ gnyid thun chung re las mi 'byung ste/ rmi lam du yang gser 'od dam pa dang*/ mdo sde sa bcu pa nas bshad pa'i sa bcu thob pa'i snga ltas kyi rmi lam de kho na rmis te/ de yang 'di ltar/ bag chags sbyong ba'i snga ltas su/ rtag tu gcer bu phyung ba dang*// khrus chen rtag tu byed pa dang*// dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag pa dang*// mtsho chu dag las brgal ba dang*// char gyi rgyun gyi khru ba dang*// me dpung chen pos bsregs pa (57)dang*// shin tu mthon po'i rtse dag la// rlung gis g.yengs shing 'khor ba dag /sgrib pa dag pa'i snga ltas so// g.yul chen 'gyed las slar ldog dang*// nad las thar ste sos pa dang*// brtson ra dag las thar pa dang*// gshed ma'i lag nas shor ba dang*// gcan gzan kha nas thar pa dang*// dug nad dag las sos pa dang*// bcings pa dag las grol ba ni// 'jigs dang bral ba'i snga ltas yin// sa rnams thob pa'i snga ltas kyang*// khri rkang dag la 'dzeg pa dang*// phal pa'i skas la 'dzeg pa dang*// ljon shing dag la 'dzeg pa dang*// gyen la shin tu 'dzeg pa dang*// ri bo'i rtse la 'gro ba dang*// rin chen skas la 'dzeg pa dang*// mchod rten dag la 'dzeg pa dang*// nam mkha'i skas la 'dzeg pa dang*// de ni don gyi snga ltas yin// sa rnams non pa'i snga ltas kyang*// khri mtho steng na 'dug pa dang*// glang po che la zhon pa dang*// seng ge dag la zhon pa dang*// khyung chen lding la zhon pa dang*// mchod rten rtse la phyin pa dang*// ri rab rtse la 'dug pa dang*// nam mkha'i dbyings na 'dug pa dang*// lus la srin bu med pa dang*// nyi ma'i dkyil na 'dug pa dang*// rnal 'byor sa la gnas pa'i rtags// sangs rgyas sras kyi snga ltas ni// (58)rgyal ba'i bka' la btags pa dang*// bka'i dpang por bskos pa dang*// gnas la dbang ni byed pa dang*// g.yul chen dag las rgyal ba dang*// mi yi dbang por gyur pa dang*// mgo la me tog skyes pa'o// chos la dbang thob snga ltas kyang*// glegs bam bzang po rnyed pa dang*// de ni bris pa mang po dang*// de dag la ni spyad pa dang*// gzhan la 'chad cing ston pa dang*// de nyid gtan la 'bebs pa dang*// me tog dag la lta ba dang*// shel gyi bum gang 'thung ba dang*// rin chen nor bu thu ba dang*// 'khor lo lag tu thogs pa dang*// nyi zla lag pas bzung ba dang*// ri rab klad la bskor ba dang*// bden pa mthong ba'i snga ltas kyang*// sngon ma mthong ba'i yul mthong dang*// stong gsum rgya chen mthong ba dang*// gling grangs gzhan du phyin pa dang*// nam mkha' rgya chen mthong ba dang*// rgya mtsho'i gting du phyin pa dang*// lag na sgron me thogs pa dang*// nyi ma'i snying po lta ba'o// lung chen thob pa'i snga ltas ni// rol mo'i dgra rnams thos pa dang*// 'brug gi sgra ni sgrog pa dang*// seng ge'i nga ro sgrog pa dang*// chos kyi sgra yi gtam thos dang*// gzugs brnyan zhal ni 'dzum pa dang*// sangs rgyas gsung thos sku mi mthong*// (59)lha mo'i klu dbyangs sgrog pa dang*// gzhal yas dag las sgra byung dang*// grogs po grogs po zhes brjod cing*// chos kyi dung ni sgrog pa'o// zhes pa la sogs pa rmis ltas ngo mtshar dpag tu med pa rmis shing*/

de'i dus su lus la shig dang srin bu yang ye med/ zhag lnga lnga tsam du gsol zas ma gsol yang ltogs pa'i 'dun pa med/ lus rtag tu bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa yang byung gsungs/ de nas nam zla dpyid kyi dus su/ mtshams nas phyung ste lcags ri'i lho phyogs su skyo bsang la byon tsa na/ sprang po rgad po gsum shig bsad sdug gtam mang po byed cing 'dug /rje btsun thugs rgyud ni ting nge 'dzin du song*/ phyag gis yi dwags la chu sbyin byed cing yod tsa na/ sprang po gcig na re/ 'o skol gsum 'dra ba'i bsod nams chung ba yong ba/ 'tshol ma dgos par zan chen po re dang*/ lo ma'i tshod ma phor re bza' btung bya rgyu yod na ci lto zer/ gcig na re/ yid smon de 'dra la byed dam/ mnga' bdag rtsen sde 'dra ba yin na dga' mod zer/ gcig na re/ rtsen sde la yang 'chi ba 'ong*/ de byung tsa na gang gis kyang phan pa med/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pa 'dra ba'i grub thob/ lus la gos mi dgos/ zas 'tsho ba med na mkha' 'gro mas bdud rtsi 'dren/ (60)seng ge la zhon cing nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ skye 'chi'i 'jigs pa med pa de yin na dga' mod zer/ gtam de gsan pa tsam gyis bla ma rin po che'i lus la ba spu zing byed pa zhig byung*/ mig nas mchi ma 'khrug pa'i dad pa tshad med pa zhig skyes te/ sngar de ma yin pa'i sems zhig rgyud la skyes nas 'dug /yun ring po zhig 'gro yang ma shes/ de nas phyis brang khang du phyin nas/ dge sbyor gyi gtso bo yan lag bdun pa yin pas byas tsa na 'phro gtor zhing gtor zhing song*/ da ci byung ba yin nam dgongs nas mal du zhugs te bsgoms pas/ khang pa la sogs pa'i phyi rol gyi yul snang thams cad med par stong phyam gyis song nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad yid kyi yul du byung ba'am/ sems can thams cad kyi sems shes pa snyam byed/ khams dang dbang po'i bye brag rnams kyang shes pa snyam byed pa zhig byung*/

der dgongs thun thon nas/ sprang po kun gar snang bltas pas 'gron khang na 'dug pa la dri ba mdzad/ da cis khyod zer ba'i grub thob de gang na yod pa yin gsungs pas/ gcig na re/ de mang yul gung thang bya ba zhig na yod pa/ mi la ras pa bya ba yin zer/ de'i bla ma gong ma rnams ji skad bya ba yin dris pas/ de'i bla ma mar pa lo tsā bya ba yin zer/ de'i bla ma nā ro paṇa (61)chen bya ba yin zer/ chos ci gsung byas pas/ chos ni nā ro'i chos drug zer te dgyes rdor gyi gdams ngag yin par 'dug /nged kyis zhal ma mthong*/ mi thams cad 'gro bzhin 'dug pa la/ phal cher gyis mi rnyed/ la las shel gyi mchod rten du mthong*/ la las shākya thub par mthong*/ sprul pa sna tshogs su ston nus par 'dug ste/ brin dang snye nam gyi ri la gtso cher bzhugs yod par 'dug zer/ 'o na nga der 'gro na khyod kyis grogs byed dam gsungs pas/ khyod gzhon nu zhig 'dug pas nga khyod kyi rjes mi sleb/ khyod rang song dang la stod rang nas shes te 'ong*/ khong grags pa can yin zer/ de nas nang du phyin nas/ zan chen po bcos lo ma'i tshod ma byas nas sprang po rnams mgu bar byas/ nangs par rtsad bcad pas gar song cha med de/ bla ma la mjal bar bskul ba'i sprang po rang rgyud pa min par thag chod do// sngar yang bla ma byang chub sems dpa' sogs la rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar thos shing*/ dad pa dpag tu med pa yod pa la/ khyad par du sprul pa'i skye bo de dag gis bskul ba dang*/ mi bzod pa'i dad pa skyes te 'gro bar blo thag bcad nas/ de'i nub mo dkon mchog la mchod pa byas/ gsol ba btab nas nyal ba'i rmi lam na/ rag dung ring (62)po zhig bus pas skad kyis 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad du thos pa zhig rmis te/ deng sang rag dung 'di las sgra che ba med zer ba rmis/ yang nam mkha' rten med la rnga bo che yang dag pa zhig btags nas 'dug pa/

brdungs pas sgra chen po tshad med pa byung*/ sgra de la ri dwags mang pos nyan cing 'dug /mi mang po dpag tu med pa 'dug pa la mon mo lta bu'i bud med cig na re/ mi 'di rnams la rnga 'di brdungs/ ri dwags 'di tsho la 'di byin zer nas 'o ma thod phor gang byin/ 'dis ri dwags 'di tshor mi khyab byas pas/ khyod rang 'thungs dang ri dwags 'di rnams las 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyang khyab nas yong*/ nga ni nyi ma nub phyogs su 'gro zer nas song ba rmis/ da lta snod dang mi ldan pa rnams lam rim gyis bskyangs te/ nga la nyan pa'i mi rnams yin par 'dug /bka' gdams kyi bla ma de rnams bka' drin che bar 'dug gsungs/ ri dwags de rnams nga'i ri khrod 'dzin pa'i sgom chen rnams yin par 'dug ste/ bla ma mi la'i gdams ngag thabs lam dang phyag rgya chen pos bskyangs/ sngon gyi rmi lam gyi ltas de ltar byung gsungs/ der zhing bzang po zhig yod pa gser zho bzhi dang*/ ja zi phol zho gang la btsongs nas dge bshes lcags ri ba la zhur byon pas/ (63)khyod gsang sngags 'tshol ba yin te 'ong*/ de nas nged rang la yod gsungs nas/ lan gsum du zhus kyang 'gror ma gnang*/ phyi ma 'o na bdag dge bshes gzhan zhig gi rtsar 'gro bar zhu zhus pas/ 'o na ci bde gyis gsungs/ dge bshes yon bdag la zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ khyed rnal 'byor pa de'i spyan sngar song zhig /lo gcig las ma 'gor bar sleb pa gyis/ rnal 'byor pa de grub thob cig yin nges su yod par 'dug /chos thams cad dris kyang dris/ gdams ngag ma lus pa zhus la chos kyi khyos ma yang khyer la shog gsungs nas/ lam rgyags kyi gser yang gnang*/ spyan snga'i zhal nas khyod rnal 'byor pa khyi thul can gyi rtsar ma 'gro /cis kyang 'gro na nged kyi rtags ma dor bar shog cig /lar ser kha la phan na khyi tshil na yang khyi tshil bya ba yin/

zangs nged kyis brdungs pas zangs skad mis 'don pa zhig 'ong bar 'dug ste thabs med gsungs/ dge bshes snyug rum pa'i zhal nas/ khyod kyis nga rgas khar ma bor bar shog cig gsungs so// bla ma rnams kyi bka' gnang thob pas shin tu dga' nas/ rje btsun gyi spyan sngar 'gro bar chas pa'i dus su/ nub gcig gi rmi lam na/ mi dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin can shin tu mdzes pa zhig gis/ rab tu dgyes pa mdzad (64)de chos 'di la gyis gsungs nas/ lta ba'i man ngag rdo rje'i tshig bzhi zhes bya ba gsungs/ phyis bla ma'i gsung dang khyad ma byung ste/ de thugs rje chen po'i rnam 'phrul yin par 'dug gsungs/ de nas grogs po 'gong ston nged gnyis 'gro bar chas nas/ bla ma'i spyan sngar 'gro ba la lam ring thung gi brtag pa mdzad pas/ lha rje la ring po yod pa'i ltas byung*/ 'gong ston la thung ba'i ltas byung*/ de nas yar byon pas tshong 'dus mgur mor bslebs tsa na/ 'gong ston na bas lus/ bla ma tshong pa dang 'grogs nas bong 'gros pa'i zla ba phyed kyis bcad nas byon te/ nyi ma phyed kyis ma bslebs pa'i sar/ mgo yom bya ba'i snyun gzhi drag po zhig gis de'u grongs byas/ nyin zhag bdun lus pa la/ bla ma rje btsun bzhugs pa'i gangs la lta yin gsol ba btab pas/ snyung ba las grol bar gyur te/ phyin pa'i lam khar rnal 'byor pa zhig bsu ba la byung*/ khres po bdag la stsol zer te/ gus par byas nas 'grogs shing phyin tsa na/ kho na re/ khyed lta re dga' na/ bla ma rin po ches nyid la chos zab mo zhig ston par yod do// de khyed kyis nga la cis kyang gsung bar zhu zer/ thugs dgongs la gtsang pa 'di la yang chung zhad cig gda'/ khong rang sngar nas bla ma'i drung du (65)bsdad bsdad pa/ nga de ring 'ong ba la chos zhu ba snyam nas/ khyed rang gis chos tshang bar zhus pa min nam/ bla ma'i drung du yun ji tsam bsdad gsungs pas/

mjal nas lo bcu tsam song*/ chos mang du zhus/ 'on kyang de min pa zhig yod pa yin/ sngar tsa na bla ma'i zhal nas/ ras chung pa 'di kho rang gi 'bras bu phyin ci ma log pa thob kyang*/ 'gro ba la phan chen po mi thogs/ da sdod dbus pa ston pa zhig gis 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs pa 'ong ba yin gsungs nas lung bstan yod pa yin zer/ de nas stong sde bkra shis sgang du byon pas bud med cig thags 'thag cing 'dug pa la dri ba mdzad de/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pa bya ba/ gzhan rgyud gyi bsam pa mkhyen cing*/ sprul pa sna tshogs ston pa zhig bzhugs zer ba de gang na bzhugs pa yin gsungs pas/ de rgyus yod pa'i nya ma gcig bstan no zer nas/ bud med rgan mo ras gos kyi steng na ske rags rgya ma lhod de bcings pa zhig 'dug pa de la dris zer ba la/ de la dris pas rgan mo de na re/ do nub bslebs pa med/ nga'i khang pa'i steng du bzhugs zer nas steng khang zhig tu gdan drangs bsnyen bkur byas nas/ des kha sang rje btsun chen po'i spyan sngar phyin pa la/ dbus nas bka' gdams kyi (66)ston pa zhig dang phrad du 'ong bas de dang nga phrad pa'i mjal sna sus byas de la ngan song gi 'jigs pa med ces gsungs pas/ nga'i bu mo sgom ma zhig rje btsun gyi drung du yod pas de la mjal sna 'tshol ba yin zer/ nangs par snga mo nas byon te thugs dgongs la/ nga 'ong ba mkhyen cing lung bstan gsung lugs des/ kho bo yang snod ldan zhig yin par 'dug /gdams ngag la dka' tshegs mi 'ong snyam pa'i nga rgyal zhig skyes pa de bla mas mkhyen/ zla ba phyed kyi bar du mjal sa ma byung*/ se ban ras pas phru ba zhig dang shing phon gcig byin te/ brag 'og cig tu bzhugs su bcug /dbus pa ston pa khyod 'ongs pa bla mas mkhyen/ gdams ngag kyang gnang bar 'dug gis da ngang ma thung bar gsol ba 'debs kyin sdod cig zer/

de nas zla ba phyed song ba dang*/ bla ma dang mjal ba la shog zer nas phyin pas/ rje btsun pha bong chen po zhig gi steng na bzhugs 'dug pa dang mjal te/ phyag btsal nas gser zho bzhi dang ja zho gang ba phyag tu phul bas/ se ban ras pa na re/ sku mdun du zhog /bla ma chen po'i drung du nor phul ba dang*/ ri dwags kyi mdun du nor spungs pa la khyad med/ gang yang phyag tu mi bzhes pa yin zer/ rje btsun chen po'i zhal nas/ gser (67)dang mi rgan lo mi mthun/ ja la skol ba'i thab chas med/ khyed rang sgrub pa byed pa'i rgyags gyis gsungs/ kho bo thag ring po nas mchis pas thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus pas/ khyod de tsam la thag ring rgyu med/ nga'i rtsar khams dang rgya gar nas kyang yong mkhan yod/ khyod kyi ming ci yin gsungs/ bsod nams rin chen bya ba lags zhus pas/ bsod nams bsod nams bsod nams tshogs chen bsags las byung*// 'gro ba kun gyi rin po che// bya ba lan gsum gsungs/ chang ka pā la gang gi gsol 'phro 'dug pa gnang nas 'di thungs gsungs pa la/ kho rten dge slong yin pa dang*/ 'khor mang po 'dug pas cung zad len ma nus pa la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas rnam rtog ma mang bar 'di thungs gsungs pas/ bla mas mkhyen bsams nas lhag ma ma lus par gsol bas brgyud pa zin cing gdams ngag ma lus pa'i snod du 'gyur bar mkhyen no// de nas ras chung pa dang se ban gnyis 'dir shog /'o skol pha ston pa la glu zhig bya'o gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// shar seng ge dkar mo'i 'o ma de// ro bcud dang ldan pa cha mchis kyang*// lha dbang brgya byin khong gis gsol nas 'ong*// lho rgya stag khra (68)bo'i sbar rtsal de// rtsal che'o skad par cha mchis kyang*// dpal ḍoṃ bhi pa yis chibs te 'ong*// byang lto dkar nya yi mkhris pa de// ro kha'o skad par cha mchis kyang*// klu gtsug na nor bus gsol te 'ong*// steng dga' ldan lha yi pho brang de// ngo mtshar ro skad par cha mchis kyang*// 'phags pa thogs med khong gis gzigs nas 'ong*// rje nā ro'i thabs lam zab mo de// lam bgrod thag nye bar cha mchis kyang*// pha mar pa lo tsā gshegs te 'ong*// rje mar pa'i snyan brgyud zab mo de// nyams rtogs pa skye bar cha mchis kyang*// nga rnal 'byor mi las bsgoms te 'ong*// nga mi la'i nyams myong tshig gsum po// don gnad du zab par cha mchis kyang*/

bu ston pa khyod byung bas 'chad pa yin// lar gser dang mi rgan blo mi mthun// ja la skol ba'i thab chas med// nga zas nor spangs nas ring zhig 'das// bu snying nas dam chos bya snyam na// tshe 'di la ma dga' phyi ma soms// lam sgrub pa'i dka' ba dang du longs// khyed bka' brgyud gdan sa 'dzin 'dod na// tshig la ma dga' don la ltos// khyed dge slong gi thugs la de ltar zhog /ces gsungs nas/ de la bu ston pa khyod kyi sna len byed pa yin no gsungs/ de nas pha bong (69)'og der za shing dang*/ ri sho ma bsdus nas phyed spyil zhig byas/ yon bdag dkon 'bar dang 'bar seng gnyis la gser zho re btsongs nas rgyags byas te/ khrid zhus pas bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyod la dbang skur gyi bka' yod dam gsung*/ dge bshes mar yul ba blo ldan shes rab la gsang 'dus kyi dbang rdzogs par zhus/ dgyes rdor gyi gnyis/ bdag med ma'i gsum/ jo bo rje'i lugs kyi bde mchog lu hi pa'i bka'/ phag mo rin chen rgyan drug ma'i byin rlabs sogs/ gzhan yang bla ma mang po la dbang bskur dang*/ byin rlabs rig gtad kyi cho ga mang du thob lags/ nga la zhag bcu gsum tsam du mi 'chor ba'i ting nge 'dzin bzang po yang yod lags zhus pas/ ha ha gsungs nas gad mo chen po zhig mdzad de/ legs par 'dug ste legs par bskyangs kyang 'bras bu gzugs med lha/ gsungs nas bye ma btsir bas mar khu mi 'ong*/ yungs kar btsir bas mar khu yong ba yin/ nga'i gtum mo a thung gis srog rtsol sgoms dang*/ sang da tshod sems kyi ngo bo mthong nas 'ong gis/ lar bod kyi snying du 'dre zhugs nas a ti shar gsang sngags 'chad du ma bcug pas mi mang po 'phung gsung pa la/ bka' gdams pa la yang gsang sngags kyi gdams ngag mang po (70)yod lags zhus pas/ de tsho gsang sngags tsam yin te man ngag mi 'grub/ thabs kyang pa res rdzogs rim snod bcud sdus pa re bshad 'dug ste/
