de rtog dpyod kyi ting nge 'dzin bya ba yin/ lam rim gyi bdag med rang bsgom pa don spyi rkyang pa yin/ kha kha rog par kho bo'i thabs lam sgoms gsung*/ de'i dus su rmi lam rmis pa zhus pas/ mdang sum gnyid kyi rmi lam na// ya gi spyi bo'i gtsug rum du// g.yu 'brug sngon mo 'khyil ba rmis// g.yu yi na bun 'thibs pa rmis// dung gi khu 'phang babs pa rmis// g.yas su khyung zhig lding ba rmis// g.yon du rgod cig 'khor ba rmis// dpral bar nyi zla shar ba rmis// gal ta phrag la bkal ba rmis// glang 'khar lag tu bzung ba rmis// rgyab tu dgra lnga bsad pa rmis// mdun du chu mig rdol ba rmis// 'og tu seng ge zhon pa rmis// 'di don gang lags gsung bar zhu// zhes zhus pas/ lan gsungs pa/ e ma ho/ skal ldan las 'phro can// rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// skyes bu las dang skal bar ldan// ya gi spyi bos gtsug rum na// g.yu 'brug sngon mo 'khyil ba de// bla ma rje btsun bstan pa yin// g.yu yi na bun 'thibs pa de// sangs rgyas zhing du slebs pa yin// dung gi khu 'phang 'bab pa (71)de// nyon mongs tha ba bdas pa yin// g.yas su khyung cig lding pa de// dpa' bo dpa' mo 'khor ba yin// g.yon na rgod cig 'khor ba de// rig 'dzin pho mo 'khor ba yin// dpral bar nyi zla shar ba de// 'phags pa'i spyan gyis gzigs pa yin// gal ta 'phrag la bkal ba de// thabs shes zung du 'brel ba yin// glang 'khar lag tu bzung ba de// bag chags dbyug pas 'ded pa yin// rgyab tu dgra lnga bsad pa de// dug lnga dug gsum bsad pa yin// mdun du chu mig rdol ba de// rnal 'byor bsod nams skyes pa yin// 'og tu seng ge zhon pa de// bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa yin// zhes gsungs/ dus phyis chos rje dwags po ba'i zhal nas bla ma rje btsun ni/ sngon la shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyangs pas nyon mongs pa rang dag la 'gro gsung*/

bka' gdams kyi bla ma rnams ni nyon mongs pa ma spangs par sangs mi rgya gsung ste/ gnyis ka gsung ba bden par 'dug gsung*/ de nas bla ma rje btsun gyi zhal nas nged rang dpon slob bal yul la 'gro'o gsung*/ de dus ras chung pa dang*/ khyi ra ras pa dang*/ bsgom stag /jo dor se ban/ skong 'gyur/ me sgom rnams phyag phyir 'dug pa la/ la la dag bal yul la phyin na tshad pa (72)'ong zer zhing sdug bsngal byed 'dug /bla ma'i thugs dgongs la nga rang kun tshad pas shi na'ang shi 'gro ba yin dgongs pa byung*/ brin pa byin gyi bla ma 'byon tsa na phyag rten la/ gser zho gsum dang 'bras mar chang mang po phul nas bzhugs zhus kyang ma gnang bar byon te/ rang rang la dgos nas gnang ngo*// de'i nub brag rtsa zhig tu bzhugs tsa na/ bud med ras gos nag po gyon pa/ bong thung zhing ngams nag pa/ mig rtsa dmar ba zhig gis bla ma chen po'i zhal la 'bur tshugs su bltas nas khyod 'gro ba gar 'gro /stong mkhan rang su yin zer/ de'i nub nas thugs 'gyur te ma gshegs so// bud med mkha' 'gro mar 'dug bya ba yang gsungs so// de nas dbyar stod mtshe lung gi brag la bzhugs/ dbyar smad sman lung chu bar du bzhugs nas chos zhus pa la/ bla ma rje btsun gyi zhal nas sngar gyi dbang bskur rnams kyis go mi chod pa min te/ 'on kyang rten 'brel yin pas nga rang gi lugs su byin rlabs zhig bya dgos gsungs nas/ sin dhu ra'i maṇḍal la brten nas/ snyan brgyud kyi byin rlabs dang dbang bskur mdzad do// de nub bla ma'i spyan sngar nyal la gsung gleng kho thag chod pa zhig byed dgos snyam nas/ bla ma rje btsun rin po che tshogs gsog pa'i stobs gang che ba (73)lags/ bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgya la zhus pas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa bas/ bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod pa bsod nams che zer ba de bden nam zhus pas/

de de ka ltar yin gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi la sogs pa nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun mchod pas// slob dpon ba spu'i khung bu mchog /ces gsungs pas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la/ rin po che'i phung po ri rab tsam spungs te bskal pa dpag tu med par phul ba bas/ bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod pa bsod nams che ba yin gsungs/ 'o na de bas zab pa'i tshogs gsog thabs yod dam zhus pas/ gcig yod gsung*/ de bdag la gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ bla mas bstan pa'i gdams ngag chud ma zos par bsgoms na de rang zab par gda' gsung*/ rje btsun rin po che lags/ bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen snyug rum pa la tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas pa 'di srid dam zhus pas/ tshe 'di la ltos pa ba spu'i rtse mo tsam yang med pa zhig dgos gsung*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen yar lungs pa la zhus pas/ gsung de nges pa can min/ dgongs pa can yin/ sman ri lu grub pa/ tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa/ skye ba bdun pa yin pa/ yi dam lha'i zhal mthong (74)ba/ mkha' spyod du 'gro nus pa zhig dgos pa yin gsung bas// de ltar lags sam zhus pas/ gsung de dgongs pa can min nges pa can yin/ tshe 'di la ltos pa med pa zhig gis bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig la/ slob ma snod dang ldan pa zhig gis/ gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang rdzogs par zhus pas/ bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams ngag bar ma chad par bsgoms na/ rab tshe 'di la sangs rgyas/ 'bring 'chi kha dang bar dor 'grub/ tha ma'ang skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun la 'grub/ de la ma grub na dam tshig gi sel zhugs pa yin pas/ re shig ngan gror song dogs yod/ lar lha rje ston pa khyod lta ba kha tsho la skur ba'i mi dang blo ma bstun/ de'i ngag la ma nyan/ sgom pa nyams su len pa'i mi dang blo bstun/ de'i ngag la nyon/ rjes su 'brang dgos pa yin/ gros phugs thams cad tshe 'di blos btang ba'i skyes bu dam pa rnams la bya dgos/

tshe 'dis mig khrid pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig gis chos brgyad slob tu 'ong ba yin/ spyir stong nyid la shor sa bzhi yod pa yin/ stong nyid rgyas 'debs (75)su shor ba dang*/ shes bya'i gshis la shor ba dang*/ stong nyid gnyen por shor ba dang*/ chags par shor ba dang bzhi yin te/ stong nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba bya ba 'di ltar/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa blo yul du gyur pa'i chos thams cad stong par bsgom pa yin zer ba yod/ stong nyid shes bya'i gshis la shor ba bya ba 'di ltar/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid yin mod zer ba yod/ stong nyid gnyen por shor ba bya ba nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gang skyes la bltas pas de dag stong pa nyid yin zer ba yod/ stong nyid chags par shor ba bya ba/ nga la bsgom rgyu med cing sgom thams cad stong nyid yin mod zer ba yod/ de thams cad lam yang dag pa ma yin/ 'on kyang las dang po pa la blo'i bden zhen ldog pa la phan rung tsam yin/ lar sems kyi gzhi rtsa ma chod na/ bde gsal mi rtog gsum gyi nyams kyang srid pa gsum las ma 'das rtsa ba ma chod pa'i nyams bya ba yin/ 'o na lam yang dag pa gang yin na/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig gis slob ma snod dang ldan pa zhig la ngo sprad de khrid pas/ de yang gnyug ma'i gshis sems can thams cad la gnas/ sangs rgyas la chos sku'i snang bar gsal/ rnal 'byor pa la thabs dpag tu med pas mtshon te ngo sprad nas bsgoms pas/ lta ba shugs la rtogs/ nyon mongs pa ngang gis 'gag /rnam rtog rang sar grol/ ye shes mngon du gyur/ gnas lugs nyams (76)su myong ba ste/ ngag tu smrar ma btub/ brjod kyang zur las mtshon mi nus/ dper na gzhon nu ma yi bde ba'am/ lkug pa'i rmi lam bzhin gzhi sems can kun la yod kyang ngo ma shes/ des na rgyud ldan gyi bla ma bsten pa gal che bar gda'/ gnyug ma'i shes pa'am tha mal gyi shes pa ste/

phu gar yang ma gtad/ go gar yang ma 'gags/ dpe gang gis kyang mtshon par mi nus/ brjod pa gang gis kyang thog tu mi phebs/ tha snyad gang gis kyang mi rig /des na bcas bcos mi bya rang ga ma bcos pa'i ngang la lhod glod la zhog mdzod gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// lta ba yin par nges kyi rang gi sems la ltos// lta ba rang gi sems las gzhan du btsal ba na// gyad kyi nor tshol 'dra'o ang ge ston pa ba// sgom pa yin par nges kyi bying rgod skyon ma bsal// sgom pa bying rgod thor rmugs skyon bsal na// nyin bar mar me 'degs pa 'dra'o ang ge ston pa ba// spyod pa yin par nges kyi blang dor res ma byed// spyod pa blang dor re dwogs res byed na// sbrang ma rgyar chud 'dra'o ang ge ston pa ba// dam tshig yin par nges kyi lta ba'i gdeng la zhog /lung med dam tshig logs nas btsal ba na// chu mgo gyen la (77)log pa 'dra'o ang ge ston pa ba// 'bras bu yin par nges kyi rang gi sems la ltos// thob med 'bras bu gzhan nas thob 'dod btsal ba na// sbal pa gnam mchong 'dra'o ang ge ston pa ba// bla ma yin par nges kyi rang gi sems la dris// sems las gzhan pa'i bla ma logs su btsal ba na// de yis rang sems spangs pa 'dra'o ang ge ston pa ba// de na snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kun// rang gi sems su 'dus nas gda'o ang ge ston pa ba// zhes gsungs so// de'i tshe je 'jigs je 'jigs la song ste/ sku'i gzi brjid la ma bzod par bzhugs gdan khyer nas ma tshang du byon te/ phyag mang po btsal nas gzims so// de'i dus su nub gcig thugs dgongs btang bas/ bla ma rin po che 'di lta bu dang mjal dus phyag phyir yun ring bsdad de gdams ngag thams cad kyi rtsad chod pa zhig byas nas/ nges par sgrub pa mthar thon pa zhig byed dgos pa la/ nga'i rgyags 'di nyung nas 'dug pas/ gal te yul 'dir mi gces pa 'dra na na/

de bcos la yon drag pa zhig blangs nas/ 'tsho ba dka' ba med par bsdad dgos snyam pa la/ de'i nang bar se ban ston pa 'bod du btang byung ste/ dbus pa ston pa khyod la rje btsun gyi spyan sngar shog (78)gsung zer ba la/ rje btsun gyi spyan sngar phyin nas phyag 'tshal zhing yod pa'i tshe/ rje btsun zhal 'dzum mdzad nas dbus pa ston pa khyod chos gsha' ma zhig byed bsam na/ yon tan 'tshong ba dang dge sbyor byed pa rgyab snol yin/ ston brin snye nam gnyis la bsod snyoms gyis/ nub mo grong gseb tu ma sdod par spro bde phug du snyogs gsung*/ der rje btsun bden dgongs nas/ bsod snyoms mdzad de gtum mo'i khrid zhus nas bsgoms pas/ khyod dge sbyor la brtson rab 'dug pas ras thub tu rung ba yin gsungs nas/ gtum mo shing bshags la me sbar ba lta bu'i gdams ngag gnang*/ nub dang po la lung pa'i mdor ras gos rkyang gcig gon te bsgoms pas bde drod rang 'bar la song bas/ nam langs nas gnyid du song bas lus rdo ba ltar song nas 'dug /de nas zhag bdun bsgoms pa'i tshe bde drod rang 'bar la song*/ zhag bdun gyi nangs par rgyal ba rigs lnga'i zhal mthong*/ bla ma la zhus pas mig rtsir nas bltas pas zla ba gnyis su mthong ba dang 'dra/ 'byung ba lnga'i rlung zin pa yin te/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min gsung*/ yon tan min gsung yang shugs kyis spro ba skyed nas bsgoms pas/ zla ba gsum lon pa'i tho rangs kha cig /stong gsum (79)gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir 'khor lor skor ba ltar 'khor zhing 'dug pas steng skyugs byas/ yun ring po brgyal te 'gyel nas 'dug /dran pa rnyed pa dang bla ma la zhus pas ro rkyang gnyis kyi rlung dhū tir tshud pa yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min sgoms gsung*/ yang nyin gcig snga dro mdun gyi nam mkha' la thugs rje chen po tham 'gag nam 'gag tu 'dug pa la/

dbu'i steng na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re 'dug pa mthong*/ bla ma la zhus pas spyi gtsug bde chen gyi 'khor lor khams dwangs ma'i thig le 'phel ba bya ba yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min sgoms gsung*/ yang dgongs mo nas srod cig gi bar la dmyal khams thams cad dang*/ khyad par dmyal ba thig nag gsal bar mthong bas rkyen byas te snying 'tshangs te/ snying rlung drag po byung*/ bla ma la zhus pas/ sgom thag thungs pas rtsa bcings pa yin/ cung zad ring du thong gyen rgyu'i rlung zin pa yin te skyon dang yon tan gang yang min sgoms gsung*/ yang nyin gcig 'dod lha rigs drug gi lha rnams gsal por mthong ba la/ gong ma gong mas 'og ma 'og ma la bdud rtsi'i char phab ste thams cad ngoms shing tshim 'dug pa la/ bdag gi ma skom pas nyam thag pa zhig mthong (80)nas bla ma la zhus pas lha rnams bdud rtsi'i char gyis tshim pa de/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo ro rkyang gnyis kyi thig le 'phel ba yin/ ma skom pa ni dhū ti'i mar sna kha ma phye ba yin pas lus kyi 'phrul 'khor 'di tsho gyis dang gsungs nas 'phrul 'khor btsan thabs kyi rdo rtsog gnang nas zla ba gcig byas pas lus 'phar ba dang*/ 'dar ba dang*/ sprugs pa dang*/ rgod 'dod pa rgyun chad med pa dang*/ rang dbang med par bkur 'debs 'dod pa byung ste/ 'dre gdon yin nam snyam nas bla ma la zhus pas/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lor thig les gang ba yin/ 'phrul 'khor 'phro ma bcad par 'bad nas bsgoms/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min gsung*/ de nas lus dga' bde'i ros gang nas kha zas cher mi dgos pa byung gsung*/ yang nyin gcig nam mkha' la nyi zla chen po gnyis gza'i zin nas 'dug pa la/ gza' de rta rnga phra mo tsam du 'dug par mthong*/ bla ma la zhus pas dhū tir ro rkyang gnyis kyi rlung tshud pa yin te skyon dang yon tan gang yang min/ lar pho rgod rab tu 'dug

/da ni da ni bya ba gsum gsungs/ de nas drag tu bsgoms pas zla ba gcig na dgyes pa rdo rje dmar po'i dkyil 'khor zhig mthong*/ bla ma da ni da ni gsungs pa de 'di yin par 'dug (81)snyam nas zhus pas/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lor ma las thob pa'i rakta brtan pa bya ba yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min shugs phyung las bsgoms mdzod gsungs/ yang 'bad nas bsgoms pas nyin gcig bde mchog lu hi pa keng rus kyi dkyil 'khor zhig mthong*/ bla ma la zhus pas/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor thig les gang ba yin te/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min sgoms gsung*/ de nas 'bad de bsgoms pas zhag bcu bzhi nas mtshan thog cig la rang lus nam mkha'i khams khyab pa tsam zhig tu red 'dug pa la/ ya gi spyi bo'i gtsug nas ma gi rkang pa'i mthil yan chad la 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad tshang bar mthong*/ phal cher 'o ma 'ba' zhig 'thung gin 'dug /la la seng ge dkar mo bzhos pa'i 'o ma yin zer ba 'thung zhing 'dug /'ur ting gi sgra lta bu zhig gang nas 'ong ma nges par rgyun du 'ong zhing 'dug pas mtshan thal gyis 'byams/ nam langs nas sgom thag bkrol tsa na thams cad yal nas song*/ bla ma la zhus pas/ lus kyi rtsa stong phrag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nang du/ las kyi rlung gi thig le khrid pa yin te/ rlung ye shes kyi rlung du 'tshal bar gda'/ gsungs nas mchog gi gtum mo gnang nas bsgoms pas/ nyin (82)gcig tsa na gung thang gi lung pa thams cad dud pas gang nas 'dug /ci zhig na mun nag tu song*/ lam yang ma rnyed long ba 'gro 'gro byas nas bla ma'i spyan sngar phyin pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas ci yang mi lto/ de gar sdod la sgoms gsungs nas steng gegs sel ba'i gdams ngag de gnang bas nam langs pa ltar song*/ yang nub gcig rang gi lus 'di sha ye med pa'i keng rus rtsa mang pos sbrel nas 'dug par mthong*/ bla ma la zhus pas rlung rtsub thal ba yin cung zad 'jam du gyis gsung*/

srod la yi dam lha bsgoms shing bzlas pa byas/ gung la bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms shing gsol ba 'ba' zhig btab/ tho rangs srog rtsol gyi rlung bsgoms/ skya rengs tha ma shar ba'i tshe gnyid thum phran tsam zhig song ba la/ sngar 'dris bag chags ye ma mchis pa'i rmi lam gyi mtshan bltas nyi shu rtsa bzhi byung ba las/ rnal sad pa dang rmi lam 'di rnams dge'am mi dge snyam du rtog pa cung zad cig skyes te/ yang thugs dgongs btang bas yang kho bo'i bla ma rje btsun sangs rgyas dngos 'di lta bu bzhugs pa la zhus pas chog bsam nas tsha ba ma bskol bar de ka ltar byon pas/ rje btsun brag rtsa zhig na dbu btums nas gzims gda' ba la/ phyag btsal maṇḍal phul nas/ rje btsun lags (83)kho bo la do gal cung zad cig mchis pas/ ma gzims par bzhengs pa zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas khyod la rnam rtog gcig skyes nas 'dug pa da nang nga'i nyams la byung gis/ da ma bde ba'i do gal ci yod smros shig /gsung pa la rmi lam zhu gsol gyi mgur 'di rnams snyan du phul ba/ rje brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// ngo mtshar ras kyi na bza' can// yid bzhin nor bu gtsug gis rgyan// kun gyis thod bzhin bskur ba'i gnas// mtshan mi la zhes byar yongs su grags// mtshan de'i snyan pas phyogs bcur khyab// de thos kho bo spro ba skyes// shar skar ma smin drug 'og nas snyegs// lus tsha grang yid la ma bgyis te// rtag tu ngu yi rnam thar bzhin// rje ras pa khyed dang nam mjal snyam// lam ring dka' ba sna tshogs spyad// gdugs phyed dang gnyis kyis phyin pa'i sar// lus srog yal bar de dor byas// 'on kyang mos gus drag po'i mthus// shar phyogs spos ldan grong khyer du// chos 'phags mdun du zhal mthong ltar// bkra shis sgang gi dgon pa ru// pha rje btsun ras pa khyed dang mjal// mi kho bo'i bsams pa mthar phyin snyam// shin tu spro dga' ba spu g.yos// nor sgyu ma'i 'bul (84)rgyu ma mchis kyang*// gzhi 'khor ba'i chos la zhen pa log

/lam skye 'chi gnyis la 'jigs shing skrag /'jig rten bya ba blo yis btang*// bsgrub blo zhig gting nas skyes pa ste// pha khyed kyi thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung*// de mi brjed kho bos sems la 'jog /'bangs zhu don mchis so gu ru rje// mdang srod la yi dam bsnyen pa bgyis// nam gung rje la gsol ba btab// de rjes srog rtsol rlung la 'bad// dgung da nang skya rengs tha ma la// gnyid thun phran tsam zhig thal ba las// sngar 'dris bag chags ma mchis pa'i// ya mtshan rmi lam 'di rnams byung*// dbyar zhwa dar gyi cha ga can// mtshal dmar 'obs kyi bad kyi rgyan// de la rgod kyi spu ru gtsug /mi kho bos mgo la gyon pa rmis// sum lham lpags sngon 'gying bag can// ra gan 'bur mgo cha le btab// sgrog dngul gyi a long ta le mdzes// lham de 'dra zung gcig gyon pa rmis// gu lang dar dkar ral ka la// gong skor gser thag mdo long ris// mtshal gyi thig phran 'dzum ris can// gos de 'dra lus la gyon pa rmis// men po ras yug ske rags la// me tog mtshon tshogs bkra ba rgyan// mu tig har gyi chun 'phyang mdzes// de 'khor gsum sked la bcings (85)pa rmis// chu rlon re dkar phying pa la// bzo dang gras su ma byas pa// gong can dngul gyi pho long btab// de ya mtshan steng du gyon pa rmis// a mra tsandan dbyug pa la// rin chen sna bdun phra bkod de// 'chang bzung gser gyi drwa ba can// de lag pa g.yas su bzung ba rmis// mtshan dang ldan pa'i ka pā la// gser mdog bdud rtsi bcud kyis bkang*// kho bos kha phor bya snyam pas// de lag pa g.yon du khyer ba rmis// sum gal phra bo dor cig gis// nang du 'bras dkar sa lu blug /kho bos chos rgyags bya snyam pas// de phrag pa g.yas la bkal pa rmis// ri dwags kriṣṇa'i lpags pa la// mgo dang sder bzhi ma nyams pa// 'di yis kho bo'i stan bya snyam// de phrag pa g.yon la bkal ba rmis// de'i rjes g.yas su phar bltas pas// gser gyi spang po ngos bzang la// be lug sna lnga bzas la bkram// kho bos phyugs rdzi bya snyam rmis// phyi rjes g.yon du tshur bltas pas// g.yu yi ne'u thang sing ma la// me tog snam bu'i mtshon tshogs bkram// bud med mang pos phyag 'tshal gyis// dbus me tog ser po'i gling khams ni// shin tu 'dab rgyas gser mdog can// padma spungs pa'i gdan steng du// (86)sems dpa'i skyil krung bcas pa rmis// mdun du chu mig rdol ba rmis// rgyab tu 'od cig 'khyil ba rmis// lus la me dpung 'bar ba rmis// snying la nyi zla shar ba rmis// ya mtshan rmi lam de rnams byung*// ltas dge 'am mi dge 'chad ma shes// rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rnal 'byor pa// 'di don gang lags gsung du gsol// zhes rmi lam gyi ltas de rnams snyan du gsol bas/

bla ma'i zhal nas bu lha rje ston pa thugs mi bde mi 'tshal shes pa lhod kyis glod la zhog mdzod/ rnam rtog gi dra bar bdag 'dzin gyi nang tshang ma gzhug /the tshom gyi mdud pa rang grol la thong*/ gnyis 'dzin gyi thag pa phra sar chod/ bag chags kyi rdul phran srab sar rtol/ sems 'phro 'du ma mang ma bcos so ma'i ngang la zhog /nga sgyu lus 'byongs pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin pas/ rmi lam 'chad pa yang shes/ rmi lam bsgyur ba yang shes/ rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid kyis rgyas thebs pa'i gdeng yang yod de/ lar rmi lam gyi chos nyid khong du chud pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin pas/ bu khyod kyis rmis pa'i rmi lam gyi mtshan ltas de rnams/ dus da res pha rgan ngas zhib tshags su bkrol de go nges shes pa bshad la brda don ngo sprad kyis/ thugs ma yengs par gtod la snyan lhan ner gson cig gsungs (87)pa'i rjes la/ rje btsun gyi rmi lam zhu gsol gyi dris lan gsung dbyangs mgur du bzhengs pa/ glu dris lan mjal lo lha rje ba// snyan lhan ner gsan las thugs gtad 'tshal// bu zangs dkar lugs kyi bde mchog shes// dbu ru stod du bka' gdams bskyangs// gnas pa zab mo'i chu rgyun mnga'// de kun ngo mtshar che snyam pa// rmi lam bag chags nying 'khrul la// ltas phyed du bzung nas yid gtod pa// bu khyod gsan rgya chung ngam rdzu ba lags// mdo rgyud bstan bcos ma gzigs sam// nges don pha rol phyin pa nas// rmi lam yang dag ma yin te// gsog dang gsob dang ya ma brla// snying po med ces thub pas gsungs// de bzhin sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad la// gong dang 'dra te rgyas par gsungs// de don thugs su ma byon nam// 'on kyang da res mtshan ltas de// ma 'ongs lung bstan ngo mtshar che// nga rmi lam sbyangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// sgyu ma ngo sprod 'chad pa shes// mgo la zhwa dkar gyon pa de// theg pa yas mar 'bubs pa'i brda// rgya mo'i dar chag btab pa de// chos nyid zab cing phra bar bstan// spu sdug 'obs kyi kha dog ltar// grub mtha' ma 'dres so sor gsal// rgod kyi bya (88)phod ldem pa de// lta ba'i yang rtse phyag rgya che// skye med ngo bo mthong ba'i brda// sum lham zung gcig gyon pa de// spyod pa mas yar 'dzeg pa'i brda// ngos bzhi 'bur gyi rgyan pa de// 'bras bu sku gsum thob pa'i brda// tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i brda ru bstan// sgrog ga dngul gyi a long de// spyod pa'i gol sa yin pa'i phyir// rtog med rang dgar mi spyod cing*// rgyal sras gzhon nu'i spyod pa ltar// bag yod mdzes par spyod pa'i brda// dar dkar ral ka gyon pa de// rang rgyud skyon gyis ma gos brda// gong skor gser thag btso ma ste// mi 'gyur bsam pa bzang ba'i brda// mtshal gyi thig phran 'dzum ris can// brtse bas 'gro don byed pa'i brda// men po ras yug ske rags kyis// 'khor gsum sked la bcings pa de// rgyud sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa'i brda// me tog sna tshogs rgyan mdzes shing*// mu tig chun 'phyang spras pa yang*// bslab pa gsum gyi rab brgyan zhing*// gdul bya dang ba 'dren pa'i brda// steng na phying dkar gyon pa de// chos sku dri med rtogs pa'i brda// bzo dang gras su ma byas pa// de la bcas bcos med pa'i brda// dngul gyi pho long btab pa de// de don 'gyur ba med pa'i brda// a mra tsandan dbyug pa de// (89)rang 'dod bla ma rnyed pa'i brda// rin chen sna tshogs phra bkod pa// de ni rje yi yon tan yin// 'chang bzung gser gyi dra ba de// snyan brgyud gnad kyi gdams ngag gis// skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa'i brda// lag pa g.yas su thogs pa de// bde nas bde ba'i lam bsgrod de// sangs rgyas zhing du gshegs pa'i brda// mtshan dang ldan pa'i ka pā la// ngo bo stong pa mtshon pa'i brda// bdud rtsi bcud kyis bkang ba de// nyams myong bde ba mtshon pa'i brda// gser mdog 'od dang ldan pa de// rnam pa gsal ba mtshon pa'i brda// kho bos kha phor bya snyam pa// de gsum cig tu mtshon pa'i brda// lag pa g.yon du khyer ba de// nyams myong 'bral ba med pa'i brda// sum gal phra bo mdzes pa de// cir snang lam du slong ba'i brda// dor sdeb phrag la bkal ba de// zung 'jug thabs dang shes rab kyis// theg chen lam la bgrod pa'i brda// nang gi 'bras dkar sa lu de// kho bos chos rgyags bya snyam pa// sku tshe la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// bsam gtan zas kyi 'tsho ba'i brda// phrag g.yon kriṣṇa'i pags pa de// dran pa yengs med mtshon pa'i brda// mgo dang sder bzhi ma nyams pa// byang chub sems kyi rgyun goms (90)shing*// tshad med bzhi la sbyangs pa'i phyir// 'gro drug sdug bsngal sel ba'i brda// kho bo'i stan bya snyam pa yang*// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i// rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba'i brda// de rjes g.yas su phar bltas pas// gser gyi spang po ngos bzang de// phyi nang yon tan rgyas pa'i brda// be lug bzas la bkram pa de// chos dang zang zing skyabs gnas kyis// 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong ba'i brda// khyod kyis phyugs rdzi bya snyam pa// sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa rnams// mi 'gyur thugs rjes skyong ba'i brda// phyis rjes g.yon du tshur bltas pas// g.yu yi ne'u thang sing ma de// zag med ting 'dzin rgyun goms pas// dga' bde ye shes mthong ba'i brda// me tog snam bus brgyan pa de// drod rtags phyogs med rim gyis 'bar// nyams myong sna tshogs skye ba'i brda// bud med mang pos phyag 'tshal ba// rtsa dang thig le la gnas pa'i// ḍā ki dbang du 'du ba'i brda// dbus me tog ser po'i zhing khams de// ting 'dzin rtogs pa dang ldan zhing*// tshul khrims gtsang mas rab brgyan pa'i// mkha' la sprin bzhin dge 'dun rnams// khyod kyi 'khor du 'du ba'i brda// shin tu 'dab rgyas gser mdog can// padma spungs pa'i (91)gdan steng yang*// shes pas srid la mi gnas phyir// padma 'dam gyi ma gos yang*// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos brda// sems dpa'i skyil krung bcas pa yang*// snying rje zhi la mi gnas phyir// byang chub sems dpa'i gzhon nu ltar// 'gro drug sems can mar gyur la// sprul skus 'gro don byed pa'i brda// mdun du chu mig rdol ba de// chos kyi chab srid dar ba'i brda// rgyab na 'od cig 'khyil ba de// bod khams dkar por gtong ba'i brda// lus la me chen 'bar ba de// bde drod gtum mo ye shes mes// rnam rtog chab rom zhu ba'i brda// snying la nyi zla shar ba de// 'gro 'ong med pa'i 'od gsal gyis// ngang la rtag tu gnas pa'i brda// bu rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// dus phyi mar 'byung bar lung bstan pa// ltas dge bar 'chad pa chos kyi brda// lar rmi lam mngon sum gang la yang*// mtshan mar gzung na bar chad yin// sgyu mar gzung na lam du 'gro

/rmi lam rmi shes 'chad mi shes// bzang rmis ngan ltas sdig par bshad// rmi lam sbyangs pa klong gyur pas// rmi lam bzang ltas dge bar bshad// lar skyon dang yon tan gang la yang*// mchog tu ma 'dzin rigs kyi bu// khyed dge slong gi (92)thugs la de ltar zhog /bu lha rje dus da res khyed la byung ba'i mtshan ltas de rnams ma 'ongs pa lung bstan pa chos rgyud la skye ba'i brda yin te/ pha rgan nga yis 'chad pa'i tshig zhib tshags su bkrol te brda don ngo sprad pa de rnams ma brjed par gyis la dus phyis bden rdzun gtan la phob cig /bden par gyur tsa na bla ma nga la yang mos gus khyad par can da lta dang 'dra ba ma yin pa zhig skye ba yin/ bu khyod la yang sems kyi ngo bo ma bcos par mthong ba'i rtogs pa khyad par can zhig de'i dus su 'char ba yin te/ tshe 'di rang la skye 'chi gnyis las log ste 'chi/ lar khyod sgom chen gsha' ma zhig byed bsam na/ rmi lam dang mtshan ltas la mngon zhen ma che/ bdud 'jug pa'i rgyu yin/ bla mas gsung pa dang rang zhe bcad ma gtogs pa gzhan gyi ngag gi rjes su ma 'brang*/ sems so mi zin pa'i rgyu yin/ g.yas g.yon grogs kyi skyon ma lta/ ngan rtog ma mang*/ bcas bcos ma byed/ gzhan rgyud kyi sems mi shes par rlom sems kyi ltung ba 'phog pa'i rgyu yin/ 'o skol da lta skye shi bar dor 'khrul pa'i snang ba la longs spyod pa 'di rmi lam chen po rmi rdo ba yin/ nyin mo byas pa'i bag chags de nub mo gnyid log tsa na rnam shes yid kyi 'khrul pa las byung ba (93)ste/ rmi lam 'khrul pa sgyu ma nying 'khrul bya ba yin/ bag chags de goms pa mthar phyin pas las dge sdig gi rjes su 'brangs te/ srid pa bar dor bde sdug gi tshor ba nyams su myong ba de/ rmi lam na rmi lam chen po/ sgyu ma na sgyu ma chen po/ bar do na bar do chen po yin te/ de lam du byed pa la rmi lam sgyu lus sbyangs pa'i rtsal mthar phyin 'tshal bas/

shugs phyung las bsgoms mdzod gsung*/ de nas zla ba gcig bsgoms pas/ dang po sman bla mched bdun gyi zhal mthong*/ nyin gcig la rlung 'gro 'ong gcig gis chog pa byung*/ rlung btang tsa na yal nas thal/ phyi dro rlung bzung tsa na longs sku'i zhing khams rab 'byams rnams mthong bas/ de la sems yengs nas rlung btang tsa na nam srod du song 'dug pas/ bla ma'i thugs dam la gnod snyam nas de nub zhu ma nus/ maṇḍal phul zhing gsol ba btab/ tho rangs kyi thun la rlung bzung tsa na/ sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyi gtso bo shākya thub pas byas pa mthong*/ nangs par nam langs nas zhur byon tsa na/ phyag 'tshal zhing yod pa'i tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas da ni yi dam lha'i zhal mthong te/ longs sku dang sprul sku gnyis dngos su mthong*/ chos sku da gzod mjal ba 'dug gis dbus su song la sgoms shig /(94)sngar gyi 'phrang de tsho ngas bsal ba yin/ da mngon par shes pa'i 'phrang yod/ de byung tsa na lha'i bu'i bdud 'jug pa yin pas shin tu gsang ba gal che/ spyir yang yon tan thams cad gsang ba gal che/ lar dbang po rnon po'i rgyu'i stobs can la/ bdud kyis mi tshugs pa yin te/ khyod dbang po rnon por 'dug mod kyis/ gsang sngags gsang bas 'grub pa yin pas/ gsang la sgrub pa gyis shig /sems can la phan par 'dug pas tshogs pa yang skyongs shig gsung*/ tshogs skyong ba'i dus nam lags zhus pas/ sems kyi ngo bo mthong nas de brtan pa dang skyongs/ ci zhig ltar lar da lta 'dra ba ma yin pa'i rtogs pa zhig rgyud la skye/ de'i dus su mi rgan nga la yang sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i nges shes brtan po zhig 'byung la/ bu khyod rang la yang sems kyi ngo bo ma bcos par mthong ba'i rtogs pa yang dag pa rgyud la skye bas de'i dus su tshogs pa skyongs/ rlung lag sor la tshud dam mi tshud ltos/ de tshud na rlung gi 'phrang las thar ba yin gsung*/

de nub rdo leb kyi steng du thal ba blug nas sor mo gtad cing rlung bcun pas/ thal ba bun bun byung ste/ nangs par bla ma'i drung du de ltar byas pas rtsa rlung la dbang thob pa bya ba ni min te/ rtsa rlung las su rung ba (95)bya ba yin pas/ da nga dang 'grogs mi dgos pas song zhig /sprul pa dang sgyur ba la sogs cho 'phrul dang*/ mchog thun mong gnyis ka'i dngos grub thob nas 'ong gis/ da 'di nas shar gyi phyogs nas sgam po gdar gyi ri bo/ ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa lta bu/ rtse mor rin po che'i prog zhu ltar yod pa nga'i zhwa 'di lta bu/ shing spang thang gser gyi maṇḍal lta bu/ mdun ri rin chen spungs pa lta bu/ rgyab ri dar dkar phyar ba lta bu/ ri bdun blon po phyag 'tshal ba lta bu yod pas/ ri de'i mgul na khyod kyi gdul bya snod dang ldan pa yod pas der song la sems can gyi don gyis shig gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// bu ston pa khyod dbus su bzhud mi bzhud// ston pa dbus su bzhud pa na// res 'ga' zas kyi snang ba 'char// zas kyi snang ba shar tsa na// zas su zag med ting 'dzin zo// zhim mngar kun sgyu mar shes par mdzod// cir snang chos skur nyams su longs// bu ston pa dbus su bzhud mi bzhud// ston pa dbus su bzhud pa na// res 'ga' gos kyi snang ba 'char// gos kyi snang ba shar tsa na// gos su gtum mo'i bde drod gyon// 'jam legs kun sgyu mar shes par mdzod// cir snang chos skur nyams su long*// bu ston pa dbus su (96)bzhud mi bzhud// ston pa dbus su bzhud pa na// res 'ga' nor gyi snang ba 'char// nor gyi snang ba shar tsa na// nor du 'phags pa'i nor bdun bsten// nor rdzas kun sgyu mar shes par mdzod// cir snang chos skur nyams su longs// bu ston pa dbus su bzhud mi bzhud// ston pa dbus su bzhud pa na// res 'ga' yul gyi snang ba 'char// yul gyi snang ba shar tsa na// yul du chos nyid gtan yul bzung*// pha yul kun sgyu mar shes par mdzod// cir snang chos skur nyams su long*// bu ston pa dbus su bzhud mi bzhud// ston pa dbus su bzhud pa na// res 'ga' grogs kyi snang ba 'char// grogs kyi snang ba shar tsa na// grogs su rang byung ye shes bsten// zla grogs kun sgyu mar shes par mdzod// cir snang chos skur nyams su longs// bu ston pa dbus su bzhud mi bzhud// ston pa dbus su bzhud pa na// res 'ga' bla ma'i snang ba 'char// bla ma'i snang ba shar tsa na// 'bral med spyi bor gsol ba thob// brjed med snying gi dkyil du sgoms// bla ma'ang sgyu ma rmi lam 'dra// lar thams cad sgyu mar shes par mdzod// shar sgam po dar gyi ri bo de// ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra// rtse mo rin chen prog zhu 'dra// (97)rgyab ri dar dkar phyar ba 'dra// mdun ri rin chen spungs pa 'dra// ri bdun blon po 'dud pa 'dra// shing spang gser gyi maṇḍal 'dra// ri de'i mgul na gdul bya yod// khyod de ru song la 'gro don sgrubs// bu khyod kyi 'gro don 'grub ste mchi// zhes gsungs nas khyod kyi ming yang dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po 'dzam gling grags pa zhes bya ba yin no gsungs/

de nas dbang dang byin rlabs thams cad dang chos ma lus pa rdzogs par gnang*/ rje nā ro pa'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa rnams rdzogs par zhus/ chos drug gong khug ma de bla ma'i phyar bu'i gong nas byung ba yin gsungs/ de yang lcam lhan cig skyes pa'i sgron ma yon bdag mos rje btsun gyi phyag dpe'i gnyer mdzad pa yin te/ mo na ba la sman bcos mdzad pas/ rin po che la shin tu dgyes nas chos kyi nang byin mdzad de/ rje btsun gyi bka' dpe la sogs pa gdams ngag gyi phyag dpe rnams rtsad chod de/ gsang sngags bla med kyi rgyud thams cad dang*/ gdams pa lhag lus med pa rdzogs pa'i mthar/ gtor ma chen po zhig dbu thog tu bzhag ste/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi dbang bskur nas/ bu khyod kyi sems can dpag tu med pa'i don 'grub par 'dug gsung*/ de ji ltar lags (98)zhus pas/ dang po khyod yong khar yang mtshan rtags gsal po byung la/ 'di na yod pa'i tshe yang nga dang khyod gnyis bang 'gran pas khyod sngon la thal te/ nga bas khong sems can gyi don rgya che bar 'dug byas pa zhig rmis/ yang pha bong sbra bas che ba yul gzhan du 'phen pa dang*/ phyag gis pha bong brdabs pas rdul phra rab tu song ste/ sku lus kyang res bzang nus pa tshad med kyi phyi rol yul gyi 'jigs pa dang bral bar 'dug byas pa rmis gsungs/ de ltar chos thams cad dris pa'i sgo nas kyang zhus/ khong dri ba la shin tu mkhas pa yin skad/ de'i lan thams cad kyang bla mas gsungs/ rnal 'byor pa gzhan gyi dri ba la lan mi gsung bar nga la chos 'dri na dbus pa ston pas 'dri dgos pa yin gsung*/ chos thams cad rdzogs par gnang nas/ bla ma'i zhal nas dbus su song la sgoms gsungs/ de ltar rje btsun gyi drung du zla ba bcu gsum bzhugs nas gung lo so gnyis pa stag gi lo la/ dbus su 'byon par brtsams te/ de nas shing stag pa'i nags yod pa'i lung pa zhig gi chu la rdo zam chung chung zhig yod pa'i sa bar du skyel thung mdzad/

dbus pa ston pa khyod rten 'brel gyi gnad cig gi chu 'di'i phar khar kho bo 'gro mi btub par 'dug pas/ 'o skol pha spad kyi 'phrin skos 'dir bya/ khyod khres (99)po phog la 'dir sdod cig gsungs nas/ rje btsun zam pa'i steng du phyed dkyil du bzhugs pa'i zhabs g.yas pa la gtad kyin phyag mang du 'tshal/ dbu steg tsa na zhabs kyi padmo la btud de/ spyan chab phyung zhing gsol ba btab pas/ de'i rten 'brel la shin tu ma mnyes pas/ rje btsun gyis a ru ra gser mdog ma gcig dang*/ me lcag gcig gnang ste/ nga la yang dge sbyor skye dka' bar byung ba la gdams ngag 'di la brten nas nyams rtogs khyad par can rgyud la skyes/ bu khyod la yang bar skabs su dge sbyor 'phel 'grib byung na gdams ngag 'di dgos pa yin gsungs nas/ phyag rgya chen po rlung sems gnyis med kyi ngo sprod gnang nas/ lar khyod la sgom chen pa mthar thug pa zhig 'ong bar 'dug gsungs nas/ bu dbus pa ston pa pha tshan gyi khe drags spongs/ gnyen 'dun gyi thag pa chod/ tshe 'di'i gdos thag med par gyis/ ri'i bu gyis chos thams cad gcig tu dril la nyams su longs/ pha rgan nga la gsol ba thob/ gzhan yang dug gsum rgyas pa'i mi dang 'grogs su mi rung*/ de'i grib 'phog pa yin/ de gang yin na snang ba dgrar langs pa'i rigs can/ chos dang gang zag thams cad la ngan smras cher 'thag pa'i gang zag yod/ de'i nang na zhe (100)sdang me ltar 'bar nas yod pa yin/ dper na sems can sbrul la rkang lag dang gshog pa ni med/ sbrul bas nyam chung ba med pa la/ kho mthong ba tsam gyis mi rnams dred cing dngangs nas 'ong ba de nang na zhe sdang chen po yod pa'i rtags yin/ nang la zhe sdang chen po yod na phyi rol thams cad dgrar langs nas 'ong ba chos nyid yin/ gang zag 'ga' zhig rdo bub pa can dang shing nyag can tshun chad nyar byed pa yod de/ rgas na rgan rgyags shi na dur zas dgos/

gzhon dus tshogs gsog pa la yang nor dgos/ de med na chos mi yong zer nas tha na bun skyed khe tshong la sogs log 'tsho 'ba' zhig byed pa yod/ de'i nang na 'dod chags chu bzhin khol nas yod pa yin/ yang gang zag kha cig yang dag pa'i don bsgom pa'i dus da lta ma yin/ tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgya bya ba shes bya la mi srid tshogs ma bsags par sdig pa mi 'byongs/ snying rje ma bsgoms par nyan thos su gol/ thabs khyad du bsad pas chad lta ru song zer ba yod/ de'i nang na gti mug mun pa 'thibs pa lta bu yod pa yin/ de 'dra ba'i mi dang gtam byed du yang mi nyan/ khyod kyi bla ma ni gang chos ni gang yin zer du 'ong*/ legs po bshad kyang de 'dra mi srid zer nas/ kho zhe (101)sdang gi dbang gis chos dang gang zag gnyis ka la skur pa 'debs/ bdag gzhan thams cad ngan 'gror skye ba'i rgyu gsog /de bas na/ thos nas blo chung de yis 'di ni spong byed de// spangs nas skyabs med gyur pa de ni mnar med 'gro /zhes bya ba de'i dus su 'byung bas/ bdag la brten nas gzhan rgyud la sdig pa gsog /dug gsum rgyas pa'i mi dang 'grogs su mi rung ste/ nyan thos nang du zhag bdun gnas// yan lag nyes pa bdun pa yin// zhes bya ba'i don yang de 'dra la zer ba yin/ spyir yang ri dwags rmas ma'am bya bzhin du zon bag che bar bya/ zhi ba dul ba rtse rag chung bar bya/ bzod pa che bar bya/ thams cad dang mthun par bya/ gtsang sbra shin tu che bar bya/ rtog pa shin tu chung bar bya/ ri mtshams dang smra bcad dang 'dag sbyar gsum gyis dus 'da' bar bya/ rang sems sangs rgyas su rtogs kyang bla ma dang rdo rje slob dpon mi spang bar slob/ bsag sbyang gnyis po rang sar dag kyang*/ tshogs chung ngu chung ngu nas bsag /las 'bras nam mkha' ltar go yang*/ sdig pa chung ngu chung ngu nas 'dzem/ mnyam gzhag dang rjes thob med pa'i nyams yod/

bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du go yang chos dang gang zag la skur ba mi gdab/ (102)bu khyod kyis yos bu lo rta'i zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la/ brin dang snye nam gyi ri la sleb par gyis shig gsungs nas dwags po'i skyel mgur 'di gsungs so// bu spros bral sems la shar dus su// tha snyad tshig phyir ma 'brang zhig /chos brgyad sgrog tu tshud nyen yod// bu nga rgyal med pa'i ngang la zhog /de go 'am dbus pa ston pa ba// de go 'am dwags po lha rje ba// rang grol nang nas shar dus su// tshad ma'i sbyor ba ma bkod zhig /don med 'bad rtsol byed nyen yod// bu rnam rtog med pa'i ngang la zhog /de go 'am dbus pa ston pa ba// de go 'am dwags po lha rje ba// rang sems stong nyid du rtogs tsa na// gcig dang du mar ma sbrel cig /chad pa'i stong nyid du 'gro nyen yod// bu spros pa med pa'i ngang la zhog /de go 'am dbus pa ston pa ba// de go 'am dwags po lha rje ba// phyag rgya chen po sgom dus su// lus ngag dge sbyor ma brtson cig /mi rtog ye shes yal nyen yod// ma bcos lhug pa'i ngang la zhog /de go 'am dbus pa ston pa ba// de go 'am dwags po lha rje ba// rtags dang lung bstan byung dus su// dga' rlom ched du ma 'dzin cig /bdud kyi lung bstan 'ong nyen yod// ched 'dzin med pa'i ngang la (103)zhog /de go 'am dbus pa ston pa ba// de go 'am dwags po lha rje ba// rang sems gtan la phebs dus su// mngon shes la 'dod pa ma skyed cig /rlom sems bdud kyi khyer nyen yod// bu re dwogs med pa'i ngang la zhog /de go 'am dbus pa ston pa ba// de go 'am dwags po lha rje ba// zhes gsungs so// de nas rje btsun yar byon te/ slob ma ras pa thams cad bsdus nas/ lha rje ston pa des sems can mang po la phan thogs par 'dug /mdang nga'i rmi lam na/ kho bo'i gan nas bya rgod ser po zhig dbus su 'phur de song*/

ri chen po zhig gi rtser babs pa las/ phyogs phyogs nas ngur pa'i 'khor mang po 'dus/ dar cig nas so sor gyes te song*/ ngur ba re re la yang ngur pa g.yog lnga brgya tsam re 'dus nas/ lung pa'i nang thams cad ngur bas ser nyog gis gang nas song ba rmis/ kho bo rnal 'byor pa yin pa la kho bos rjes su rab tu byung ba mang po 'ong bar 'dug /lha rje ston pa des sems can dpag tu med pa la phan thogs par 'dug /kho bos kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba byas par 'dug gsung*/ de nas rje dwags po rin po che dbus su byon te/ sngar bka' (104)gdams kyi bla ma rnams kyis zhal nas nged kyi rtags ma dor bar shog cig gsung ba dang mthun par/ dbu zhwa la ser tshos mdzad/ na bza' la phrug gong btang*/ sku 'gag ha zlum mdzad pa dang*/ chags lham dgur mo gsol ba la sogs te/ bka' gdams kyi chas rnams ma dor bar/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen snyug rum pa'i sar byon pas/ khong gi zhal nas khyod kyi rnal 'byor pa'i rtsar phyin pa'i yon tan ci yod gsung ba'i lan du/ rlung phyi nang du mi rgyu/ rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam zhus pas/ khyed la yon tan bzang po skyes 'dug sems can gyi don bya ran gsung ba la/ kho bo'i tshe rten 'brel tsam las med pas/ sngon la sgrub pa rang gces par yod zhus pas/ tshe sring ba'i gdams ngag nga la yod gsungs nas/ sgrol ma dkar mo dang snyug rum gnyis mi lab lab kyi tshul du yod pas de'i sgrub thabs gnang*/ de nas gnyal du bzhugs tsa na/ bla ma'i gsung dran nas/ rgya pa se re la gser zho bcu gnyis bskyis/ ras sgom ras pa grogs su khrid byon pas/ yar lung gi mdor sleb tsa na/ gtsang nas 'ongs pa'i tshong pa dang 'phrad pas/ de rnams la brin pa spyi dus khams bde'am/ bla ma rje btsun sku khams bde bar bzhugs sam zhes dris pas/ brin pa spyi dus (105)khams bde ste/ bla ma rje btsun ni rta'i zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la bde bar gshegs zer nas phyag mkhar dang*/

na bza'i ras shig bskur nas 'dug pa gtad pas/ de'i mod la spyan chab mang po shor/ dran med du gyur ba la drung na yod pa kun gyis phyag zhabs la sku mnye phul/ zhal ras la chu mang po gtor nas/ dar cig na dran pa rnyed de/ gser srang gang kha phye nas brin snye nang gyi phyogs su gtor/ phyag mang po 'tshal nas de'i tshe bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// rje gangs dkar rtse la gshegs pa'i tshe// seng ge dkar mo'i spyod dang mtshungs// zil gyis gnon pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje nags kyi khrod du gshegs pa'i tshe// rgya stag khra bo'i spyod dang mtshungs// re dwogs bral ba'i rnal 'byor pa// rje brag dkar rtse la gshegs pa'i tshe// thang dkar rgod po'i spyod dang mtshungs// phyi rgya rlabs kyi chod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje phyogs med ri khrod 'grim pa'i tshe// ri dwags yongs kyi spyod dang mtshungs// gdos thag chod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje 'khor gyi nang na bzhugs pa'i tshe// rdo rje 'chang gi spyod dang mtshungs// nged skal ldan 'dren pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje glang po lta bu'i spyod pa ste// mnyam gzhag rjes thob med par (106)nges// rje bu chung lta bu'i spyod pa ste// phyi nang gza' gtad bral bar nges// rje blo dang bral ba'i spyod pa ste// de nyid thugs su chud par nges// rje mngon shes dag snang ldan pa ste// nang gi sems nyid gsal bar nges// rje zas skom gyi 'du shes chung ba ste// ting 'dzin zas su gsol bar nges// rje nor bu dbang gi rgyal po ltar// dgos 'dod rang la 'byung ba khyed// rje skar tshogs dbus kyi zla rgyas bzhin// mang po'i nang na mdzes pa khyed// rje 'dam gyi nang nas padmo bzhin// 'khor ba'i skyon gyi gos pa med// rje 'gro ba yongs la drin re che// bka' brgyud rnams kyi re ba bsgrubs// khyed kyi yon tan dpag med la// bdag gis cung zad bstod pa las// thugs rjes dgongs shing yongs su bzung*// dngos po'i bsnyen bkur ma mchis kyang*// sgrub pa nyams su len lags kyi// chos sku gcig tu ma gyur bar// byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun ma gcod cig

/thugs rje'i lcags kyus ma gtang zhig /de ltar bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis// rje btsun nyid dang mjal bar shog /mjal nas byin gyis rlob par shog /ces bstod nas rang gi yul phyogs la byon te/ nyi ma dro ran gyi tshe/ dpe'u lcog cig gi rtsa na bud med cig 'dug pa la dro 'dod dgos gsungs pas/ de na re dro drang gis (107)steng du byon zer nas gdan drangs/ bud med des nas spar gang khyer nas sa zhig la zhing rmo ba'i tshul byas nas de btab pas mod de la ljang par song*/ de nas su smin te btsas ma byas dbyug pas brdung*/ brngo thags byas te zan rdzis/ chab thug skol nas bla ma la dro drangs/ chab cig btang ste kha bshal nas bzhengs par snyam byas tsa na/ dpe'u lcog dang bud med gang yang mi 'dug pas nga rang 'khrul pa yin nam snyam tsa na/ de min par zan gyi sgregs pa chil chil 'dug /lar 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad snang bzhin du stong*/ bden rdzun gyi mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ 'di lta bu zhig yin ang snyam pa byung ste/ nyams su myong ba khyad par can zhig rgyud la skyes so// de nas 'khor la snga ba ras sgom ras pa bya bas nye gnas byas/ de dus bka' gdams kyi grogs po rnams bya bya chos spyod mang du byed par 'dug /de'i ram 'degs ma byas na ni sdig par 'dug /khong rnams kyi ram 'degs byas pas/ sngar gyi nyams myong khyad par can rnams yal nas song*/ dben par sdod dgos bya ba yang de ltar yin/ dka' thub byas pas lus skam/ ting nge 'dzin ni shor/ sngar tsa na bla ma'i zhal nas bye ma btsir ba la mar khu mi yong*/ yungs kar la mar khu yod (108)pa yin lus bcud med pa la ting nge 'dzin mi yong gsungs pa de shin tu bden par 'dug gsung*/ der thugs ma bde nas da nga la sgom gyi skal ba med las che bas/ sngar gyi bka' gdams kyi bla ma rnams kyi sar 'gro dgos snyam pa la/ yang thugs dgongs btang bas/

yang nga'i bla ma rje btsun sangs rgyas dngos yin/ khong gi zhal nas phyag rgya chen po bsgom dus su// lus ngag gi dge sbyor ma brtson cig /mi rtog ye shes yal nyen yod// gsung ba 'di yin par 'dug /da ni dmyal bar da lta rang song rung bla ma la ltos pa 'cha' ba yin/ rje khong rang mkhyen snyam pa'i blo bcos ma ma yin pa zhig skyes nas blo khel nges su skal nas gsol ba btab pas/ dar cig na rje btsun gyi snang ba shar nas mdun du rtsen gyis byon/ de nas ring po ma lon par drod rlung rang lugs su tshud/ phyag rgya chen po nam mkha' dang mnyam pa mchog gi rtogs pa skyes te/ 'di'i dus su mgur 'di gsungs so// e ma ho// rang rig ye shes 'od gsal 'di// yod med mtha' las 'das pa zhig /rtag chad gnyis dang bral ba zhig /ngos bzung med par gsal ba zhig /ye shes yin phyir skye 'jig bral// spros bral bde ba'i ngo bo can// dmigs (109)pa'i yul med ngo bo gsal// bde ba ngos bzung med pa'i nyams// stong pa ye shes gsal ba'i nyams// 'bad rtsol mi dgos ye gsal nyams// 'du 'bral med pas gnyis med nyams// dgag sgrub med pas 'od gsal nyams// re dwogs med pas 'bras thob nyams// don dang blo ru phrad pas ngo mtshar che// nges shes gting nas skyes pas 'gyur ldog med// thams cad brdzun du shes pas zhen pa'i 'jig pa med// rnam rtog sems su shes pas spang blang gnyis dang bral// nyon mongs ye shes yin pas gnyen po bsten mi dgos// rang sems de ltar rtogs na chos sku lhun gyis grub// ces gsungs nas bo dhi tsitta'i phyag 'phreng nyi shu rtsa gcig yod pa de lcang ma'i sdong po cig la btags te/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis nga lung bstan na/ shing 'di la shing khyod skye bar gyur cig /gal te ma bstan na mi skye bar gyur cig /ces gsungs pas bo dhi tsi de nyin gcig la skyes so// de'i dus su rang gi sems skye ba med pa cir yang ma yin pa/

cir yang ma grub pa/ rnam pa gsal ba/ cir yang snang ba/ cir yang btub pa 'di ngo mtshar che gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// sems nyid 'od gsal stong pa 'di// lta ba yin par da (110)gzod shes// tha mal shes pa yengs med 'di// sgom pa yin par da gzod shes// 'dzin med rig pa rten 'brel 'di// nyams myong yin par da gzod shes// sems la nges shes skyes pa 'di// rtogs pa yin par da gzod shes// rang lugs lhug pa zhen med 'di// spyod pa yin par da gzod shes// rang rig ngo bo gsal stong 'di// chos sku yin par da gzod shes// thog med rang sems rnam dag 'di// 'bras bu yin par da gzod shes// e ma rin chen sems kyi klong*// rgyu yi dus na 'bras bu dngos// rtogs shing mngon du ma gyur kyang*// mtshan ma'i dri mas mi g.yog 'tshal// zhes gsungs so// de phyin chad sdig gsog 'phro chad kyang*/ thugs so ma bsod nas 'ol khar byon te dge lung du phyag phebs/ der lo gsum bzhugs/ de gong gnyal gyi se ba lung du lo drug bsgoms/ der bza' yang che bar byung*/ bsgom la yang bza' dgos par 'dug gsung*/ de nas bzod sems kyi ngo bo en tsam mthong*/ spyir kho bo la sgom skye ba dka' bar byung*/ rmi lam bzang po zhig rmis nas 'dod pa skyes pa yin gsung*/ rmi lam ci lta zhig rmis zhus pas/ gser brkos pas zhong pa gang rnyed/ 'di la brgyad stong pa zhig (111)'bri dgos byas pa rmis/ de nas cher ma lon par nges shes shig skyes/ dang po ni chos thams cad sems su shes pa zhig byung*/ lhan cig skyes sbyor en re tsam ma gtogs pa sgom pa ni gtum mo kho na bsgoms/ thams cad rtog par 'dug /rtog pa glo bur bar 'dug /de thams cad sems su 'dug snyam pa zhig nang nas rang shugs kyis byung gsung*/ de nas ci zhig na shes pa'i ngo bo sngar 'dris kyi mi dang phrad pa 'dra ba zhig byung*/

rig pa rang gi ngo bo yer gyis mthong*/ sngar gyi sgom dang mi dra bar sing nge ye re ba byung ste/ sngar gyi chos kun dang bla ma'i mgur kun kyang blo la bkra lam gyis byung*/ res ni snang ba sgyu ma lta bur wal wal/ res 'ga' ni cog ge ba lta bu yang byung*/ res ni shes pa rang gi ngo bo gcig pur song*/ thams cad sgom du song tsa na bsgom rgyu mi 'dug /sgom mkhan dang sgom gyi ngo bo ma rnyed/ sngar thos pa'i chos thams cad phyi shun du song*/ rig pa rang gi ngo bo rten med du song nas/ snang ba la blo btang mi dgos pa byung*/ res ni stong par rtogs/ res sgyu ma res 'od gsal du shar bas snang ba la rtog dpyod bya ma dgos gsung*/ res ni nyams la rgyang rgyang song ba snyam byed de/ de nyams rang yin par 'dug /(112)rtogs pa brtan du song ba min pa bogs 'don rgyu cher mi gda' gsung*/ sngar ni rtog pa ban bun byung tsa na med na dga' snyam pa byung ba la/ de nas rtog pa 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu song nas/ da yong gang gis kyang mi gnod snyam pa byung*/ de phyin chad 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu song*/ dus da lta yan chad du rgyun chad med de/ nyin mtshan med rgyun chad med rnal 'byor pa la shi ma shi med/ bar do med snyam pa zhig byung*/ sngon tsa na bzlas pa mang po byas kyang 'dre gdon gyis gnod/ da lta bzlas pa rdog gcig ma byas kyang gnod mi nus par 'dug /sngon dge bshes mkhas pa kun dang 'phrad na nyam nga ba snyam byed/ da ni sangs rgyas byon yang nyam nga med/ gzhan ji ltar mkhas pa zhig dang gleng slong byed kyang nyam nga ba med/ khong gi de rnams rgyang du lus nas 'gro zhing 'dug /yang nub cig rmi lam na/ bse'i ga'u cig rnyed pa dang*/ sgom pa bkras g.yung na re nga la ston zer ba la/ mi ston 'di na jo bo rje'i gdung ring bsrel dang*/ bka' gdams kyi gdams ngag rnams bzhugs pa yin byas pas/

kho nan che bas kha phye ba zhig rmis te/ da lta mi la phan dam dum thogs pa bka' gdams la brten nas phan thogs pa yin gsung*/ yang nub gcig gi rmi lam na/ mi gnyis la zangs dung chen po (113)zhig gtad de 'bud du bcug nas/ da lta dbus gtsang gi rgyal khams na'ang dung 'di las sgra che ba med byas pa zhig rmis te/ ston yon bya ba zhig yod pa de la kho bo la de 'dra ba zhig rmis te/ slob ma 'di kun la chos kyi bltas yin nam byas pa la/ khong na re slob ma'i chos kyi bltas yin te mi 'ong*/ bla ma rang la bltas yin te 'ong zer ba la phyis de kho na bzhin du byung gsung*/ yang nub cig rang gi lus las ring bsrel byung ste/ spang gshongs shig ltem gyis gang ba la mang po zhig rang gi khong du mid pa rmis/ da lta nga'i slob ma btsun chung gsar bu gcig tshun chad la yang*/ shin tu gnyan pa'i sar bsdad kyang bar chad mi 'byung ba'i brdar 'dug /yang nub gcig gi rmi lam na/ kho bos lag na mtshon rnon po zhig thogs 'dug ste/ des rang gi brla sha nas bcad pa gcod khar nyam nga ba tsam 'dug /bcad nas mi tsha bar 'dug ste zos pas shin tu zhim par byung*/ gzhan thams cad la yang gcod du bcug cing byin/ gnyid sad pa dang go ba zhig rnyed de/ rang la yod pa rang gis zos/ rang la yod pa rang gis myong*/ bya bar 'dug /gzhan la gcod du bcug pa de/ g.yag sha'i bem la gri gu su rno bya ba yin te/ nga la cher 'bags cher 'tshengs/ chung 'bags chung 'tshengs pa yin/ (114)yang lan cig kho bos lag na/ sgo nga gnyis 'dug pa la sgo nga'i nang na/ bya phrug skad ci di ri ri 'don pa rmis/ gnyid sad pa dang*/ ngas slob ma tshar te 'ong ba yin nam snyam pa byung*/ lar kho bo la slob ma dad pa can rnal ma zhig /ra khrid lug khrid kyi tshul du khrid na/ zla ba lnga na phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la 'god nus par 'dug gsung*/ de bzhin du rang sems kyi ngo bo'i dpe don gsungs te/

lhan cig skyes pa gnyug ma'i ye shes rang la gnas pa'i dpe/ gyad kyi khong pa na nor bu yod pa'am/ dbul po'i mal 'og na gter yod pa lta bu yin/ bla ma'i gdams ngag gis ngo shes pa mun rum du zla ba shar ba lta bu'i dpe/ sgron me thogs nas phyin pas mun pa'i nang nas gser gyi bum pa rnyed pa lta bu ste/ dpe'i dgongs pa bzhi pa'o// gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa phra rags thams cad rang sar zhi rgya mtsho'i 'khyag pa lta bu'i dpe dang*/ snang rig gi dngos po thams cad chos nyid kyi ngang du ro gcig pa chu ltongs su kha ba bab pa lta bu'i dpe/ tshogs drug gi snang ba sna tshogs chos kyi dbyings su dag pa nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa lta bu dang*/ sems nyid yongs su dag pa'i ngos la shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa gsal ba me long g.ya' dang bral ba'i dpe ste/ dpe'i dgongs pa brgyad pa'o// lus (115)sems bde ba rgyas pa gzhon nu zla ba rgyas pa lta bu dang*/ de nyams su myong ba gzhan la bshad du ma btub pa lkugs pa'i lce thog tu sbrang rtsi'i ro bzhag pa lta bu dang*/ phra rags kyi bag chags thams cad rang sar dag pas 'khor ba'i chos la nyam nga bag tsha med pa ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ge lta bu'i dpe dang*/ sems nyid yid bzhin gyi nor bu de la/ 'khor 'das kyi dgos 'dod ma lus par 'byung ba nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu'i dpe ste/ dpe'i dgongs pa bcu gnyis pa'o// de'i don mgur 'di gsungs so// e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// sems can ma lus thams cad la// de nyid yod de rtogs pa med// dper na gyad kyi nor bu bzhin// rang la yod de ngo ma shes// rgyun du 'grogs kyang zhal ma mjal// bla ma'i drin gyis dus 'dir rtogs// mun pa'i dkyil du zla shar bzhin// rang blo'i dkyil nas ye shes shar// shar ba'i nyi ma nub pa med// nyams su myong bas rang rgyud tshim// byin rlabs stobs kyis ye shes rgyas// rang rig ye shes nang nas shar// brjod bral gyi nyams myong blo dang bral// don dang blo ru phrad pa ngo mtshar che// ma bsam lhun gyis grub pa la// bsam gyis mi khyab ye shes gsal// rtag tu longs spyod ngo mtshar che// (116)'od gsal ngos bzung med pa la// nyams len byed pa rmad kyi chos// rang nyid chos skur gyur pa ngo mtshar che// snang grags sems su shes pas zhe 'dod bral// dga' dang spro ba rgyun chad med pa byung*// bde ba chen po'i don cig rnyed pa 'dra// phra rags sems kyi bag chags dbyings su dag

/seng ge bzhin du 'jigs dang nyam nga med// skye shi 'khor ba'i chos dang bral ba 'dra// nam mkha' bzhin du ngos bzung kun dang bral// phyogs lhung med cing zhe 'dod dbyings su zhi// sems nyid de ltar rtogs na lta ba yin// snang sems gcig 'dres chu dang chab rom bzhin// de don gcig tu go na rtogs pa yin// de don nang nas shar na nyams myong yin// de la rtse gcig 'jog na bsgom pa yin// ma yengs dran pa brtan na spyod pa yin// de nyid chos skur rtogs na 'bras bu yin// de ma rtogs na gzugs sku 'byung mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// bla mas gsung ba de 'di yin par 'dug ang snyam pa byung*/ chos thams cad phyi shun dang sbun pa bzhin du yal nas song*/ skyes bu dbul pos gter rnyed pa'am/ sngar 'dris kyi mi dang phrad pa'am/ mgron po rang khyim du sleb pa bzhin du bya sems thams cad dang bral/ nga skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i srid pa tha ma ba (117)yin ang snyam pa byung*/ sgom lta thog tu skyol/ sgom bdag po'i lag tu gtad/ bla ma drin re che ang*/ gdams ngag ngo mtshar che ang snyam du/ dus de nas da lta'i bar du nyams la 'phel 'grib med/ rtogs pa la mtho dma' med/ spang blang med pa'i don la the tshom med gsung*/ de nas yang 'ol kha grab kyi gtsang po la chos gos gting nas byon/ 'ol kha srib na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ nub cig gi rmi lam na kho bo la bu gcig 'dug pa 'di mgo bo bcad/ ro rbab la btang nas skye rgyud bcad do byas pa rmis/ gnyid sad nas 'jig rten na bu bas gces pa med de/ bu la yang ma chags bya ba yin snyam pa la de kho na bzhin byung*/ de nas 'jig rten 'di'i 'khri ba chod pa zhig byung gsung*/ 'brel ba'i dbang du byas na yang*/ tshul khrims snying po dang 'phags pa la sogs pa yin te/ 'di kun rang la dgos snyam pa'am gces snyam pa med/ re shig tsam khong gis nga la gtud pas de las ma btub gsung*/

slob ma rnams la yang 'di spang snyam pa dang*/ 'di dgos snyam pa med de thams cad la mnyam nyid cig las med gsung*/ rdzas dang yo byad rnams la'ang 'di nga la dgos snyam pa'am 'di yod na rung snyam pa med de/ re zhig dge 'dun spyi la dgos snyam nas thun (118)mong du bzung ba tsam las/ nga la 'di dgos snyam pa med gsung*/ yang nub zhig mi nag po zhig byung ba de bsad pa rmis/ de phyin chad bdud bzhi'i bar chad kyis mi tshugs sam snyam pa byung gsung*/ de phyin chad rmi lam ye rmis ma myong gsung*/ gnyid 'ong bar 'dug ste 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu 'gro bar 'dug gsung*/ de'i dus su nyang sgom dang zang ri ras pa la sogs pa'i 'khor rnams la mgur 'di gsungs so// chos nyid kyi klong nas dbyangs gcig len// ye shes kyi ngang du tshig cig 'debs// gnyis med kyi don 'di gtan la 'bebs// gzhan phan snying rje zhen med 'di// thabs kyi mchog tu btsir gyis bzung*// lhan cig skyes pa'i rnam shes 'di// ye shes yin par btsir gyis bzung*// nges shes skyes na de nyid yin// mtshan mar skyes pa'i rnam rtog 'di// chos sku yin par btsir gyi bzung*// nyams su myong na snying po mthong*// btags pa'i bag chags snang grags 'di// don dam yin par btsir gyis bzung*// brtan pa thob na bden pa mthong*// de yi don zhig rtogs 'dod na// chu bo'i rgyun bzhin nyams su long*// bcas bcos ma mang lhug par zhog /blta nyul ma byed rang gar zhog /yid la ma byed mi dmigs (119)zhog /nyams dang rtogs pa gcig tu mchi// rgyun chad med par rtogs na yin// nam mkha' lta bur mnyam na yin// rang sems sangs rgyas su mthong na yin// chos nyid mngon du rtogs sam snyam// mtshan ma rang sar grol lam snyam// ma bsam lhun gyis grub bam snyam// 'di phal dang phal gyi spyod yul min// thos pa che bas go ba min// shes rab che bas shes pa min// rtog ge ba yi spyod yul min// byin rlabs kyi lam la gnas pa yin// bla ma'i gsung la brten pa yin// dad pa can gyis rtogs pa yin/

de ltar lags so sgom chen kun// kun la smra ba'i rigs ma yin// ces gsungs so// lar nga la ni sgom rgyud la bskyed par byed pa la dka' las chen po byed dgos pa byung*/ da lta khyed rnams la ni tshegs med du skye zhing 'dug ste/ gdams ngag thabs lam 'di zab pa'i steng du/ bka' brgyud 'di la byin rlabs kyi babs chen po gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yod pas/ bsgoms nas bka' ba spyod nus na lam sna zin pa mang po 'ong bar 'dug gsung*/ bogs 'don pa dang bar chad sel ba dang*/ nyams myong rgyud la skye bar byed pa la lam zab mo bla ma'i lam gyi dbang bskur thob nas/ de kha yar bsgom pa dang*/ gtum mo dang phyag rgya chen po 'ba' zhig (120)bsgoms pas chog par 'dug gsung*/ gzhi der sgrub pa lo bdun nyams su blangs pas mi mang po 'dus nas thugs so ma bsod pas/ zang zing chen po byung ba'i yo byad rnams/ 'ol kha'i sde pa rnams la bgos te byin/ dbyar 'o de gung rgyal gyi gangs la bsgom du bzhugs bsam tsa na/ tho rangs kha cig dngos kyi gdul bya yal bar 'dor ba byang chub sems dpa'i ltung ba yin/ zer ba'i sgra zhig nam mkha' las byung*/ de nas ring zhig ma lon pa na/ rtsad po'i gzugs su 'dug pa la dar gyi thod chen po bcings pa/ mgul na g.yu chen po btags pa zhig byung nas/ de na re 'dir bzhugs na yon bdag ni ngas byed pa yin/ da mi bzhugs na nga'i bu dwags lha sgam po can du bzhud cig /khos khyed kyi thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs par byed kyis/ bdag mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dwags su song bas/ sems can la gnod pa skyel snyam pa med kyang mang po la gshis kyis gnod par 'dug pas/ sdig bshags shig kyang zhu/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyang thugs la btags par zhu zer/ der stobs bzhi'i sgo nas sdig pa bshags thabs dang*/ byams snying rje la blo sbyang thabs dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnang nas phyag rgya chen po'i sgom zhig gdab dgos snyam tsa na/

nam (121)mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin song*/ de nas dwags lha sgam por byon nas/ lo bcu gnyis su 'dag sbyar bya dgos snyam nas/ zangs lung du 'dag sbyar gyi khang pa legs pa zhig byas nas/ dang po chu'i bcud len bya dgos snyam tsa na/ chu mi 'dug nas/ ras sgom ras pas chu mi gda' zhus pas/ kha sang bsdad pa'i brag rtsa'i stan chung sol las ltos dang gsung*/ ras sgom ras pas chu skyogs khyer nas bzhugs gdan bsal bas/ de'i 'og na chu mig khog ma'i kha tsam zhig rdol nas 'dug /'di la gting ji tsam yod snyam nas bltas pa las/ gting mi 'dug ste rin po che'i zhal nas nga'i 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi mda' chu khron pa skyes dang 'dra gsungs nas rtogs ldan la dge sbyor dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan lnga'i mgur gsungs pa/ shes bya gshis kyi stong pa de// zhen pa bral yang don ma rtogs// gnyis 'dzin can gyi sgom chen de// nyams su myong yang don ma yin// rtogs pa med pa'i lta ba de// mtha' bral zer yang blos byas yin// gdos thag ma chod sgom chen de// ting 'dzin bzang yang 'khor ba'i rgyu// snying rje med pa'i chos pa de// 'bad rtsol byas kyang nyan thos lam// lar ni bla ma'i gdams ngag gces// de bas nyams su len pa gces// (122)zhes gsungs te/ 'dag sbyar bya dgos snyam tsa na/ bud med lus la thal ba byugs pa lag na rma bya'i sgro bzung ba zhig na re/ bcu gnyis 'dag sbyar byas pa bas// bcu gnyis bstan pa spel na dga'// zer nas mi snang ngo*// de nas zhag 'ga' lon nas/ gtsang gi klog skya ston pa bya ba 'jig rten chos brgyad la zhen cing tshul 'chos che ba zhig byung nas/ gdams ngag zhu zer ba la gsungs pa/ phung po sangs rgyas mnga' bdag de// zhen chags lus kyis ma bcings sam// gsang sngags nang gi spyod pa ste// dman pa'i spyod pas ma slad dam// dam tshig sdom pa srog shing ste// nyon mongs me yi ma bsregs sam// 'gro drug sems can mar gyur te// rang don phra mos ma spangs sam// rgyun mi chad pa'i bsam gtan te// spros pa'i g.yeng bas ma khyer ram// 'gyur med lta ba lhun grub ste// gnyis 'dzin mtha' ru ma lhung ngam// zhen med sgom pa bde gsal te// nyams myong gi rtsi la ma 'byar ram// spyod pa rang byung lhug pa ste// tshul 'chos kyi spyod pas ma slad dam// dus la ma bab brtul zhugs kyis// gsang sngags kyi dam tshig ma nyams sam// nang gi gdeng dang mi ldan par// las 'bras (123)khyad du ma bsad dam// yon tan mnga' ba'i sgom chen kun// nga rgyal gyi ri bos ma non nam// chos brgyad kyi sgrog tu ma tshud dam// tshe 'di'i lcags kyus ma bzung ngam// legs par soms dang sgom chen kun// ma mthong gi g.yang sar lhung nyen gda'o// zhes gsungs nas/

sgom gyi gdams ngag gnang nas sgom du bcug pas phyis chos brgyad chung du song nas sgom chen khyad par 'phags pa zhig byung ngo*// de nas zhag 'ga' na dge bshes rgyal ba khyung tshang can byung*/ de nas dge bshes gnyan nag byung*/ de nas snyags dmar po dang*/ de la sogs pa drug cu tsam 'dus/ de rnams kyi khrid tshar bar byas la 'tshams dam po bya dgos snyam tsa na/ dbus gtsang khams gsum gyis snod dang ldan pa'i gang zag rnams/ dus gcig la 'dus so// de rnams thams cad la yang ring por ma lon par nyams myong dpag tu med pa dang*/ rtsa rlung gi yon tan khyad par can yod pa dang*/ mngon par shes pa drug ka dus gcig la shar ba'i gang zag sha stag byung zhing*/ 'khor de rnams kyang ma dag pa'i dngos po brgyad mi 'chad zhing*/ tsog pu'i rnal 'byor la brtson zhing*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la gnas pa/ gsang spyod dang*/ smra bcad dang*/ (124)ri mtshams dang 'dag sbyar kho nas dus 'da' ba rnams byung ngo*// de'i dus su 'khor mang bas g.yengs nas thugs so ma bsod de/ stobs lung bya ba'i lung pa gnyan po mi ma yin mngon gsum du 'dus nas klag cor gyi sgras lung pa khengs pa zhig yod pa der bros nas bzhugs te/ 'khor rnams kyis 'dir 'ong mi nus snyam pa la/ khong 'ga' tsam byung bas 'di pa snying nas chos byed par 'dug dgongs nas/ khyod rnams lus srog la ma ltos par 'dir 'ongs phyin chad chos gang 'dod pa sbyin no gsungs pas khong rnams na re ci gnang ba zhig zhu zer ba la/ chos 'di mgur du gsungs so// na mo gu ru/ yun ring mi sdod 'chi bar nges kyis thar pa myur du sgrubs// nyi ma nub pa'i grib so bzhin du mi rtag pha rol 'gro nges kyis// le lo snyoms las spongs las brtson 'grus drag po me bzhin spor// tshe la blo gtad med par nges kyis rgyun par nyams su long*// nyams su blangs na blo dang bral ba'i nyams rtogs dus gcig 'char// rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung bar nges kyis las 'bras khyad mi bsad// ngan song sdug bsngal dran par gyis la gnyen po drag tu bskyed// rang nyid gcig pu thar par 'dod na theg dman nyan thos chos yin pas// ma yi (125)drin dran gyis la byams dang snying rje rgyun du sgoms// byang sems sems can sgrol ba'i smon pa drag tu sgoms// goms par byas na rang la ltos med gzhan phan shugs kyis 'byung*// rang rgyud gting nas 'byongs shing sgrib pa gnyis po shugs kyis mdzad// chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam gzugs brnyan lta bur ni// go bar gyis la tshe 'di'i 'dod dang zhen pa zil gyis gnon// de ltar goms na rang blo gting nas ldog

/rang blo ma log gang zag de dag gis// nyon mongs bsal nas thar pa thob mi 'gyur// zhes gsung zhing lar gang zag gi sems kyi ngo bo cir yang ma grub par shes na/ de'i ngang la bzhag pa de las lhag pa ci yang med de/ rnam par rtog pa phra mo byung yang mi lto// de rang la bltas pas tshur log nas 'ong*/ sems kyi ngo bo ci yang ma yin pa las lhag pa gang yang med de/ rtog med kyi ting 'dzin nam mkha' ltar chal gyis song ba dang*/ rig pa'i ngang las ma yengs pa gnyis gang dga' lta ste/ rtog med lung ma bstan du 'dug pa des don mi 'grub/ de bas tha mal gyi shes pa dga'/ yang nam mkha'i khams thams cad lha dang lha mos gang ba la/ de rnams kyis bdag yar drangs te/ de rnams dang bdag tha mi (126)dad du gyur pa gnyis gang dga' blta ste/ de rnams de ltar snang yang*/ sems kyi 'khrul snang 'gyur ba can yin pas/ de bas kyang tha mal gyi shes pa rang dga'/ yang rang nyid sangs rgyas su byas te/ sku mtshan dpe la sogs pas brgyan pa 'ja' tshon ltar gsal ba byung yang*/ de blos byas bskyed pa'i rim pa yin pas/ de bas kyang tha mal gyi shes pa dga'/ gzhan gyis rang lhar mthong yang de bas kyang tha mal gyi shes pa dga'/ yang mtshan nyid pa'am bka' gdams pa ltar/ bzung 'dzin gnyis ka gzhi ma grub par skye med du byas nas/ snang ba sna tshogs dkar dmar 'di la yid kyis snang ba a cang che na/ mig gis kyang ma mthong bar chos thams cad nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil ltar gyur kyang*/ de yang blos byas kyi stong pa shes bya'i gshis la shor ba bya ba yin te/ de bas kyang tha mal gyi shes pa rang dga'/ tha mal gyi shes pa nyams su myong ba la gsang sngags nas/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// chos de rnams gnang skad/ de nas sgam por gdan drangs nas sgom chen pa rnams kyis chos zhus pa'i dus su/

rin po che'i gsungs nas nga'i bka' gdams (127)kyi bla ma rnams kyi zhal nas/ stong nyid rtogs na rgyu 'bras la zhib cha cher 'gro gsung ba shin tu bden par gda'/ lar bka' gdams kyi bla ma rnams la'ang chos kyi babs chen po zhig 'dug /da khyed rnams kyang nga'i kha lta 'di la nyon cig gsungs nas/ zhal lta tshogs chos kyi mgur 'di bzhengs so// yongs dgra la zhe sdang che ba dang gcig /gnyen la gdungs sems che ba dang gnyis// nor la zhen chags che ba dang gsum// de gsum chos pa'i spang bya lags// chos gsha' ma zhig byed na 'di gsum spongs// snying nas mdzad na 'di gsum spongs// lho tshong byang du skyel ba dang*// rkang leb bran du 'khol ba gnyis// lung stong gi grogs bur g.yeng ba gsum// de gsum chos pa'i chos brgyad yin// chos gsha' ma zhig byed na 'di gsum spongs// snying nas mdzad na 'di gsum spongs// ston pa rgas pa'i bza' dpon dang*// zhen log rgas pa'i gsog 'jog dang*// rtogs ldan rgas pa'i slob gnyer gsum// de gsum chos pa'i bla 'tshong yin// chos gsha' ma zhig byed na 'di gsum spongs// snying nas mdzad na 'di gsum spongs// mang po thos pa'i tshig yus dang*// gcig por bsdad pa'i bsgom yus dang*// dka' thub byas pa'i (128)ltogs yus gsum// 'di gsum chos pa'i khong sran yin// chos gsha' ma zhig byed na 'di gsum spongs// snying nas mdzad na 'di gsum spongs// sdig zas khra bo'i sha dang gcig /myos byed ser mo'i chang dang gnyis// bslu byed na chung gzhon dang gsum// 'di gsum chos pa'i btsan dug yin// chos gsha' ma zhig byed na 'di gsum spongs// snying nas mdzad na 'di gsum spongs// ma mthong mngon shes 'chad pa dang*// dmangs po'i sri'u gso ba dang*// mi thub nad pa'i sngas bsrung gsum// 'di gsum chos pa'i sad khyer yin// chos gsha' ma zhig byed na 'di gsum spongs// snying nas mdzad na 'di gsum spongs// zhes gsungs so// de yan chad rang snang gis bsdus pa'i yon tan no// gzhan snang gis bsdus pa'i yon tan ni/

gzhan yang skyes bu chen po des ngo mtshar ba'i spyod pa snang ba dang mi snang ba dang*/ mang po gcig tu mdzad pa dang*/ gcig mang por sprul pa la sogs pa/ sku'i bkod pa'i rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mdzad de/ de yang dwags po lha sa ba na re/ bla ma rin po ches dgun zla ra ba'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin par dwags po lha sar byon nas/ bcu bzhi nyin par sta gon mdzad/ (129)bco lnga la me tog gtor/ bcu drug la gtang rag gi mchod pa dang*/ chos ston dang 'bul ba rgya chen po byas so// zhes bcu bdun gyi nyin par gsung rab mang po dang*/ nas sha mar snam bu mang po la sogs pa longs spyod kyi 'bul ba rgya chen po sgam por bskyal nas de rnams kyis bsngo ba yang mdzad/ gral de ma zhig par yon bdag dge 'bum 'khor bcas byung nas bla ma chen po chos nged la thugs la btags pas tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin par sta gon byas/ bco lnga'i nyin par me tog gtor/ bcu drug la gtang rag dang chos ston 'bul ba byas nas dpon slob mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs/ ngo mtshar re che zer nas sha thud mang po'i 'bul ba yang bskyal/ yon bdag de'i bsngo ba yang mdzad do// gzhi la yod pa'i grwa pa rnams na re/ rin po che ni dus dang rnam pa thams cad du sku mtshams la gnas pa yin pa la/ dgun zla ra ba'i bcu gsum la mtshams phyung nas/ bcu bzhi'i nyin mtshan la gtsang pa rnams la khrid mdzad/ bco lnga'i nyin mtshan la khams pa rnams la khrid mdzad/ bcu drug gi nyin mtshan la dbus pa rnams la khrid mdzad de/ bla ma rin po che ni gang du yang ma bzhud zer ro// nye gnas gsal byang dang*/ sgom pa legs mdzes dang*/ sho sgom byang yes gsum na re/ (130)bla ma rin po che ni zla ba gsum la chos kyang ma bshad gar yang ma bzhud/ gsol zas kyang ma gsol/ smra bcad mdzad de skyo sangs la yang ma bzhengs/ gzims mal kho nar bzhugs shing 'dug zer ro// yang dus gcig gi tshe na sgom pa legs mdzes kyis/

sngon gyi nyan thos rnams kyis ni zad pa dang*/ zil gnon gyi ting nge 'dzin mang po 'grub par 'dug /da lta mi 'grub par 'dug pa 'di cis lan zhus pas/ des sems sbyong mi nus pas lan pa yin mod/ bsgrubs na mi 'grub pa'i don med gsung*/ de'i nangs par zho la bu ram blug nas 'dren du song tsa na/ bla ma'i gzim mal na me chen po zhig 'bar zhing thog la reg reg 'dug /khong de la bred nas gsal byang sbran nas phyin tsa na me mi 'dug zad par me yis ting nge 'dzin bstan par 'dug ste/ bla ma nyid kyi skur snang ngo*// yang lan gcig gi tshe mar me 'ga' byas nas mchod khang du skyel phyin pas/ mchod khang chus mer gyis khengs nas 'dug /de ci yin nam snyam nas se gol 'ga' byas nas/ bla ma'i gsungs nas yar shog gsung ste chu'i snang ba med par gyur to// yang nyin gcig dro'i rjes la steng khang na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ yon bdag dar rgyal byung nas/ rin po che la ja 'di 'bul (131)'dod zer/ de zhur phyin pas gser gyi mchod rten 'od lhag ge 'dug /yon bdag la ston dgos snyam nas khrid song tsa na bla ma nyid bzhugs nas 'dug /yang dus gcig gi tshe na/ dgra bzhi lam khyer gyi gdams ngag 'di zhu snyam nas gtor ma zhig khyer te song tsa na nang dang phyi rol gang na yang mi bzhugs par 'dug /de nas khyod ci 'dod yar shog gsungs nas/ bla ma gzim mal na bzhugs nas 'dug /de rnams ni zad par me dang chu dang sa dang nam mkha'i ting nge 'dzin ni phyogs re tsam bstan pa yin no// yang dge bshes khams pa na re slob dpon sgom pa la/ bla ma rin po che la grib ma med pa khyed kyis rtogs sam gsung*/ nub mo mar me la bltas kyang grib ma mi 'dug /nyin par nyi ma la bltas kyang grib ma mi 'dug ste/ dus thams cad du grib ma med pa yin gsung*/ gzhan yang nam mkha' la skyil krung mdzad pa dang*/ brag ri chen po la thal byung du gshegs pa la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul mang po mdzad cing*/

yang 'bro khyi rdzi'i 'khrug pa bsdum pa la byon pas/ sgom chen rnams sngon la btang bla mas 'ja' la chibs te byon pas 'khrug pa thams cad rang zhir gyur to// yang lan gcig sgom pa blo bstan gyis shog gu 'bum tshar zhig 'bul du byung ba/ (132)spyan sngar btang tsa na phyir log nas byung nas/ khyed kyi thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong gi lder tsho 'di'i bzo bo su yin lags/ bla ma gang na bzhugs nga la ston zer/ legs mdzes kyis khrid nas song tsa na bla ma nyid bzhugs nas 'dug go /yang dus gcig gi tshe na/ ros skam pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis stong 'bul byas shing spangs su khri brtsigs/ mang skol byas/ sgom pa sher gzhon spyan 'dren du song bas/ khyod rang sngon la ber thul khur las song*/ nye gnas kun mi 'dug pas was khyim slog pas ngas sgo bcad la 'ong gis gsung*/ sher gzhon sngon la song nas 'phrang khar bsgugs te bsdad tsa na yun du ma byon/ mar bltas pas khri thog tu phebs nas 'dug /lam gzhan la byon pa ni med pa la ci yin snyam nas 'ongs tsa na/ ban de stong tsam gyi 'bul ba byed pa yang tshar nas 'dug go /yon bdag la sogs pas sher gzhon la rgol du byung ste/ khyed kyis rin po che sku gser du bcug /thang la bzhugs su bcug nas 'dug zer skad/ dus bzang thams cad kyi tshe gzims khang la 'ja' tshon zug 'ong ba mi phal cher dag bar dor 'od gsal mngon du gyur ba'i rtags yin zer/ rje nyid la zhus pas/ de'i tshe ḍā ki ma rnams 'dus te byung ba yin gsung*/ (133)yang btsag 'byung gnas ye shes kyis gdan drangs te 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes pa las/ nangs par kho bo mi 'gro btsun chung gcig nga'i tsar zhog /khyed rang kun song gsung ste phyin pa na/ bla ma sngon la phebs 'dug ste/ chos ston grol nas yar phyin tsa na/ rje nyid gang du yang ma byon par btsun chung la chos shin tu dmar ba gsungs 'dug ste sku'i bkod pa bstan pa'o// yang dus gcig gi tshe slob dpon sgom pas/

bla ma rin po che la byang chub sems dpa' sa dang po bas stong gsum rdul phra rab gcig tu bcug pas rdul cher ma song*/ stong gsum chung du ma song zer ba de rang mtshar zhus pas de la mtshar rgyu med/ shes bya'i chos nyid yin pas kun rdzob kyi snang ba la ci yang nyan/ mi'i mig yung 'bru tsam gyi nang du mtho gang gi gzugs tshud/ me long sor bzhi pa'i nang du rta dang glang po'i gzugs tshud/ chu phor gang gi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang nam mkha' yongs tshud/ kho bo la ltos dang gsungs te/ bla ma nyid byang chub chen po'i sku sgam po'i ri bas che ba zhig tu gyur nas 'dug pa/ gzims spyil mi lnga las mi shong ba de'i nang du tshud nas 'dug go /yang nyin gcig nyi ma gzas zin pa la shing spangs su mang skol zhig byas/ dge 'dun stong tsam tshogs nas yod pa'i tshe/ (134)rin po che pas kyang yang dgon gyi thang kha'i nam mkha' la byon/ bum chu mang po gtor zhing phar bzhud tshur bzhud mdzad pa thams cad kyis mthun par mthong*/ yang mgar sgom dkar pos lha bcu gsum ma'i lung zhus pas/ de bya gsungs nas lha bcu gsum ma'i 'phreng sngags zhal nas nar gyis gsungs pas 'od zer kha dog mang po byung nas mgar sgom gyi snying khar thim/ der mgar sgom gyis phyag 'tshal mos gus byas pas bla ma nyid bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par gyur nas 'dug pa mthong*/ yang dus gcig gi tshe na skyo sgom gyi ma shi nas dge rtsa la rigs lnga tshar gcig bzhengs nas/ bla ma'i spyan sngar gdan drangs te/ 'di rnams la rab gnas myur po zhig zhu dgos/ nga ma'i ro sreg pa la rings par bdog zhus pas/ 'o de bya spos reng zhig sregs maṇḍal zhig phul gsung*/ de ma thag bla ma byang chub chen por gyur nas 'dug pa'i/ dbu'i gtsug tor las 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bu byung nas sku rnams la so sor zug pas dril shing kun khrol di ri ri 'dug

/nam mkha' la gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dang rol mo'i sgra mang po dang*/ me tog gi char mang po 'bab pa'i snang ba skyo sgom la byung*/ de nas bla mas spyan har gyis phye nas rab gnas myur po byed na (135)de tsug byed pa yin/ da rgyugs shig gsung ngo*// yang slob dpon sgom pas ro gcig gi rnal 'byor rgyud la skyes dus su lus sems snang ba gsum gcig tu 'dres bya ba de ji ltar lags zhus pas/ mdun na ka ba zhig yod pa la phyag yug mdzad pas nam mkha' la g.yugs pa bzhin du/ thogs pa med par phyal phyal 'dug ste de gsum 'dres lugs 'di ltar 'dre ba yin gsungs/ yang dus cig na zab kyi gtsang po la bzhud tsa na/ chu'i steng du gding ba gting nas phyag g.yon pas 'phreng ba bgrang*/ g.yas pas chu sbyin mdzad cing bzhud pa dang*/ yang bre gu'i ri la bzhugs pa'i dus/ rtsad po lha sgom gyi rab gnas mdzad pas/ me tog rnams rten la rang 'byar du song ba dang*/ me tog gi snod lhung bzed nam mkha' la bzhag pa dang*/ yang slob dpon sgom tshul gyis rlung lag sor la ston nas/ spos rgya'i thal ba spur ba la nga rgyal cung zad skyes pa mkhyen nas nangs par chos gos nyi zer la bkal te/ ngas kyang 'di ltar byas nas 'ong ste nga rgyal du song na chos par mi 'gro /de kun phral gyi yon tan yin/ mthar thug gi yon tan chos thams cad skye med du rtogs pa las yong ba yin/ de kun nga rgyal rdul tsam yang ma byed cig gsung*/ yang lha sgom la (136)sogs pa'i mi brgya tsam gyis thugs rje chen po kha sarpa ṇi mthong ba'i snang ba mthun par byung ba dang*/ yang dben phug na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ nye gnas legs mdzes la nga la zhag bdun du gtam ma byed cig gsungs nas/ rtsig pa la thogs med du phar bzhud tshur bzhud mdzad pa dang*/ keng rus kyi mi chen po zhig tu sprul nas/ g.yas na gri khug g.yon thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga phrag la bkal stag la zhon te/

ḍom bhi he ru ka ni stag la zhon// lus ngan bu mo rab tu mchod// dur khrod gnas ni khyad par rgyu// deng yin zer ba ma yin te// zhes gsung zhing nam mkha' la bzhugs so// yang chos gos rnam gsum bsnams nas bzhengs te/ zhabs kyi rting pa gnyis sprad/ bdud rtsi thal sbyor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor mdzad nas zhag gsum bzhugs pa la nub dang po la sku bdun du snang*/ gnyis pa la bcu bzhir snang*/ gsum pa la gzims khang tham 'gag nam 'gag gang nas 'dug tsa na/ yang skad cig de la sku de rnams mi snang bar gyur to// gzhan yang zhag gcig la srog rtsol lan gnyis dgag pas chog pa dang*/ nyams rtogs phul ba dang*/ gegs sel ba dang*/ gdams ngag la sogs pa ci zhus kyang*/ gtor ma bshams maṇḍal phul te 'phrul 'khor bcas nas bsdad (137)pa tsam gyis dri mi dgos par so so rang rang gi sems la ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin gsung la/ de la sogs pa gzhan gyi sems shes pa'i mngon par shes pa rgya chen po mnga' ste/ de dag gi shes lugs rnams bris na zad pa med de/ cung zad tsam las 'dir ma bris so// gzhan yang zhal phu gnyan na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ tshes bco lnga'i zla ba shar nas en cig lon pa na/ gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin gtibs pa lta bu'i dbus na chos gsung zhing bzhugs pa dge bshes khams pas gzigs te/ bstod pa yang mdzad/ yang bla ma'i gzims khang du bud med kyi gad mo rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba dang*/ yang sgom chen zhig gis ri zur cig tu khams bsang la phyin pas bla ma'i sku mdun na/ bud med mang po bro brdung zhing 'dug ste phyin tsa na su yang mi snang*/ de rnams ni ye shes kyi ḍā ki dus rgyun par 'du ba yin gsung*/ yang gnyan na bzhugs pa'i dus su dbrong kha'i dus mchod la byon pa dang*/ ya gir bzhugs pa mthun snang zhig tu byung bas/ dge bshes khams pas ji ltar lags zhus pa'i tshe/ de la dka' rgyu med rtogs pa phyogs gnyis su bkye bas chog pa yin mod gsungs/

da res zhu ba'i skabs zhig byung snyam nas/ bla ma rin po che'i sprul pa ci tsam mdzad pa (138)lags zhus pas/ ngas sems can re'i mdun du sprul pa mi 'dra ba re 'gyed kyang dka' las med gsung ste/ der kho bo'i dri rgyu zad pa yin gsungs/ gzhan yang u rgyan la sogs pa mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas su byon pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa mdzad pa dang*/ sku'i bkod pa du ma dus gcig tu bstan pa la sogs pa dpag tu med de 'dir ni cung zad tsam mo// de'i dus su tshogs pa yang mang du 'dus/ bla ma rin po che la sku bsod dpag tu med pa la/ dge bshes bya yul pas sdig pa cung zad bsags pas/ rje'i zhal nas khong rang la mi gnod kyang*/ khong gi lad mo gzhan gyis byas pas ngan song du skye ba'i las gsog /kho bo sa phyogs gzhan zhig tu 'gro bar rung gsung ba la/ slob ma thun mong ba zhig na re/ khong rang dang 'brel ba zhig bgyis na mi 'thad lags sam zhu ba la de yang gros yin gsungs nas dpon slob kha yar zhig bya yul du byon/ bya yul mig gis mthong ba'i ne'u thang zhig tu bzhugs te/ kho bos khong la ting nge 'dzin ci lta bu zhig 'dug blta'o gsungs nas/ cung zhig lon pa na khong la sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin ni mnga' bar 'dug gsungs/ de nas mjal te chos kyi gsung gleng mdzad pas/ gcig la gcig shin tu dgyes chos (139)kyang phar zhu tshur zhu mdzad/ bya yul ba sngar sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mnga' ba la/ phyis nam mkha' lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin du gyur/ rab tu gnas pa'i gdams pa zab mo shog dril ma yang gnang*/ de nas rab gnas bya yul ba'i lugs su mdzad/ kho bo'i chos kyis kyang khong la phan par byung 'dug /khong gi chos kyis kyang kho bo la phan par byung gsung*/ yang lan cig bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga'i rmi lam na sgam po'i ri rtse thams cad dar dmar po re re phyar/ dar thogs pa'i bud med mang po gar byed cing*/

de yang sgam po kho na las gzhan du mi 'gro ba rmis te/ sgam po 'di yang phyogs thams cad du grags pa dang kho bo'i tshe gzhug kyang 'di rang du sdod pa zhig 'ong bar 'dug gsung*/ yang dus gcig gi tshe na dge bshes khyung tshang pa'i bsam pa la/ bla ma rin po ches kyang ban gsar btsun chung 'di rnams la dang por thos bsam bag re byed du mi 'jug par/ 'bag btsog tsam yang mi shes par 'dug pa la/ sgom kho na bstan kyang yon tan cang skye'am snyam pa la/ de'i nub mo khong gi rmi lam na sgam po'i ri thams cad brag phug gis gang nas 'dug pa la/ de rnams kyi nang na rin po che'i mchod rten mang po 'dug pa la/ phal cher gzo shin tu legs pa la 'od zer (140)nam mkha' la 'phro ba kho na 'dug /la la ni bzo phyed tsam tshar bar 'dug /la la ni gzugs dod pa tsam la dkar chab kyis gsol zhing*/ mi mang pos phyag 'tshal nas 'di rnams 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa'i mchod gnas yin zer ba rmis/ der khong gis bla ma la zhus pas/ phyag byed cing yod pa la zhu ma khom par/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ spyir yang bka' gdams kyi mtshan nyid pa khyed tsho nga la sdang*/ dgos khyed kyis nga la brnyas pa chen po byas te/ nga'i btsun chung 'di tsho yang khyod rang gi rmi lam rmis pa kho na bzhin du yod pa yin/ ban gsar sprang phrug 'di kun kyang lha dang bcas pa'i mchod gnas su 'ong ba yin/ kho bo la ni che reg cher 'tshengs/ chung reg chung ngu 'tshengs pa yin/ mi la la kho bos bstan pa bsnubs zer ba yod de/ bstan pa'i bdag po su yin/ bstan pa la sus phan/ sems can gyi don sus byas/ nyi 'og gi rgyal khams 'di na bstan pa sus bsrungs/ rang re tsho da lta'i lo 'ga' na gsal nas 'ong*/ lar mi la la zhig kho bos 'dus byas khyad du bsad pas chad lta ba yin zer ba'ang yod de/ bya bya chos spyod cog ma myong gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bde mchog dang*// rje btsun rdo rje (141)rnal
