'byor ma// mkha' 'gro rje btsun dmar chung gsum// 'di bskyed rim bsgom pa'i lha gsum yin// bcom ldan 'phags pa rta mgrin dang*// sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo gnyis// bdag bskyed phyag na rdo rje gsum// 'di bar chad sel ba'i lha gsum yin// chos skyong dpal chen mgon po dang*// bran mo mnga' bdag chen po gnyis// gnod sbyin las mkhan rgyal po gsum// 'di 'phrin las sgrub pa'i lha gsum yin// gsol 'debs maṇḍal 'bul ba dang*// zab mo gsang sngags bzlas brjod gnyis// tshogs gsog chu sbyin gtor ma gsum// 'di 'dus byas bya byas chos spyod yin// bskyed rim lha yi rnal 'byor dang*// zab mo rtsa rlung rdzogs rim gnyis// zung 'jug snang stong dbyer med gsum// 'di thun bzhir bsgom pa'i chos gsum yin// gnyid dang bsam gtan bsre ba dang*// rmi lam lam du slongs pa gnyis// sgyu lus 'pho ba sbyang ba gsum// 'di mtshan mo thun gyi chos gsum yin// ma bsgoms sangs rgyas 'pho ba dang*// zab mo grong 'jug rlung sems dang*// sgyu lus me long gzugs brnyan gsum// 'di nyin mo thun mtshams kyi chos gsum yin// bar do bsre ba'i mtshams sbyor dang*// ngo sprod phyag rgya chen po gnyis// (142)gdams ngag lhan cig skyes sbyor gsum// 'di rgyun du bsgom pa'i chos gsum yin// mi nged dang nged cag mi zer te// nged ni gcan gzan seng ge'i bu// ma yi mngal nas rtsal gsum rdzogs// ma 'gro bu 'gro mnyam du 'gro

/ma dang mnyam por gangs khrod 'grim// gcan gzan tshogs kyang nyam mi nga*// mi nged dang nged cag mi zer te// nged ni 'dab chags khyung gi bu// sgo nga'i nang nas gshog drug rdzogs// ma 'phur bu 'phur mnyam du 'phur// ma dang mnyam por nam 'phangs gcod// 'dab chags tshogs kyang nyam mi nga*// mi nged dang nged cag mi zer te// nged ni rtogs ldan bla ma'i bu// ngo sprod cig char btab tsa na// pha 'tshengs bu 'tshengs mnyam por 'tshengs// blo dman phal la ci cha yod// ces gsungs so// gzhan yang bdag nyid chen po de la mthong thos dran reg gis smin grol la 'god pa'i yon tan yod de/ ra rdzi sgom skyes kyis mtshan thos pa tsam gyis bsgom byung ba dang*/ rgya sgom rdo rje seng ges zhal ye ma mthong yang*/ maṇḍal phul mos gus byas pa tsam gyis bsgom byung ba dang*/ nam pa 'phan ne la sogs pa mi mang pos zhal mthong ba tsam gyis bsgom byung ba dpag tu med do// yang nyang ston dang (143)sher bsgom gnyis kyis sgom zhur phyin pas/ sgam por ma bslebs par de nub ri thang mtshams su nyal bsdad pas/ srod la nyang ston la phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa skyes/ tho rangs sher bsgom la rtogs pa skyes/ nangs par bla ma'i spyan sngar phyin te/ snam bu bubs re'i phyag rten byas phyag 'tshal zhing yod pa la/ bla ma'i zhal nas mdang khyed gnyis kyi don 'grub ang gsungs/ yang 'ol kha'i mdze mo zhig rkang lag chad nas 'gro ba'i nus pa med pas/ bla ma bzhugs pa'i gangs dkar rong nge ba la bltas nas mos gus byas pas nad sos/ ma hā mu dra'i sgom skyes drod rang 'bar la song*/ phyis bla mas snod ldan du gzigs te bsgom btab pas/ dpe'u chung du btsun ma ngo mtshar can zhig tu gyur nas/ ban mo lnga brgya tsam gyi tshogs dpon byed pa zhig byung ngo*// gzhan yang skyes bu chen po de nyid gang du byon yang 'ja' 'od kyis lam sna 'dren cing*/

gang dang gang du gshegs pa der mi nad phyugs nad yams nad la sogs pa thams cad rgyun chad cing*/ bkra shis bde legs dang ldan par mdzad pa yin te/ de ltar yang khams pa rin po che'i bstod pa las kyang*// khyod ni mthong thos dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// sdug bsngal zug rngu ma lus gcod (144)par byed// sman pa'i rgyal po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes 'byung*/ yang 'bro dmar yu ba bya bas dang por dge slong byas gtum mo'i khrid rdzogs par zhus/ phyis las dbang gis khyim thab byas bu smad mang po yod/ phag mang po gsos/ nyin par chang dang sgog pa la zas byed/ mtshan mo gnyid sad pa dang*/ gtum mo dang phyag rgya chen po sgom pa zhig yod pa ste/ ci zhig na nad drag pos zin nas 'chi khar song ba dang*/ spun zla kun gyis da khyod 'chi bar 'dug pa/ sdom pa shor dam tshig nyams/ rin po che'i gsung bcag sdig pa ni khyod las che ba med de dge bshes nam pa 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po bos la 'bul ba bya/ skyabs 'gro zhu dgos byas pas de rung zer/ dge bshes bos te 'bul ba byas/ skyabs 'gro zhus pas nad pa na re/ nga'i bla ma rin po che'i skyabs 'gro dang mi mthun par 'dug zer/ khyod kyi rin po ches ji skad gsung byas pas/ nga'i rin po che'i zhal nas/ sems kyi chos nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar rtogs na/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song ba yin/ spyod lam rnam bzhir mnyam rjes med par dus thams cad du nyams myong dran shes kyi thag pas bzung nas mnyam rjes med na chos la skyabs su song ba yin/ de'i ngang nas dge ba ci byed (145)theg pa chen po'i lam du song zhing*/ sems can gyi don 'ba' zhig byed na dge 'dun la skyabs su song ba yin gsungs pas/ ngas de kho na bzhin du byas/ khyed kyi de kha tshig gi skyabs 'gro tsam du 'dug pa zer/ der dge bshes na re/ re sdug re sdug /'di dmyal bar 'gro bar 'dug

/nga'i chos la log lta skyes zer nas song*/ de nas 'bro dmar yu ba shi ste ro bsregs pas/ ring bsrel kha dog sna lnga phul la 'jal bas chog pa byung*/ du ba thams cad 'ja'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ sgal tshigs la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mtshon gang ba zhig byon/ de la sogs pa'i sdig po che mang po mjal ba tsam gyis bltas bzang po dang bcas te shi song ba la zad pa med do// gzhan yang thugs kyi sras chen po zangs ri ras pas/ bdag lan cig yul du 'gro bar zhu zhus pas/ mgur gsungs pa// yongs stongs pa med pa'i 'khor ba dang*// zin pa med pa'i so nams gnyis// zad pa med pa'i long gtam gsum// 'di gsum yang dam pa'i chos dang 'gal// mi bdag gis kyang rgyab tu bskyur nas bzhag /khyed rang yang rgyab tu bskyur na legs// gzhi bdag tu bzung ba'i dgon pa dang*// ngo bsrung dgos pa'i yon bdag gnyis// kha lan re ba'i tshogs (146)gsog gsum// 'di gsum yang dam pa'i chos dang 'gal// mi bdag gis kyang rgyab tu bskyur nas bzhag /khyed rang yang rgyab tu bskyur na legs// yon tan med pa'i slob dpon dang*// mos gus med pa'i slob ma gnyis// smra zhing gshe ba'i mched grogs gsum// 'di gsum yang dam pa'i chos dang 'gal// mi bdag gis kyang rgyab tu bskyur nas bzhag /khyed rang yang rgyab tu bskyur na legs// pha yul bdud kyi btson ra dang*// sdug sogs byas pa'i nor rdzas gnyis// mgu ba med pa'i ngo srung gsum// 'di gsum yang dam pa'i chos dang 'gal// mi bdag gis kyang rgyab tu bskyur nas bzhag /khyed rang yang rgyab tu bskyur na legs// grogs cir mi 'ong ba'i dungs sems dang*// dgra snying du sdug pa'i bu tsha gnyis// don med kyi sa mtha' skor ba gsum// 'di gsum yang dam pa'i chos dang 'gal// mi bdag gis kyang rgyab tu bskyur nas bzhag /khyed rang yang rgyab tu bskyur na legs// zhes gsungs pas blo 'gyur te bla ma sku ma 'das kyi bar du bsten pa yin skad/

yang dus skabs shig na/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ sgom pa tshul khrims snying po dang shes rab byang chub gnyis la/ (147)kho bo dang khu mtshan yin snyam ste/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog yin ang*/ nga skye mtha'i byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma bar gda' gsungs// yang byar lkog na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ sher bsgom byang yes dbu mdzad pa'i nye gnas rnams la/ da ni kho bo yang 'jig rten du yun ring po mi sdod pas/ chos lhag ma zhu bar 'dod pa dang*/ dri rgyu yod pa rnams myur du dris shig /'on kyang nyams su len par 'dod na tshig mang mi dgos pas nga'i gdams ngag 'di yid la zhog cig gsungs nas/ phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa mgur du gsungs pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku// thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs bcur rab bkyes pas// bdag blo snying gi mun pa sel mdzad pa'i// dus gsum bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// e ma rang rig ye shes skyong 'dod na// ras bal bzhin du shes pa glod las zhog /bya ba thongs la sems la rten ma bca'// shes pa ched du ma 'gugs yan par thongs// bying rgod byung na de nyid rang la ltos// sems la gnod pa'i las rnams khad kyis spongs// zhe 'dod byung na bdud du shes par gyis// ma bcos gzhag pa'i sems ni sangs rgyas yin// bcos ma'i sems ni rgyal ba'i dgongs pa min// nyin (148)mtshan 'gro 'chag kun tu lhug par zhog /de ltar bzhag pa'i sems nyid de// gsal la 'dzin med nam mkha' 'dra// phyogs su ma lhung lta ba yin/ nyam nga med pa shugs las byung*/ dag cing dri med shel sgong 'dra// gsal la 'dzin med sgom pa yin// rgyun chad med pa shugs las byung*// ma bcos lhug pa bu chung 'dra// zhen pa bral ba spyod pa yin// dgag sgrub med pa shugs las byung*// rgyu 'bras dus mtshungs a mṛ ta// re dwogs med pa 'bras bu yin// rang byung lhun grub shugs las byung*// de ltar rang sems sangs rgyas ma lags pa// phyogs bcu dus gsum ma lus gang la yang*// sangs rgyas phyi nas btsal bas rnyed mi 'gyur// de bas rang gi sems la blta ba goms par gyis// zhes gsungs so// de ltar drang srong chen po de la skye 'chi'i 'jigs pa mi mnga' na yang*/

gdul bya le lo can rnams lam la bskul ba'i phyir/ cung zad snyung ba'i tshul bstan te/ snyung zug ni med/ gsol zas cher mi gsol/ sku shed cung zad chung bar gyur pa la/ sgom pa legs mdzes thugs ma bde nas/ sku khams bde'am mi bde zhes dris pa'i lan gsungs pa/ (149)bla ma dam pa'i mtshan thos nas// tshe 'di blo yis btang nas kyang*// 'jig rten chos brgyad yal bar dor// chags zhen med pa'i rnal 'byor bde// blo 'das kyi lta ba mtha' bral te// dran med bdud kyis ma bzos tsam// bde stong sgom pa zhen med de// rtog med ltengs pos ma bslus tsam// shugs 'byung spyod pa gtad med de// gnyis 'dzin gyi mtha' ru ma lhung tsam// 'bras bu sems nyid 'od gsal de// phyi dus kyi yid smon du ma lus tsam// blo las 'das pa'i chos nyid de// yin min tshig dang bral bas bde// yod med mtha' las 'das pas bde// nang nas shar bas ngo mtshar che// nyams su myong ba e ma ho// zhes gsungs te/ 'dus byas mi rtag par ston pa dang*/ gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams byang chub la skul bar bya ba'i phyir/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul ston pa'i zla ba phyed tsam gyis gong nas/ kho bo skyes chen po zhig 'degs pas gdams ngag lhag ma rnams dang dri rgyu yod pa tsho dris shig gsungs/ sgom chen pa rnams kyi bsam pa la zhal kyal yin snyam nas 'dug go /dge ba'i bshes gnyen khams pa ston pa'i gsal snang la shar nas/ bla ma dam pa 'di lta bu'i spyan sngar zhag re sdod pa la yang dka' las (150)dpag tu med pas/ khyed rnams kyang rgyu 'grul ma byed par/ gdams ngag lhag ma rnams kyang zhus shig gsungs nas/ grogs po yul phyogs la 'gro 'dod pa rnams kyang bshol btab/ de'i lo la thabs lam la sogs pa'i chos gang zhus kyang*/ phyag rgya chen po 'ba' zhig 'debs/ de'i dus su phyag rgya chen po'i ngang las tha mal gyi snang ba ye med par 'dug ste/

de nye gnas rnams kyis zhu ba go ma chod pas/ phyis sgom chen pa rnams la ma mnyes skad/ yang zhal 'dzum mdzad nas khyed kyis mthong ngam nga rang gis mthong gsungs/ de'i dus na sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dpag tu med pa gzigs yod par 'dug ste zhu ba ma spobs skad/ ston zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig la tshogs chos shig gsungs/ de nas tshes bcu gsum gyi bar du rgyun du bzhad cing sku khams shin tu bde bar gyur/ de'i tshe slob dpon sgom pas bla ma rin po che gal te sku mya ngan las 'das na/ phyi rabs kyi gdul bya rnams la zlas su rung ba'i zhal chems gdams ngag dang bcas pa zhig thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ nga srid pa tha ma pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin pas nga la 'brel ba yod pa tsho 'tshengs pa yin gsungs shing*/ kho bos de snga yang tshogs dben med par bshad pa de tsho rang yin mod/ de (151)min pa logs pa zhig bshad rgyu med/ 'on kyang khyod kyis 'di sems la zungs/ da lta phan chad 'chi ba'i dus tshun du yang*/ kho bo dran par gyis de rang gis chog pa yin/ kho bos sems can ngan song nas 'don pa'i las tshan chen po bsags pa yin pas kho bo'i ming thos pa tsam yang 'dren nus pa yin/ nga kha chems rlung po la 'jog /kha chems gzhan gzhag rgyu med gsungs/ da bzod dwags po snyi sgom gyis 'di skad zer ba yin bya ba 'ong ba yin/ chos sus bshad zer na snyi sgom gyis bshad pa yin gyis gsung*/ yang nan tan du zhus pas 'di skad gsung*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis su 'dres pa'i yi dam gyi lha rnams dang*/ jo bo dkon mchog gsum mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyis sems can thams cad la thugs rje'i spyan ras dag pas gzigs shing skyabs pa dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ bskyang ba dang*/ thugs rjes bzung du gsol// nga yongs 'di ltar bsam par zhu// 'chi ba zhes bya rnam rtog yin// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyis// mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par byed// rnam rtog gcig nas gcig 'gro ba// de la 'chi rgyu ga la yod// chos sku rnam par dag pa (152)la// de la 'chi rgyu ga la yod// 'ja' tshon ri mo yal ba la// de la 'chi rgyu ga la yod// sems la skye 'chi med pa la// de la 'chi rgyu ga la yod// 'byung bzhi rnam par dag pa la// de la 'chi rgyu ga la yod// sgyu ma'i grong khyer zhig pa la// de la 'chi rgyu ga la yod// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med la// de la 'chi rgyu ga la yod// 'od gsal rnam par dag pa la// de la 'chi rgyu ga la yod// rten 'brel tshogs pa gyes pa la// de la 'chi rgyu ga la yod// rang sems skye 'gag med pa la// de la 'chi rgyu ga la yod// dag pa'i zhing du 'gro ba la// de la 'chi rgyu ga la yod// btags pa ming gi rdo rje yin// nga ni song ba'i dus dag na// nga la sems pa'i gdul bya rnams// sdug bsngal mya ngan ma byed par// nang du rang gi sems la ltos// bcos min ngo bo mthong ba na// nga dang 'bral ba med pa yin// nā ro'i chos drug bsgom pa na// nga dang 'bral ba med pa yin// lha sku dbyer med bsgom pa na// nga dang 'bral ba med pa yin// chos rnams rten 'brel go ba na// nga dang 'bral ba med pa yin// stong nyid snying rje 'dres pa na// nga dang 'bral ba med pa yin// rang sems bla mar shar tsa na// nga dang (153)'bral ba med pa yin// byang chub sems nyid 'byongs pa na// nga dang 'bral ba med pa yin// rnam rtog cir yang gzigs pa na// nga dang 'bral ba med pa yin// rtag tu ri khrod 'grim pa na// nga dang 'bral ba med pa yin// 'jig rten blo yis btang ba na// nga dang 'bral ba med pa yin// skye 'chi gnyis med rtogs pa na// nga dang 'bral ba med pa yin// chog shes 'dod pa bral ba na// nga dang 'bral ba med pa yin// kun la bu bzhin brtse ba na// nga dang 'bral ba med pa yin// bla ma'i gsung bzhin sgrub pa na// nga dang 'bral ba med pa yin// dam tshig gtsang mar bsrung ba na// nga dang 'bral ba med pa yin// kho bo gnyis med dbyings su gshegs pa na/

bla ma med par gyur snyam ma sems par/ bla ma dam pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams dang nga'i sems dbyer mi phyed pa brtan g.yo thams cad la khyab par gnas pa yin pas de bzhin du go zhing rtogs par zhu/ chos thams cad kyi mthar thug pa'i don stong pa nyid dang snying rje dbyer med pa bsgom par zhu/ lam rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ zab lam nā ro'i chos drug bsgom par zhu'o// yon tan skyes tshad la mchog tu ma 'dzin par gong nas gong du brtseg par zhu/ (154)bsgoms skyon dang the tshom byung na gegs sel gyi dpe rnams gzigs par zhu/ rang zhi bde 'dod na 'dod chung chog shes bgyid par zhu/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhed na ri khrod kyi dgon pa 'grim par zhu'o// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dran par gyis la tshe 'di blo yis gtong bar zhu/ bla ma rang sems yin pas gzhan nas mi tshol bar zhu/ rnam rtog mi mnga' sa le mkhyen pa'i chos rnams rten 'brel du rtogs par zhu/ smon lam ji ltar btab pa bzhin du 'grub pa yin pas smon lam zab cing rgya che ba 'debs par zhu/ ma 'ongs pa'i gang zag nga dang ma phrad snyam pa kun kyang*/ kho bos brtsams pa'i lam mchog rin chen 'phreng ba dang*/ rnam par thar pa'i rgyan la sogs pa rnams la gzigs dang*/ nga dang dngos su phrad pa dang khyad med kyis da lta nga'i 'khor snying med po 'ga'/ bla ma dam pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas 'di lta bu dang mjal nas nga la bsgom med sems pa kun kyang*/ gus par gyis la 'bad de gsol ba thob dang*/ byin rlabs kyis yon tan rang 'bar du 'byung bas/ de ltar dgongs par zhu/ sems can la gnod par ni 'ong*/ phan par ni dka' bas gdan sa dang*/ sku lder dang*/ 'bum pa la sogs pa mi mdzad par zhu/ gdan sa dang bla ma'i rnam thar (155)la sogs pa gang yin na chos dang mthun pa de yin pas/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang ma 'gal ba zhig mdzad par zhu/ lar ni bla mar snang ba rmi lam tsam 'di nub kyang*/

thugs rje dang byin rlabs chung du mi 'gro zhing*/ sdug bsngal las skyob cing 'khor bar mi ltung ba nga rang gis shes kyis mos pa dang gdung ba mi brjed par gsol ba 'debs par zhu'o// zhes gsung chems kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// ka ye rang la sems pa'i slob ma rnams// 'khor bar mi ltung nga rang shes// sdug bsngal skyob par nga rang shes// sdug bsngal ma byed bu slob rnams// sdug bsngal la snying po ga la yod// 'khrul snang la snying po ma mchis pas// bu gcig po shi ba'i mar rgan yang*// zhag gsum nangs par 'dzum bu 'chor// de ma shor ba la ngo mtshar med// de bas bu dang slob ma rnams// phyi ru mya ngan ma byed par// nang du rang gi sems la ltos// bcos min gnyug ma mthong ba na// nga dang 'bral ba med pa yin// byang chub sems ldan skyes bu nga la nyon// bdag gis 'gro ba sems can ma lus pa// dag pa mngon dga'i zhing khams su// yang dag de ru 'khrid par shog /khrid nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// nges pa nyid du (156)sgrol bar shog /ces gsung*/ lar snyung rgyu ni med/ sku shed cung chung nas gsol ja ba rnams thugs ma bde nas/ slob dpon sgom tshul dang sho sgom 'phags pa gnyis sbran nas/ zhal skyems sam/ sku khams bde'am dris pas cung zad ma bde gsungs/ slob dpon sgom pas lcags thom gyi nang du chu skol nas lcong zhi zhib mo btab pa 'dren par brtsams/ sho sgom gyis zhe sa phul nas/ ji ltar snyung dri dgos snyam tsa na/ sku drang por srang spyan nam mkha' la hrig mdzad de/ rnam rtog mi mnga' ci yang sa le mkhyen/ de khyed kyis go'am nga rang gis ni go zhes yang yang gsung zhing*/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs skye 'gags med cing*/ spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la snyom par bzhugs so// dus snga dro nyi ma ri sked la sleb pa tsam yin la/ tshes bco lnga/ skar ma chu stod/

zla ba dbyar zla 'bring po/ gnyal pa dang 'ol ka ba dang*/ dbrongs kha ba rnams kyi zhing ser ma'i btsas ma byed dus/ chu mo bya lo la bab pa'i tshe/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa lnga la sku gshegs pa'i tshul bstan/ de nub nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' 'od kyis khengs pa dang*/ sgam po'i thad kyi nam mkha' la shel gyi mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad 'od 'phro ba dang*/ lha'i rnga lta bu'i sgra chen po (157)grags pa dbrongs kha ba dang*/ 'ol ka ba dang*/ gnyal pa la sogs pa thams cad kyi mthun snang du byung*/ de yang bla ma gang du gshegs pa'i sar 'jas lam sna 'dren pa yod pas/ mi bying na re/ bla ma spyan 'dren mkhan yod par 'dug zer/ dge bshes khams pas 'ur sgra chen po yang gsan/ khong rang gi spyil po dang yang dgon 'ja' 'od kyis sbrel bar gzigs/ a tsar ni bya bas 'od kyis sgam po gang bar mthong ba dang*/ lha rje snyi sgom 'das so zer ba'i sgra thos/ de nas gdung lha khang chen mor gdan drangs nas dar zab dang rin po che'i khri la bzhugs te/ mchod pa'i bkod pa sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas nas/ btsun chung gnyis kyis mchod gnyer byas pas phyag rgya chen po'i sgom skyes/ sgom chen thams cad kyang so so nas mtshams ston te gdung gi drung du 'dus nas thams cad kyis mos pa'i sgo nas mchod pa phul zhing*/ gsol ba btab pas zhag gsum gyi bar du thams cad la gnyid dang rmugs pa dang*/ bza' btung gi snang ba ye med de/ gdong mchi mas gang zhing gsol ba btab pas phal cher ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams myong khyad par can dang ldan par gyur to// de nas zhag gsum gyi nangs par mchod pa'i khyad par shin tu rgyas pa dang bcas te gdung bzhus/ (158)gdung rus 'o ma la 'dren pa'i phyir/ skam pas len par brtsams pas 'od rdza ma tsam zhig spur khang gi nang du 'dril bar mthong*/ gzhan yang mthong snang sna tshogs byung ste/ dge bshes khams pas 'ja' spungs pa'i gur lta bu steng gi nam mkha' la mthong*/

mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams sprin bzhin 'thibs par mthong*/ slob dpon stod lungs pas nub phyogs la 'ja' gur phub pa lta bu mthong*/ la las spur khang gi phyi rol na mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bskor bar mthong*/ slob dpon gnyos pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ sgom sher gsum gyis 'jag spyil dang*/ spur khang gi bar 'ja' gsum gyis sbrel bar mthong*/ bud med sma ra yod pa mang pos gdung la mchod pa byed pa dang*/ de la sogs pa rang rang la mthong snang sna tshogs dang*/ phul du phyin pa'i bltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing*/ dbus kyi sgam po'i ri de smug sing ba thams cad kyis mthong ba la/ rong khang rnams rmugs pas 'thibs shing*/ mtha' ma khor yug tu sprin mchod rten gyi bang rim lta bus khengs shing 'khrig par gyur nas/ de'i dbus na sgam po'i ri ni sprin dang na bun gang yang med par 'dzum dkyil le 'dug ste/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag par gyur to// spur sbyangs pa'i nang nas thugs mes ma gnod (159)par byon pas slar yang slang nga'i nang du til mar blug nas sol mes bsregs kyang rnam pa gsal du song bas/ slob dpon sgom pa'i zhal nas 'di 'o skol rnams la thugs rjes 'dzin pa'i rten du byon par 'dug /gsungs nas gsol 'debs bstod pa 'di gsungs so// rje mnyam med bla ma rin po che// cir snang chos skur ston mdzad cing*// bde ba chen-por gzigs mdzad pa'i// rje dus gsum gsal la phyag 'tshal bstod// nyin mtshan dus rnams thams cad du// chos nyid ngang las g.yo ba med// rnam par snang mdzad sprul pa zhig /rje ye shes sgron la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// thugs rje'i chu rgyun mi gcod pa// spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa zhig /rje 'gro ba 'dren la phyag 'tshal bstod// khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ni// nyon mongs nad kyis gdung ba la// sman pa'i rgyal po'i sprul pa zhig

/rje dug lnga sel la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro drug sems can thams cad la// sna tshogs sgo nas don mdzad cing*// ye shes sgron me 'degs mdzad pa// rje sprul sku khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gis khyed la de bstod pa// de las byung ba'i bsod nams (160)kyis// 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyis// nyon mongs nad rnams sel bar shog /ces gsungs nas thugs de dri dang spos chab kyis sku khrus gsol nas/ sgom chen rtogs ldan rnams la zhal bstan cing dbang bskur ro// de nas sde pa rnams kyis rin po che 'das pa'i gtam thos nas/ thams cad kyis bzang 'gran byas nas gdung gdan 'dren du 'ongs te/ zla ba gcig tu gdung la mchod pa phul nas bzhi char dgos so// sde pa rnams kyis cha bzhi/ slob dpon sgom pas bkra shis sgo mang nang du bzhugs pa la bzhi cha/ sgom chen pa rnams kyis phyed thob pa la/ slob dpon sgom pas gser zho la btags nas dam tshig la kar te rgyal pham med par bgos so// sde pa rnams kyis phyogs phyogs su dar gyi khri la gdung bzhugs te/ steng du gdugs phub/ zur la rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ phyogs rnams la ba dan dang*/ phye ma phur ma la sogs pa mchod rdzas du ma dang*/ cha lang dang 'khar rnga la sogs pa'i rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs dang bcas pas bskor te gdan drangs so// nam mkha' yang 'ja' 'od kyis gang bar gyur to// bar snang thams cad spos kyi du bas 'khrigs shing*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyis ngu zhing smre sngags bton pas/ sa g.yos pa tsam du gyur to// sgom chen rnams kyang (161)rang rang gi phyogs kyi ri khrod rnams la bzhud do// sa gzhi thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs nyams te sdod mi 'dod par gyur kyang*/ khams pa rin po che'i zhal nas yugs sa mo khrel chung bar 'dod pa rnams kyang*/ dbyar dgun re'i mya ngan byed par 'dug pas/ nga yang da lo slob dpon sgom pa'i sdod rogs byed pa yin gsungs nas/

'tsho ba dkon ne las med kyang dpon slob gnyis kyis slob dpon sgom pa'i phyag phyir bzhugs so// de'i tshe chos rje rin po che 'das dus ma bslebs pa'i sgom chen rnams kyis dri rmed byas pa'i lan du gdung dbyangs kyi nga ro gsungs pa/ skyes chen mi yi seng ge'i nyi ma ni// dus kyi rgyal po bya lo shar ba'i tshe// dbyar zla 'bring po'i bco lnga'i snga dro la// sangs rgyas nyi ma gdul bya'i snang ngor nub// rgyu skar chu stod mkha' la rgyu ba'i dus// rtsi shing nags tshal 'bras bu smin gyur cing*// nye dang ring ba'i skye bo thams cad kyis// 'ja' yi gur phub mchod rten snang ba shar// du ba 'od kyi phung po chen por 'khyil// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams sprin phung bzhin du 'thibs// sprin tshogs rab dwangs nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor te// 'od zer rab bkye mchod pa'i char pa phab// ye shes me la thugs nyid bzhu gyur kyang*// 'gyur ba med pa chos rje'i phyag (162)tu byon// rjes 'jug bka' 'bangs rnams la thugs rje yis// lcags kyu'i zhags pas dus gsum gzigs par nges// zla ba gcig tu gdung la mchod pa phul// mchod pa'i rten du gdung rnams so sor bgos// sde pa rnams kyis phyogs phyogs rnams su yang*// shing rta rab byas rgyal mtshan bslang byas shing*// gdugs rnams rab phub rol mo'i tshogs kyis bskor// spos kyi dud pas stong gsum khyab gyur cing*// nam mkha' 'ja' dang 'od kyis khengs par gyur// dge 'dun rnams kyi gdong yang mchi mas g.yogs// mkha' 'gro rnams kyang rang bzhin gnas su gshegs// sgom chen rnams kyang rang rang yul du bzhud// chos skyong rnams kyang rtogs ldan phyi bzhin 'brang*// dben zhing nyams dga'i dgon pa stongs par gyur// yi dwags rnams la gtor ma'i rgyun yang chad// 'gro ba'i nyi ma sgam por nub par gyur// dgos 'dod nor bu chos dbyings rgya mtshor gtor// shes rab sgron me dus kyi rlung gis skyod// sa yi bkrag nyams thar pa'i grong khyer zhig

/kyi hud 'dod 'jo'i rgya mtsho skams par gyur// thub pa'i bstan pa sgam po'i ri la nub// 'di 'dra'i bshes gnyen rnyed par ga la 'gyur// 'od gsal nyi ma nub par gyur pa la// lta ngan mun pa gang (163)gis sel bar nus// gru chen rgya mtshor zhig par gyur pa la// chu bo bzhi las gang gis sgrol bar 'gyur// ye shes ri bo nyil bar gyur pa la// shes rab nyi ma gang las 'char bar 'gyur// gdul bya'i char pa chad par gyur pa la// phrin las myu gu gang gis bran par 'gyur// kyi hud skyes mchog chen po gang du gshegs// 'gro ba'i sgron me gang du gshegs par gyur// sngon gyi dus na me tog zla mdzes te// thub pa'i spyan sngar zla 'od gzhon nur gyur// lnga brgya'i dus 'dir skyes mchog chen po nyid// khyed ni mthong ngam thos sam dran gyur pa// khyed la dad pa'i skye bo ma lus pa// sdig pa rab zad rtogs pa mthar thug 'char// skyes bu khyed kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis// sangs rgyas zhing du khyed dang mi 'bral shog /ces bstod nas bla ma rin po che min na/ da res kyang kho bo'i mi lus don med la de'u song gsungs shing*/ lar slob ma bya ba bla ma'i rnam thar 'dzin pa la zer ba yin pas kho bo yang rin po che'i rnam par thar pa bzhin byed pa yin gsungs nas/ dus rtag tu mtshams la gnas pa dang*/ rkang bzhi'i 'bul ba mi len pa dang*/ gser dngul phyag tu mi 'dzin pa/ yar ngo la sku mtshams mdzad pa/ mar ngo la khrid mdzad pa dang*/ de la sogs pa rin po che'i rnam (164)thar bzhin mdzad do// de nas slob dpon sgom pas bkra shis sgo mang la sogs te/ chos rje'i phyi rten nang rten rnams legs par grub nas khong rang gi thugs las rnams tshar ba dang*/ dbon po sgom chung la gdan sa gtad nas/ khong rang ri khrod la 'byon par dgongs pa la/ grwa pa bgres po rnams dang nye gnas la sogs pa rnams sgo mang la phyag 'bul ba dang*/

chos 'brel zhu ba la phyogs phyogs nas tshogs te/ chos zhu ba'i lan mgur du gsungs pa/ blo 'das kyi lta ba mtha' bral la// the tshom za yang mi 'tshal lo// bde stong gi sgom pa zhen med la// sgom thun du bcad kyang mi 'tshal lo// rang shugs kyi spyod pa zhen med la// tshul 'chos bgyi yang mi 'tshal lo// 'bras bu rang sems 'od gsal la// re dwogs bgyi yang mi 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pas/ don nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag cig zhu lags/ zhes zhus pas/ the tshom med pa'i lta ba la// gzhi rtsa chod pa'i rtogs pa 'tshal// sgom thun du bcad du med pa la// dus gsum gnyug mar 'char yang 'tshal// tshul 'chos med pa'i spyod pa la// rang 'khris med pa'i gzhan phan 'tshal// re dwogs med pa'i 'bras bu la// goms pa rgyun (165)du bsten yang 'tshal// zhes gsungs pas khyed res 'tshal res mi 'tshal gsung*/ de kun khyed rang rtogs ldan gyi chos su 'dug /nged rnams la skye bar byed pa'i thabs lag tu blang rgyu'i gdams ngag cig zhu zer ba la yang gsungs pa/ dbyangs de dang gcig ste 'di dang gnyis// lhan cig skyes pa'i sems nyid 'di// btsir gyis gzung na gnyug ma yin// lhod kyis glod na spros bral yin// lhan cig rtogs na chos sku yin// rnam rtog spang byar mi 'dod cing*// mi rtog ched du mi sgrub pa// mnyam bral sems kyi ngo bo yin// gsal stong gi rig pa rjen pa 'di// ma yengs par skyong ba man ngag yin// yod na bla ma dkon mchog mchod// med na shes pa glod las zhog /pha 'dzam gling grags pas de skad gsungs// zhes gsungs te/ rje sgom pa 'di nyid kyang*/ bla ma rin po che'i 'phrin las kyi rnam sprul/ sprul sku sems can gyi bsod nams las grub pa/ bstan pa'i bdag po yin te/ de yang rgyas pa se re dang*/ yum tshe lcam gnyis la sras gsum yod pa'i 'bring po sgom pa grags mdzes bya ba/

ting nge 'dzin du ma dang ldan pa zhig snga bar 'das// de'i gcen po slob dpon sgom tshul yang yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ yum gyi rmi lam na lto ba nas nyi ma (166)shar bas 'dzam gling 'od kyis gang ba rmis pas/ sku bltams pa'i dus su mtshan yang 'dzam gling grags pa bya bar btags/ lo lnga pa la a khu lha rje snyi chung pa dang 'grogs nas dwags po ngos su byon/ bla ma chen po dang mjal/ mi g.yo ba'i sgom lung phog pas zhal gzigs/ lo bcu gcig pa la sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin ni 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu bdun lon nas dge bshes mnga' ris pas mkhan po mdzad de dge tshul mnos/ nyi shu la dge bshes sha ba gling pas mkhan po mdzad nas bsnyen rdzogs mdzad do// dge slong tshul khrims snying po bya bar mtshan gsol/ bla ma chen pos chos drug la sogs te/ gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs par gnang nas gnyags lta byar ma dang*/ lho sha 'ug dom tshang la sogs pa ri khrod du ma bsten/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub mnyes/ byar lkog dbang zhu phub tu bzhugs dus/ zhwa sna ring gi sna ba bltabs ste mnabs pas sgom zhwa zhes grags pa byung*/ bla ma chen po'i zhal nas sgom tshul 'di sngar nas thugs rgyud sbyangs sbyangs pas/ kho bos sad par byas pa tsam zhes shin tu dgyes par mdzad/ de nas tshogs pa slob dpon sgom pa la gtad/ bya lkog tu tshogs pa stong re tsam 'dus/ de nas sgam po'i mchod khang rnying ma dang*/ sgom (167)sde'i mkhar lan la sogs pa mdzad/ gser gyi mchod rten bkra shis sgo mangs la sogs pa mang du bzhengs/ de nas stod lungs kyi gnas brtan shes rab grags bya bas gdan drangs/ mtshur lha lung gi dgon pa btab/ dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi dge 'dun dpag tu med pa smin grol la bkod/ de nas 'dre srin gdug pa can 'khrugs nas/ lha sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang mes bsregs/ re hrul du song nas gso mkhan med pa'i dus su/

chos skyong mgon po dang*/ re ma ti dang*/ rdzong btsan gsum gyi spyan 'dren du byung ste/ dbu ru byang ngos pha gir lha sa sde bzhi 'khrug pa shor bas de'i bsdums la byon zer bas zhal gyis bzhes te/ der byon nas re hrul stong pa der bzhugs nas/ bsdums ma byung*/ yun ring du thogs/ dwags po nas kyi grwa pa rnams skyo bar gyur/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas da zhag 'ga' na 'gro ba yin gsungs/ der 'gro bar brtsams pa dang*/ yang 'gro mi btub par 'dug gsungs/ de ji ltar lags zhus pas/ mdang nga'i rmi lam du bla ma chen po byon nas sgom tshul khyod kyis nga 'jog phod dam bya ba gsungs/ bla ma chen po dang jo bo tha dad mi 'dug gsung*/ yang lan cig jo bo'i zhal nas 'khrug pa 'di khyod kyis mi sdum na sus sdum/ ngas (168)grogs bya yis gsungs te/ spyan chab byung ba kun gyis mthong snang du grub pa byung*/ de nas jo bo'i lung gi rjes su 'brangs nas bsdums pas/ tshegs ma byung*/ bsod nams nam mkha' dang mnyam/ nyi ma dang zla ba lta bur grags par gyur/ 'phrul snang gi lcags ri dang*/ skor khang dang*/ spen pad dang*/ zhal ba la sogs pa'i zhabs tog mang du mdzad/ slob dpon gnyal ston la khyod kyis lha sa 'di cir mthong gsungs/ gnyal ston gyis jo bo 'di na bzhugs/ byams pa 'di na bzhugs bya ba la sogs pa kun gyis mthong ba bzhin du mthong zhus pas/ kho bos de ltar ma mthong lha sa'i gtsug lag khang 'di dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du mthong gsungs/ bdag gis kyang mthong thabs yod lags sam zhus pas/ mos gus gyis dang mthong gi gsungs/ gsol ba btab pas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo slob dpon nyid kyis mdzad pa/ khong rang yang lha'i gral la tshud par gzigs so// gnyal ston na re 'o skol rnams la nā ro pa tsam gyis dad pa yod na/ slob dpon 'di la tai lo pa tsam gyis byin rlabs yod ngo shes par 'dug gsung skad/

gzhan yang rdo rje gdan skad cig gi skor ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa (169)gzigs pa dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dang rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa yi dam gyi lha dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs/ sku mi snang ba dang du mar gyur pa la sogs pa rdzu 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa yin zhing*/ chos rgyal chen po'i bka' chems las lung bstan pa'ang yod de/ ji skad du/ byang chub sems dpa' shar lhor sku 'khrungs pa// gsang sngags 'chang ba'i rnal 'byor chen po ni// snying po'i mtha' can skyes bu dam pa ste// gtsug lag khang chen 'di la phan par 'gyur// zhes sogs 'byung zhing rgyas par ni rje 'di nyid kyi rnam thar du blta bar bya'o// de ltar bdag nyid chen po 'di ni bla ma chen po dang*/ ngo bo cig kyang thugs sras lta bur snang ba mi las 'das pa yin zhing*/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gsum gyi bar du bzhugs/ glang gi lo ston zla tha chung gi tshes nyi shu la ngo mtshar ba'i bltas mang po dang bcas te sku gshegs/ thugs dang ljags ma tshig par byon/ slob dpon pa'i gcung po slob dpon sgom chung zhes grags pa yang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rtogs pa dang yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' zhing*/ bde mchog dang sgrol ma dkar mo la sogs te/ yi dam dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa mthong ba dang*/ dbu'i gtsug tor (170)kun gyis gsal bar mthong ba yod pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston cing thugs rje dang rtogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' ba zhig yin cing*/ dgung lo bzhi cu rtsa bzhi la ngo mtshar ba'i bltas mang po dang bcas te sku gshegs/ thugs ljags ma tshig par byon/ rgyas par ni 'di nyid kyi rnam thar du blta bar bya'o// de ltar rje khu dbon gsum po 'di ni/ 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mgon rigs gsum mgon po lta bu/ rdo rje 'chang nas sprul pa'i sku rgyun ma chad pa yin te/

rje btsun khu dbon 'di dag gi sras mchog tu gyur pa/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa dang*/ bde gshegs rin po che phag mo gru pa dang*/ dpal 'ba' rom pa rnams so sor yang yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa 'gro ba 'dren pa'i gtso bor gyur pa'o// nye ba'i sras bzhi la/ sgom pa 'dul 'dzin/ la yag jo sras/ mgar sgom dkar po/ skye sgom ye rdor dang bzhi'o// gsol ja gzims g.yog dang zhabs tog byed pa'i nye gnas bzhi ni/ jo gdan legs mdzes/ sho sgom byang yes/ nye gnas gsal byang*/ ras sgom ras pa dang bzhi'o// gzhan yang 'ol kha chos 'byung*/ thang lha mon sgom/ ti sgro nyang sgom/ zhig po ljang thul/ zhes bya ba rnams dang*/ rin po che rmog lcog (171)pa/ rgyal ba khyung tshang pa/ gnam mtsho do sgom/ zangs ri ras pa la sogs te phyi nang gi yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' ba'i bu slob bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ngo*// rje sgom pa dang*/ dge bshes khams pa dang*/ rje rin po che dbu se la sogs pa thugs kyi sras mang zhing 'dus pa'i dus su/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar kho bo zla 'od gzhon nu zhes bya bar gyur nas ting nge 'dzin dam pa stsal zhing*/ 'dir yang kho bos khyed rnams ting nge 'dzin la bkod de/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba cher byas pa yin zhes gsungs te/ de ltar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras dam par gyur pa/ chos rje sgam po pa 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das kyis ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo dang*/ dkon mchog rtsegs pa dang*/ snying rje padma dkar po la sogs te mdo rgyud du mar lung bstan cing*/ snyigs ma'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la chos 'dzin par zhal gyis bzhes pa/ dge slong 'tsho byed ces bya ba 'khor dgra bcom pa lnga brgya las mi nyung bar lung bstan te/ de yang ting nge 'dzin gyi rtogs pa dang ldan pa/

ma dag pa'i dngos po brgyad mi 'chang ba/ ri mtshams dang 'dag sbyar la gnas pa/ gsang spyod tsog pu'i rnal 'byor la (172)brtson pa/ spyan dang mngon shes drug gi yon tan dang ldan pa/ lnga khri gcig stong drug brgya 'byung ngo*// zhes pa dang*/ mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i le'u bco lnga pa las kyang*/ gsal bar lung bstan te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byams pa la bka' stsal pa/ zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa 'di nyid kyis// mtshungs pa med par dga' bas sangs rgyas bstod// sangs rgyas yon tan bye brag 'phags brjod pas// rtag tu 'khor mor shin tu bsngags par 'gyur// sngon yang rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer 'dir// sangs rgyas dag kyang bye ba phrag stong mthong*// rgyal ba de dag kun gyi drung du 'dis// ting 'dzin zhi mchog 'di yang rab tu dris// byang chub spyod pa mchog 'di spyod pa na// 'di ni kun tu nga yi bur gyur te// thams cad du yang spobs dang ldan par gyur// kun tu rtag par tshangs par spyod pa spyad// 'di ni phyi dus 'jigs pa chen po la// rtag tu tshangs spyod gtsang la rab gnas pas// ting 'dzin 'di ni shin tu rgyas byed 'gyur// 'di la ma pham khyod nyid nga yi dpang*// ting 'dzin dam pa 'di ni rab 'tshol zhing*// lam 'dir zhugs pas byang chub dam thob 'gyur// sangs rgyas bye ba mang pos yongs bzung ste// 'dren pa rnams la mchod pa (173)mchog byed 'gyur// nga ni ye shes la yang rab gnas te// zla 'od spyod pa khyad zhugs lung bstan cing*// 'di yi srog dang tshangs par spyod pa dag /phyi ma'i dus la bar chad med par bya// lag mthil kyu ru'i 'bru lnga bkod pa bzhin// ma 'ongs pa na gang la mchod 'gyur ba// sangs rgyas bye ba dag ni phrag stong dang*// de las lhag par gaṅga'i bye snyed ces// lha dang klu rnams bye ba brgyad cu dang*// gnod sbyin bye ba stong phrag bdun cu dag

/phyi ma'i dus la brtson par byed par 'gyur// rkang gnyis gtso bo la yang mchod par byed// rkang gnyis gtso la mchod pa mchog byas te// ye shes bla med 'di ni rab bsgrubs nas// phyi ma'i dus la de ni 'jig rten mgon// rgyal ba dri med 'od ces bya bar 'gyur// zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa bdag nyid kyi// lung bstan 'di thos dga' ba rgyas gyur te// ta la bdun srid du ni mngon 'phags nas// mkha' la 'dug ste ched du brjod pa brjod// e ma rgyal bas chos mchog ston mdzad pa// rnam grol ye shes bdag po stobs la gnas// shin tu nges pa'i ye shes mchog gnas pas// pha rol rgol ba dag gis zil mi non// chags pa spangs shing rnam par grol la reg /srid pa'i khri shing 'ching ba mtha' dag (174)bcad// srid pa spangs shing srid par mtshams sbyor med// chos kyi rang bzhin dngos med rab mkhyen cing*// brjod du med pa'i tshig kyang thugs su chud// mu stegs phyin ci log la gnas pa dag /mi mkhas de kun seng ges wa bzhin bshig /bde bar gshegs pa bstan pa'i chos kyi gter// gter mchog dam pa bdag gis deng thob ste// ngan 'gro log par ltung ba thams cad spangs// 'dren par mi 'gyur snyam pa'i the tshom med// gser gyi kha dog mdzes shing 'od gsal ba// phyag kyang de'i mgo la rab bzhag nas// lhar bcas 'jig rten dag kyang dpang bkod de// mi yi khyu mchog byang chub dbang bskur mdzad// ces bstan to// rgyas par ni mdo nyid las rtogs par bya'o// yang 'khor 'dus pa'i sgo nas kyang gsal bar bstan te/ mdo de nyid las/ zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa sems dga' nas// sangs rgyas spyan sngar 'dug ste tshig smras pa// skyes bu dam pa mya ngan yongs 'das nas// ma rungs dus na bdag gis mdo 'di bzung*// bdag gis lus dang srog kyang yongs btang ste// 'jig rten skyid pa ci mchis kun btang la// bdag gis 'jig pa chen po'i dus der yang*// ting 'dzin zhi mchog 'di ni bzung bar bgyis// (175)sems can mang la snying rje cher bskyed de// sems can sdug bsngal mgon med mthong bas kyang*// de dag la ni byams pa nyer sbyar zhing*// ting 'dzin zhi mchog 'di ni gzung bar bgyi// de yi tshe na ting 'dzin 'dzin pa dag

/lnga brgya las ni mi nyung der 'byung ste// mdo sde mchog 'di rgya cher gzung ba la// de dag sngon du 'dren pa gzhon nu yin// zhes bstan to// yang phyi rabs kyi rgyud 'dzin bstan pa yang mdo de nyid las/ mi zad pa yi phyi dus la// dam pa'i chos ni 'jig pa'i tshe// mdo sde 'di ni rab bshad par// khyed la su dag spro ba yod// de tshe gzhon nu langs nas ni// ngu zhing rgyal la 'di skad gsol// sangs rgyas thugs kyi sras po yis// 'di skad seng ge'i sgra yang grags// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das// mi zad pa yi phyi dus la// lus dang srog kyang rab btang ste// bdag gis mdo sde rgyas par bgyi// byis pa rnams kyis mi bden pa// spyod cing spyod pa bzang bar bgyi// gshe ba dang ni sdig pa yang*// 'dren pa dang du blang bar bgyi// byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dag la// ngan sems dag ni skye ba'am// gang sngon bdag gi sdig pa yis// las rnams bgyis pa byang bar bgyi// sangs rgyas gser gyi mdog 'dra (176)ba// spyi bo la ni phyag bzhag ste// de bzhin gshegs pa 'jam dpal dbyangs// zla 'od la ni ston pas gsung*// gzhon nu phyi ma'i dus dag la// khyod kyis tshangs par spyod pa dang*// srog gi bar chad mi 'byung bar// khyod la byin gyis brlab par bya// chos smra ba ni gzhan dag kyang*// brgyad brgya po dag langs nas su// phyi ma'i dus na bdag cag kyang*// mdo sde 'di ni 'dzin pa lags// lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin yang*// bye ba brgya bcu nyer lhags te// gzhan yang khrag khrig drug cu rnams// 'jig rten mgon la 'di skad smras// dge slong dag ni 'di rnams las// de ring su dag langs pa rnams// phyi dus de tshe bdag cag gis// 'dren pa rab tu bsrung bar bgyi// zhes gsungs pas/ brgyud 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa 'di rnams kyang*/ sngon gyi chos smra ba brgyad po de rnams yin cing*/

de'i dus kyi lha dang klu la sogs pa de rnams kyang*/ skyes bu dam pa de rnams kyi phyi bzhin du chos skyong bar lung bstan pa yin no// rgyas par ni mdo nyid du blta bar bya'o// don 'di nyid dang mthun par snying rje padma dkar po las/ ji skad du nga 'das nas ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ byang phyogs kyi rgyud du dge slong 'tsho byed ces bya ba/ sngon gyi (177)rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa/ sangs rgyas brgya stong mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ lhag pa'i bsam pa bskyed pa/ theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa/ skye bo mang po la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir zhugs pa/ mang du thos pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod 'dzin pa/ theg pa chen po'i bsngags pa brjod/ theg pa chen po la yang dag par rab tu ston pa zhig 'byung bar 'gyur te/ zhes bla ma chen po nyid kyi lung bstan dang*/ des nga'i sku gdung zhig cing ral ba rnams mthong nas gser gyis brgyan par byed/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang*/ dar dang dril bu g.yer kha'i drwa bas g.yogs pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang mchod rten gyi khang pa dang*/ mchod rten rnams seng ge'i rgyal mtshan gyis brgyan te/ lha dang mi rnams dga' ba skye zhing yongs su bskyang ba dang*/ nga'i bstan pa yongs su bskyang ba dang*/ sems ma dwangs pa rnams dwangs par bya ba dang*/ dwangs pa rnams phyir zhing 'phel ba dang*/ skye bo mang po dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs bsags pa'i phyir longs spyod pa byed du 'jug par 'gyur ro// zhes slob dpon sgom pa lo lnga pa'i tshe mjal/ de gtsug lag khang gi zhig gso byed du 'jug pa dgongs pa yin no// zhes tshad (178)mar gyur pa rnams gsung ngo*// kun dga' bo de'i tshe dge slong mi brtson pa lhod pa/ longs spyod mang ba/ spong ba las nyams pa/ tshul khrims nyams pa/ tshul khrims 'chal ba/ sdig pa'i chos kun tu spyod pa/

'du 'dzi la dga' ba/ rab tu dben pa la mi blta ba/ brtson pa bor ba/ gnas gcig na 'khod pa/ yongs su 'dzin pa la brtson pa/ khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba rnams 'dres pa/ dkon mchog dang ma 'dres pa/ ma gus pa/ dge slong ltar bcos pa dag ni mang du 'byung bar 'gyur ro// dge slong brtson 'grus brtsams pa/ rab tu dben pa/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa/ mnyam par bzhag pa/ shes rab dang ldan pa/ sems rtse gcig pa/ dge ba'i chos can 'dod pa chung ba/ chog shes pa/ bsod snyoms la rgyu ba/ 'phags pa'i rigs la gnas pa/ mang du thos pa/ thos pa bsags pa dag ni nyung ngu 'byung bar 'gyur te/ zhes dag pa dang ma dag pa'i 'khor lung bstan pa/ de la dge slong 'tsho byed de 'khor rnams la khong khro ba'i sems med pa dang*/ dbang po ma nyams pa dang*/ dad pa dang dang ba mchog dang ldan pa/ gos ngur smrig bgos shing*/ tshul khrims can thams cad la sbyin gnas su 'du shes (179)bskyed nas sbyin pa byin/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par byed de/ byang chub sems dpar byed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po rnam pa sna tshogs bsags nas/ 'chi ba'i dus byas ma thag /nub phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba brgya stong 'das pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing*/ 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur te/ 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhes bya bar/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dri ma med pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro// kun dga' bo dge slong 'tsho byed des kyang nga'i bstan pa 'di yangs shing rgyas par byed par 'gyur gyis/ kun dga' bo khyod mya ngan ma byed smre sngags ma 'don cig /kun dga' bo nga'i tshangs par spyod pa rgyas pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyis mnos par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs/ chu bo ma hā lo hi ta'i 'gram ri brag tshang tshing can na dge slong 'tsho byed ces grags pa/

dag pa'i 'khor dang ma dag pa'i 'khor 'dres pa gcig pu/ lnga brgya las mi nyung ba dang lhan cig tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes la longs spyod/ ces pa la sogs pa mdo sde dang rgyud sde du ma las lung bstan pas/ the tshom dang rtsod pa'i gnas dang bral zhing*/ (180)gzhan las ches yid ches pa'i gnas su gzung bar bya ba yin pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhan yang 'di dag las ches mchog tu gyur pa'i rnam par thar pa mang zhig kyang snang mod kyis/ 'dir ni de tsam kho na las brjod par ma spobs so// 'di dag ni rje nyid kyis gsungs pa'i rnam thar rgyas bsdus gsum dang*/ nye gnas chos bzhi dang*/ bran kha rin po che la sogs pa rnams kyis phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa dang*/ 'dul 'dzin gyis zin bris su mdzad pa rnams dang*/ rje mkha' spyod dbang pos mdzad pa'i rnam thar chen mor grags pa rnams gung bsgrigs te/ mdo sde rin po che'i lung khungs dang sbyar nas mos pa'i blo kho nas yi ger bgyis so// me tog zla mdzes rgyal ba'i sras po mchog /gang sngon zla 'od gzhon nu zhes byar 'gyur// gang ri'i khrod 'dir dpal ldan sgam po pa// rgyal mchog dri med 'od la phyag 'tshal te// gang gis skal mang sngon nas rjes bzung yang*// dran dang blo gros ting 'dzin dman dbang gis// ji bzhin rtogs te de lta na yang 'dir// dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam thar yid bzhin 'phreng*// rab mdzes bkod pa'i ba dan rnam mdzes pa// mgon mchog thugs rje'i mthu las legs grub ste// ma lus skye dgu'i mig gi bdud rtsir (181)ni// zad med phyi mtha'i bar du rab tu gnas// bdag ni dus rnams kun tu bcom ldan 'das// bde chen rab rtsol khyod dang mi 'bral zhing*// ḍombi rnal 'byor dbang po'i lam bzang las// 'gro rnams yud kyis rnam 'dren nyid gyur cig /chos kyi rje dpal ldan sgam po pa'i rnam par thar pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan/

thar pa rin po che'i rgyan gyi mchog ces bya ba 'di ni/ rje nyid kyi dbon po/ spyan snga chos rje bsod nams lhun grub zla 'od rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas da lta'i bar la/ lo nyis stong gsum brgya go brgyad song zhing*/ mgon po 'di nyid bltams nas

sa mo lug bzhi brgya zhe gnyis song la/ mya ngan las 'das nas chu mo bya lo sum brgya re bdun song ba'i lcags pho 'brug gi lo la/ bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa spel ba'i slad du/ ri bo shāntir par du bgyis pa'o// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog/ //
